title: Method and system for training a car parts detector on synthetic dataset
abstract: A method may include selecting one or more virtual car parts, selecting initial positions and initial orientations for the selected one or more virtual car parts in a virtual container, determining resting positions and resting orientations for the selected one or more virtual car parts in the virtual container based on the initial positions, the initial orientations, and a physics simulation, generating an image of the selected one or more virtual car parts in the virtual container at the resting positions and the resting orientations, and generating training data including the generated image as one training example.

title: Reinforcement Learning System for Optimizing Selective Extraction of Lithium from Brines
abstract: According to one or more embodiments, a method, computer system, and computer program product for optimizing extraction of lithium through reinforcement learning are provided. The method may include receiving measurement data from one or more sensors corresponding to a current set of operational parameters associated with a direct lithium extraction process in one or more columns. A physical simulation of the direct lithium extraction process is generated based on the received measurement data and the current set of operational parameters. A set of optimal operational parameters for the one or more columns is identified based on the generated physical simulation. The identified set of optimal operational parameters is configured to maximize extraction of lithium through the direct lithium extraction process. The current set of operational parameters is adjusted based on the identified set of optimal operational parameters.

title: Systems and methods for engineering optimization using quantum computing
abstract: Methods and systems herein may solve engineering problems, such as multiphysics problems as design optimization problems, using quantum computing. Such quantum computing may utilize a quantum computing system, which may include a classical computing processor and a quantum processor. The classical computing processor may be configured to provide instructions to and receive output from the quantum processor. The quantum processor may comprise one or more quantum bits manipulated and measured by a quantum bit interface module. Input and a model comprising a quantum algorithm for an engineering problem may be used by the classical computing processor to generate quantum input for the quantum processor, which may operate using the quantum input, and quantum output may be returned to the classical computing processor to determine the output of the engineering model. In some implementations, an error may be determined and an error correction applied to the engineering model.

title: Autonomous simulated testing and benchmarking framework for agentic AI systems
abstract: A computer-implemented method and system are disclosed for simulation-based testing and benchmarking of an agentic artificial intelligence (AI) system. The method comprises binding a simulation agent to one or more tool-access interfaces of the agentic AI system to replace external tools, intercepting requests emitted through the interfaces, and generating protocol-compliant responses using synthetic data and a simulated environment. The simulation agent executes healthy and fault-inserted task runs within the synthetic environment and generates a performance vector comprising task-completion rate, accuracy, efficiency, resilience, and fault-recovery metrics. The system is configured for maintaining a simulation registry, orchestrating resource allocation using reinforcement-learning policies, and applying an autonomous feedback pipeline for continuous refinement. In some embodiments, the simulation agent operates in a stealth observation mode to train surrogate tool models, enabling privacy-compliant, closed-loop simulation.

title: Method for predicting multi-component spatial distribution in transformer
abstract: The invention discloses a multi-component spatial distribution prediction method in a transformer, which relates to the technical field of monitoring of the running state of power equipment, and comprises the steps of firstly constructing a multi-gas component transportation physical simulation model of transformer oil based on fluid simulation software, and configuring an observation system mapped with the position of an actual sensor; the method comprises the steps of constructing a time sequence error matrix of actual observation and simulation prediction, dividing the time sequence error matrix into a training set and a verification set, generating a dynamic B matrix by utilizing an LSTM network on the basis, fusing simulation data with real-time sensor observation data through an EnKF algorithm to realize dynamic updating and error correction of a simulation model, assisting an adaptive step length regulation and abnormality processing mechanism in a data assimilation process, and finally dynamically displaying the spatial distribution of each gas component in an oil tank in various forms. The invention effectively solves the problems of space limitation, static simulation prediction error accumulation and the like of the traditional monitoring, and realizes accurate and dynamic prediction of the spatial distribution of multiple gas components in the transformer.

title: Black start evaluation method for wind power generation system, computer equipment and related devices
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of electric power and discloses a black start evaluation method of a wind power generation system, computer equipment and related devices, wherein the black start evaluation method of the wind power generation system comprises the steps of obtaining a black start simulation data set, wherein the black start simulation data set comprises normal simulation data when the wind power generation system is normal and fault simulation data when the wind power generation system is faulty; training an initial SVDD model by using a black start simulation data set, respectively training to obtain a first SVDD model describing normal simulation data and a second SVDD model describing fault simulation data, obtaining a first spherical center distance of the first SVDD model and a second spherical center distance of the second SVDD model, inputting data to be detected of the wind power generation system into the first SVDD model and the second SVDD model to obtain a target distance, and evaluating the state of the wind power generation system based on the target distance, the first spherical center distance and the second spherical center distance. The invention can fully utilize the simulation data and improve the accuracy of black start evaluation.

title: Method and system for defining effective analysis frequency band of engineering structure
abstract: The invention relates to a method and a system for defining an effective analysis frequency band of an engineering structure, which are used for selecting important parameters and defining a range of statistical energy analysis of a target system, wherein the important parameters comprise a modal number, a modal overlapping factor, a normalized attenuation factor and coupling strength, carrying out dimensional analysis by combining vibration characteristics and boundary conditions of the target system to obtain dimensionless parameters with corresponding relations with the important parameters, comprising dimensionless wave numbers, shape parameters, damping loss factors and Poisson ratios, constructing a statistical energy analysis effective graph of each subsystem according to a corresponding relation between the dimensionless parameters and the important parameters so as to describe the distribution condition of the important parameters in a dimensionless parameter space, analyzing the statistical energy analysis effective graph to obtain the dimensionless wave number value range of each subsystem, and then combining the coupling relations to obtain the effective frequency band of the target system. The method has the advantages of being quick, visual, accurate and the like, and is beneficial to improving the high-frequency dynamic response prediction precision of the engineering structure.

title: Assembly process error modeling method based on physical information neural network
abstract: The invention designs an assembly process error modeling method based on a physical information neural network, which realizes the rapid and accurate calculation of the stress deformation of an assembly joint surface in the assembly process of parts. In the assembly process of parts, the force in the assembly process is an important factor affecting the assembly accuracy. In order to rapidly and accurately predict the stress deformation amount in the assembly process of the parts and improve the assembly precision, the patent constructs a prediction model of the stress deformation of the assembly joint surface of the parts based on a physical information neural network. Based on the fully connected neural network structure, boundary conditions are embedded as loss terms to participate in training. By minimizing the loss function, the model learns the rule of the stress deformation of the assembly joint surface, and the mapping relation between physical quantities such as point coordinates, point displacement and the like is obtained, so that the rapid prediction of the stress deformation of the assembly joint surface is realized.

title: Coal-fired furnace hearth semi-physical simulation system based on RT-LAB
abstract: The present invention discloses a semi physical simulation system for coal-fired furnace based on RT-LAB, which relates to the field of coal-fired furnace simulation technology. A high-precision, adaptable, and predictive coal-fired boiler furnace simulation system is developed. Through real-time simulation and testing, the adverse effects that may occur when the induced draft fan works abnormally on the operation of the boiler furnace are studied, which solves the problem of inaccurate simulation of major abnormal accident conditions in coal-fired boilers and provides a platform support and theoretical basis for information security protection of DCS control systems.

title: Ship control surface load simulation system
abstract: The invention discloses a ship control surface load simulation system, and belongs to the field of electrohydraulic servo control and semi-physical simulation. Comprises a steering engine system and a load simulation system. The problem that the active motion of a steering engine system seriously affects the loading performance of a load simulator in the loading process of the existing electrohydraulic load simulator is solved, namely the problem of redundant force. The invention adopts hydraulic loading to simulate the seawater hydrodynamic force borne by the control surface of the ship, the loading force is not influenced by the redundant force, and the control strategy does not need to consider the problem of the redundant force compensation, so that the complexity of the control strategy is reduced, and the method is simple and reliable. The invention solves the problem of low loading precision caused by redundant force in the electrohydraulic load simulator, and has scientific and reasonable structure.

title: Method for pipeline corrosion prediction and maintenance
abstract: A computer-implemented method for predicting corrosion of a pipeline comprises the steps of: generating, using a physical simulation model, a physical flow profile of the pipeline based on at least a part of an inspection profile of the pipeline; predicting, using a machine learning model, a future corrosion profile of the pipeline including at least one future corrosion feature based on at least a part of the inspection profile of the pipeline and the physical flow profile of the pipeline; wherein the inspection profile includes operating data of the pipeline comprising inspection data from at least one physical inspection of the pipeline. In addition, a corresponding training method, model, computer program as well as data processing devices are disclosed.

title: Pikan-based seepage simulation method for heterogeneous reservoirs
abstract: The present disclosure provides a PIKAN-based heterogeneous reservoir seepage simulation method, which belongs to the field of heterogeneous reservoir development technology, including the following steps: S 1 , using three independent KAN networks to approximate the PIKAN of pressure p, velocity component v x  and velocity component v y  respectively; S 2 , constructing a loss function of the mixed pressure-velocity formula including the residual of the mass conservation formula, the residual of Darcy's law and the residual of the relevant boundary conditions, and optimizing the loss function. The present disclosure adopts the above-mentioned PIKAN-based heterogeneous reservoir seepage simulation method, introduces KAN into the flow simulation of porous media for the first time, and provides a preliminary reference for the development of general seepage simulation tools based on PIKAN.

title: Generation of new artificial intelilgence modles for edge case driving scenarios
abstract: A method of generating artificial intelligence (AI) models for driving related scenarios, the method includes (a) generating, by using driving related data, a database of driving scenarios, the generating involves clustering the driving related data in accordance with the driving scenarios; and holding, in the database, the clustered data in association with corresponding driving scenarios; (b) creating, by using the clustered data, a dictionary of concept signatures; and (c) training, by using the database of driving scenarios, a set of AI models, the training of each AI model is based on the clustered data stored in the database in accordance with a specified driving scenario, to provide a decision making with respect to the specified driving scenario.

title: Method for co-designing modeling and monitoring systems
abstract: A method for improving a system model includes selecting a continuous-time model that includes numerically constant model parameters and time-varying variables; selecting an objective function; selecting from the model parameters a set of model parameters whose numerically constant values are to be estimated; selecting a data acquisition system to supply data for model operation and for estimation of the numerically constant values of the set of model parameters. The data acquisition system includes sensors operable to collect data associated with at least one model parameter of the set. The method further includes assigning temporary values as the numerically constant values of the set of model parameters; generating, via a processor, synthetic data from the model using the temporary values; determining, via the processor, an unidentifiable model parameter of the set presenting an identifiability issue; and displaying, via a user interface in communication with the processor, the unidentifiable model parameter.

title: Composite analysis method for evolution of microwave load radiation characteristics of domestic satellite
abstract: The invention discloses a composite analysis method for the evolution of the microwave load radiation characteristics of a domestic satellite, which comprises the steps of re-analyzing domestic satellite microwave load historical data by referring to a radiation reference, diagnosing and classifying deviation steady-state events, adopting a load semi-physical simulation technology to explore a radiation deviation mechanism by combining physical tests of a loader/component level with simulation analysis of a loading system level, further updating a domestic satellite microwave load radiometric calibration system model, reconstructing domestic satellite microwave load radiometric calibration system parameters by changing iteration between a satellite load observation radiation field and a reference radiation field, re-calibrating the domestic satellite microwave load historical data based on the updated domestic satellite microwave load radiometric calibration system model and parameters, extracting time-varying information according to the radiation reference, and establishing a microwave load system radiation drift correction model.

title: System and method for accelerating physical simulation models during microelectronic device fabrication
abstract: A method for accelerating physical simulation models during microelectronic device fabrication may include, but is not limited to, running a physical simulation model at a first grid size having a first resolution, generating outputs at the first grid size having the first resolution from the physical simulation model, inputting the outputs at the first grid size having the first resolution from the physical simulation model into a resolution enhancement model (REM), and generating outputs at a second grid size having a second resolution via the REM to reduce at least one of a computational time cost or a computational resource cost of a controller running the physical simulation model. The physical simulation model may simulate an on-wafer performance of at least one microelectronics fabrication process. The second grid size may be smaller than the first grid size. The second resolution may be higher than the first resolution.

title: Method, apparatus, electronic device, and storage medium for outputting information
abstract: The disclosure relates to a method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium for outputting information, and relates to the technical field of structural engineering. The method comprises the steps of obtaining relevant parameters of a rectangular plate, wherein the relevant parameters comprise size parameters, elastic mechanical parameters and load calculation parameters, determining initial sedimentation of each corner point of the rectangular plate, determining a first coefficient and a second coefficient corresponding to each side according to boundary conditions of each side of the rectangular plate and a preset equation set corresponding to each side, determining structural parameters of the rectangular plate according to the relevant parameters, the initial sedimentation and the first coefficient and the second coefficient corresponding to each side, and outputting the structural parameters. By the method and the device, the structural parameters of the rectangular plate under any supporting condition can be calculated, and the accuracy of calculating the structural parameters is improved.

title: Multi-umbrella-wing unmanned aerial vehicle semi-physical simulation system
abstract: The invention discloses a multi-parachute unmanned aerial vehicle semi-physical simulation system which comprises an upper computer and a plurality of parachute unmanned aerial vehicle controllers, wherein the upper computer is connected with each parachute unmanned aerial vehicle controller, the upper computer comprises a flight path planning module, an unmanned aerial vehicle state acquisition module and a first communication module, the flight path planning module is used for carrying out flight path planning on a formation formed by the multi-parachute unmanned aerial vehicles and outputting expected flight paths of each parachute unmanned aerial vehicle, the unmanned aerial vehicle state acquisition module is used for calculating an updating value of an unmanned aerial vehicle state according to a control quantity output by the parachute unmanned aerial vehicle controllers and an unmanned aerial vehicle dynamic model, the first communication module is used for sending the expected flight paths and the updating value of the unmanned aerial vehicle state to the corresponding parachute unmanned aerial vehicle controllers, and the parachute unmanned aerial vehicle controllers are used for calculating the control quantity according to the expected flight paths and the unmanned aerial vehicle state. By utilizing the system, the multi-parachute unmanned aerial vehicle collaborative air drop system can be calibrated, and the functions and performances of all equipment of the system can be more directly and effectively checked.

title: Digital twin body construction method for wound tube type heat exchanger based on computational fluid dynamics
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of digital twinning, in particular to a method for constructing a digital twinning body of a winding tube type heat exchanger based on computational fluid dynamics, which comprises the following steps of collecting physical parameters of the winding tube type heat exchanger and establishing a tube unit scale characteristic unit model according to the physical parameters; the method comprises the steps of obtaining scale feature quantity data of a pipe unit scale feature unit model, forming a feature unit database, establishing a coarse-grained three-dimensional digital twin body model, setting initial conditions and boundary conditions, training the feature unit database to obtain a momentum source item and an energy source item training model of an output feature unit database, and obtaining flow field variable values of flow and heat transfer flow field and temperature field distribution by simulating the coarse-grained three-dimensional digital twin body model.

title: Excavator structure topology optimization method and system based on real-time stress field reconstruction
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of engineering machinery structure optimization, in particular to an excavator structure topology optimization method based on real-time stress field reconstruction and a system thereof, which are characterized in that deformation and stress data of key parts of an excavator movable arm are obtained through a distributed fiber bragg grating sensor array, virtual data are obtained through modeling and simulation in finite element analysis software, a Kalman filter is designed to correct errors of the virtual data and actual test data, and training a Kalman filter by using the corrected data to obtain prediction of real-time stress field distribution, further establishing a topological optimization model of the excavator structure, coding material properties into a weight matrix in a neural network, taking a stress constraint partial differential equation as a constraint condition, realizing high-precision reconstruction of the stress field of the excavator movable arm under the actual working condition, and providing accurate boundary conditions for topological optimization.

title: Semi-physical simulation test method for injection type inertial measurement unit
abstract: The invention relates to a semi-physical simulation test method of an injection type inertial measurement unit, and belongs to the field of simulation tests. The method adopts a signal injection method to skip the gyroscope component and the accelerometer component of the inertial measurement device, and directly injects the angular acceleration signals in three directions of pitching, yawing and rolling of the carrier and the acceleration signals in three directions of x direction, y direction and z direction calculated by a simulation computer into the inertial measurement device through a simulation information interface to excite the inertial measurement device to carry out navigation calculation so as to obtain the attitude angle information and the position information of the carrier, thereby solving the problem that the traditional semi-physical simulation test method of the inertial measurement device is seriously dependent on a turntable side to carry out a test.

title: Self-adaptive positioning complex structural member surface laser shock reinforcement numerical simulation method
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of metal processing, and particularly relates to a self-adaptive positioning complex structural member surface laser shock reinforcement numerical simulation method which comprises the following steps of (1) establishing a structural model of a part, (2) carrying out grid cloth planting on the structural model of the part, (3) self-defining parameters of VDLOAD subroutines to generate arrayed laser loading positions and shock pressures, (4) establishing a dynamic explicit analysis step and boundary conditions, and calculating by referring to VDLOAD subroutines to obtain a residual compression stress field formed after laser shock on the surface of the part. The method constructs a curved surface self-adaptive judging algorithm based on vertical mapping between a real-time normal vector of a free surface and transient pressure projection in VDLOAD subprograms, ensures that the transient pressure is always accurately aligned with the normal direction of a laser impact curved surface, simultaneously utilizes a full-parameterized space-time array to generate laser loading positions and impact pressures in batches, and realizes simulation of a continuous laser impact strengthening process of the surface of a part with any complex structure.

title: Island type multi-constraint discontinuous interface block region blanking refined arrangement method
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of building construction, and discloses a precise arrangement method for blanking of island-type multi-constraint discontinuous interface building block areas, which mainly comprises the steps of acquiring data of wall structures and components; the method comprises the steps of distinguishing parameterization and self-adaptation data of a structure, utilizing a computer to program, determining the positions of concrete blocks on a wall structure containing door and window openings and boundary conditions of building block areas, traversing and optimizing blanking combinations with minimum deviation values of the sizes and positions of filling building blocks at the door and window openings, determining blanking positions of the building block areas, loading the created model into a programming platform, and finishing fine arrangement work after automatic layout of components of the wall. The invention is based on a visual programming platform, and is used for programming by using a computer language, so as to realize the automatic arrangement of concrete blocks for walls with door and window openings and the standardized and refined arrangement in a building block area. The invention can improve the utilization rate of the masonry material and is beneficial to promoting the sustainable development of the building construction industry.

title: Closed-loop self-adaptive motor turn-to-turn short circuit dynamic evolution simulation system
abstract: The invention discloses a closed-loop self-adaptive motor turn-to-turn short circuit dynamic evolution simulation system, which relates to the technical field of motor fault simulation and comprises a feature extraction module, a fault evolution modeling module, a multi-level parameter dynamic correction module and a simulation strategy optimization module, wherein the feature extraction module is used for calculating and generating a fault excitation index and a winding chaos entropy from acquired motor operation data, the fault evolution modeling module is used for solving a preset fault evolution model based on the fault excitation index and the winding chaos entropy to generate an updated fault resistance, the multi-level parameter dynamic correction module is used for correcting parameters of a simulation model according to the winding chaos entropy, and the simulation strategy optimization module is used for switching among a plurality of preset simulation modes according to the winding chaos entropy. According to the invention, a closed-loop self-adaptive system is constructed, a interdisciplinary theory is fused, dynamic simulation of the turn-to-turn short circuit full life cycle of the motor is realized, and high fidelity, physical interpretability and calculation efficiency are considered through a multi-level correction and self-adaptive strategy.

title: Calculation method for load transformation in local coordinate system
abstract: The present invention relates to a calculation method for load transformation in a local coordinate system. The calculation method for load transformation in a local coordinate system is based on a part simulation model, and comprises the following steps: S1: determining hard point coordinates of a part; S2: establishing a local coordinate system; S3: establishing a local coordinate load calculation formula: F xLocal =a•F xGlobal +b•F yGlobal +c•F zGlobal ; S4: setting boundary conditions; S5: solving coefficients; and S6: performing load transformation in the local coordinate system. The present invention has the following beneficial effects: no part model is required during calculation, and the calculation can be performed solely on the basis of hard point positions, without relying on any specific simulation analysis software, the calculation is simple, the calculation amount is reduced, the calculation capability is strong, and the calculation efficiency is improved, large‑scale and batch mechanical analysis calculation of automobile parts can be performed, the application range is wide, and the practical value is high.

title: Method and numerical three-dimensional model to simulate dam breach for homogeneous and zoned soil dams
abstract: Disclosed are method and a numerical three-dimensional dam breach model that calculate the dam break hydrograph for a homogeneous or zoned soil dam along with the visualized three-dimensional dam-breaching process and removed soil graph, wherein the failure mode can be overtopping failure, wind-generated wave overtopping failure, piping failure, or static liquefaction failure; wherein the dam can be breached at one location or multiple locations; and wherein elevations of the dam's crests and bottoms and soil properties at all stations along the dam's centerline are modeled. The topographic information surrounding the dam is pulled out from USGS DEM as a domain of the outer two-dimensional Shallow Water Equations grids that controls the hydraulic boundary conditions. Clear water scouring to different soils with different construction compaction efforts are calculated using corresponding erosion formulae. Force/moment equilibrium of soil blocks is analyzed, and instable soil blocks are removed.

title: Groove wave numerical simulation method of viscoelastic VTI medium based on WRK-SSGFD
abstract: The invention discloses a method for simulating a slot wave value of a viscoelastic VTI medium based on WRK-SSGFD, which comprises the steps of firstly establishing a first-order speed-stress equation of the viscoelastic VTI medium, carrying out space domain high-order staggered grid finite difference discretization by using the equation to obtain a semi-discrete differential equation, converting the semi-discrete equation into a normal differential equation set, solving an optimal weight coefficient by minimizing a frequency dispersion error objective function, finally setting geologic model parameters, boundary conditions and observing system parameters, carrying out time propulsion by adopting a fourth-order weighted Longku tower method, calculating wave field values at all moments in sequence until all time steps are completed, and obtaining corresponding simulated seismic records. According to the method, the optimal weight coefficient is determined according to the specific dispersion condition, and then the optimal weight is integrated into a fourth-order weighted Longku tower method for simulation calculation.

title: Cross-scale large-scale electromagnetic surface grid generation method with periodic fine features

title: Digital twin simulation platform for multi-material color mixing process
abstract: The application relates to the field of digital twin simulation, and particularly discloses a multi-material color mixing process digital twin simulation platform which is used for converting a geometric model, material properties and rated process parameters into basic physical simulation data by constructing the multi-material color mixing process digital twin simulation platform and acquiring real-time process parameters by means of an internet of things (IoT) interface to determine parameter drift vectors. Meanwhile, the parameter drift characteristic and the color distribution characteristic are processed by using a lightweight machine learning model, and a color difference correction chart is generated to dynamically correct the color prediction result. By the method, the color deviation caused by parameter drift can be dynamically corrected, and the accurate simulation of the dynamic evolution of the multi-material color mixing process is realized, so that the efficiency of color mixing process design and optimization is improved, the time and material cost are reduced, and the quick switching requirement of a multi-variety small-batch production scene is met.

title: Combined estimation method for radial and axial thermal conductivity of cylindrical battery
abstract: The invention provides a combined estimation method of radial and axial thermal conductivity of a cylindrical battery, which aims to synchronously and highly accurately estimate the radial and axial thermal conductivity of the battery by combining transient thermal simulation and optimization algorithm through forming a temperature gradient by self charge-discharge heat generation and forced cooling of the battery. The method comprises the specific steps of discharging a battery under a natural cooling condition, placing the battery on the constant current, calculating a natural cooling heat transfer coefficient, applying forced cooling to one end of the battery, conducting constant current charging, collecting terminal voltage, temperature and environment data, establishing a transient thermal simulation model of the charging process, inputting the transient thermal simulation model into the battery, changing the thermal power and boundary conditions, traversing the thermal conductivity combination for simulation, and determining an optimal thermal conductivity estimated value by taking the square sum of the minimized temperature error as an optimization target. According to the invention, an external heating device is not needed, the operation is safe and convenient, the thermal conductivity decoupling identification capacity is enhanced through the difference of the axial temperature gradients, and the nondestructive detection with low cost and high precision is realized.

title: Multi-objective optimization method for cooling space power magnetic device structure based on phase change material
abstract: A multi-objective optimization method for cooling a space power magnetic device structure based on a phase change material relates to the technical field of space power magnetic device cooling. The method comprises the steps of designing a magnetic device cooling structure, sealing and wrapping phase change materials on the surface of a magnetic core of the magnetic device through a packaging shell, building a model according to COMSOL Multiphysics, setting the assignment range of thickness variables of the phase change materials to obtain the magnetic device cooling structure with different sizes, performing steady-state parameterization scanning, calculating effective cooling capacity per unit volume and effective cooling capacity per unit mass of a winding and the magnetic core, calculating unit cooling cost of the winding and the magnetic core, and obtaining the thickness value of the optimal phase change material by averaging according to an Origin fitting curve. The space power magnetic device is cooled based on the high latent heat property of the phase change material, and the multi-objective optimization including the volume, the mass, the material cost and the carrying cost is comprehensively considered, so that a better cooling effect is obtained.

title: Real-time estimation method and system for internal temperature field of cylindrical lithium battery
abstract: The invention discloses a real-time estimation method and a system for an internal temperature field of a cylindrical lithium battery, which are characterized in that a temperature space distribution model is established based on a heat conduction equation, the space-time quantity is normalized through scaling transformation, and a non-homogeneous boundary condition is converted into homogeneous condition through variable substitution; the space-time relationship between the temperature distribution quantity and the heat production quantity item is decoupled by adopting a double decomposition technology, the heat production quantity time variable is taken as a virtual source, and a limited dimension Chang Weifen equation model is established by utilizing the Galerkin method. The method comprises the steps of designing an adaptive observer, combining an adaptive learning algorithm to estimate low-order state variables and virtual source time sequences on line so as to measure and estimate a temperature error driving update rate, and reconstructing temperature distribution quantity and virtual source estimated values through space-time synthesis of the estimated sequences and a preset space basis function. Only temperature measurement data is needed, voltage and current sensors are not needed, and real-time estimation of the internal temperature field and the heat generation capacity of the cylindrical lithium battery can be effectively realized by means of a small amount of thermocouples.

title: Wind field correction method based on multi-stage hybrid physical-data driving
abstract: The invention discloses a wind field correction method based on multi-stage hybrid physical-data driving, and relates to the technical field of wind field data processing and climate mode application. The method comprises the steps of performing dynamic downscaling simulation by using a regional climate simulation tool to obtain a multi-dimensional candidate variable field, screening target candidate climate variables according to ERA5 wind speed data to form a multi-dimensional key variable field, constructing a model to be trained comprising a multi-dimensional space feature extraction module, a time dynamic feature extraction module, multi-dimensional space-time feature fusion and an output module, training by using the multi-dimensional key variable field to obtain a hierarchical multi-dimensional space-time fusion network for correcting wind field data, and generating a high-resolution wind field correction field by using a complex topography micro-scale flow field fine-correction solver by using the wind field correction field as a boundary condition. title: Fusion of physics and AI based models for end-to-end data synthesization and validation
abstract: In sensor data analytics, physics-based models generate high quality data. However, these models consume lot of time as they rely on physical simulations. On the other hand, generative learning takes much less time to generate data, and may be prone to error. Present disclosure provides system and method for generation of synthetic machine data for healthy and abnormal condition using hybrid of physics based and generative model-based approach. Finite Element Analysis (FEA) is used for simulating healthy and faulty parts in machinery with set of parameters and pre-condition(s). Small output data from FEA is fed into a generative model for generating synthesized data by learning data distribution knowledge and representing into latent space. Rule engine is built using statistical features wherein realistic bounds serve as faulty data indicators. Synthesized data which does not satisfies features bounds are discarded. Further, AI-based validation framework is used to analyze quality of synthesized data.

title: Analysis method for dynamic response index of concrete arch dam structure affected by earthquake
abstract: The invention discloses a dynamic response index analysis method of a concrete arch dam structure affected by an earthquake, which comprises the steps of collecting various displacement response indexes and stress response indexes of the concrete arch dam in each unit time and damage indexes of the working state of the concrete arch dam in each unit time by various data collecting sensors, storing collected data and sending the data to an engineer data centralized control center, carrying out normalization processing on the data, mapping the data with different physical dimensions to the same numerical range, dividing the arch dam into different nodes according to the structural characteristics of the concrete arch dam, constructing a node characteristic matrix, and generating a to-be-maintained repair instruction of the concrete arch dam if the various displacement response indexes and the stress response indexes are not in preset safety limiting boundary conditions and feeding back the to a safety analysis model interface of the concrete arch dam structure by a multi-mode data centralized control server. title: Electromagnetic pulse transmission simulation method and system based on scattering matrix and crossing ionosphere
abstract: The invention provides an electromagnetic pulse transmission simulation method and system based on a scattering matrix, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a source area waveform signal, carrying out Fourier transform on the source area waveform signal to obtain the amplitude and the phase of different frequency components of the source area signal, uniformly layering the ionized layer to obtain the electron density, the electron collision frequency and the total electron content of a path along which the ionized layer is layered, writing the scattering matrix by boundary conditions, combining the scattering matrices among all adjacent layers after the uniform layering of the ionized layer to construct a global matrix, calculating a total transmission coefficient, calculating the amplitude attenuation and the phase change of a single-frequency signal when the ionized layer is transmitted according to the total transmission coefficient, carrying out Fourier inverse transform according to the amplitude attenuation and the phase change to obtain a time domain signal after the ionized layer is passed, updating the source area waveform signal, and comprehensively and accurately describing the scattering characteristics of electromagnetic waves in a complex environment by a final simulation result.

title: Electromagnetic-heat flow coupling simulation method, device, medium and program product for superconducting power equipment based on iterative algorithm
abstract: The invention relates to an electromagnetic-heat flow coupling simulation method, equipment, medium and program product of superconducting power equipment based on an iterative algorithm, wherein the simulation method comprises the following steps of constructing a simplified basic model of the superconducting power equipment; the method comprises the steps of calculating steady-state alternating-current loss distribution of a coil, simulating and calculating temperature distribution of a superconducting coil and cooling liquid, feeding back the obtained temperature distribution of the superconducting coil and cooling liquid to an electromagnetic simulation process, calculating alternating-current loss as an input temperature boundary condition, feeding back the alternating-current loss to the heat flow simulation process, calculating the temperature distribution, forming an iteration loop, determining total alternating-current loss of superconducting equipment according to the alternating-current loss distribution in the iteration, and calculating the change rate based on the total alternating-current loss. Compared with the prior art, the invention can comprehensively consider the mutual influence of the electromagnetic field and the thermal field on the premise of not obviously increasing the simulation complexity, and can obtain the alternating current loss and the temperature of the superconducting power equipment more accurately.

title: Method for evaluating capacitance value and predicting residual life based on charging time
abstract: The invention relates to a capacitor life prediction method, in particular to a capacitor capacity value assessment and residual life prediction method based on charging time. According to the method, parameters of corresponding time from 100% to 70% of capacity fading to 800V of fading charge are established through semi-physical simulation, charging time data under each capacity is obtained, and therefore a capacitive state identification SVM model and a capacitive fading state model which accord with product characteristic deviation and fading trend are established. The decay of the capacitor is a long-term process, the time of charging the capacitor to 800V is monitored in real time, data of 1 time/second are transmitted to the ground operation and maintenance platform through a network, the charging time value of the newly loaded capacitor is collected and tidied, the charging time value with the highest occurrence frequency and the charging time value with the highest occurrence frequency are selected as the original value to carry out model training again, the charging time charged to the appointed voltage is monitored regularly, the current capacitance value of the capacitor is estimated, and the service life is predicted.

abstract: The invention provides a physical simulation-based industrial visual countermeasure sample defense method, a physical simulation-based industrial visual countermeasure sample defense system, an electronic device and a physical simulation-based storage medium, which belong to the technical field of general image data processing or generation, and comprise the steps of acquiring original image data, and generating a physical simulation image through a physical simulation engine based on visual information of the material surface in the original image data; the method comprises the steps of generating a countermeasure network generator through two channels according to a physical simulation image, generating a countermeasure sample iteratively through the two channels, generating a countermeasure network discriminator through two channels based on a normal sample set and a countermeasure sample set, performing countermeasure training through the two channels, calculating a discriminator loss, calculating a generator loss based on the physical simulation image according to the discriminator loss, generating the countermeasure sample iteratively until a generator loss difference value is smaller than a preset value, and outputting a target countermeasure sample to realize defense on the industrial visual countermeasure sample. title: Overall hydraulic performance prediction method for sink-type dishwasher
abstract: Method for predicting the overall hydraulic performance of a sink-type dishwasher. Process begins with unsteady numerical computation on a dishwasher pump under static conditions to obtain a characteristic pump curve. Using this curve, rotation velocity adaptation coefficient (A d ) and axial velocity coefficient (B d ) are determined. Mapping relationship is established between composite superposition virtual impeller and composite impeller. Passive rotation velocity of the volute and the nozzle flow rate are calculated using GMO model and virtual impeller. A jet mass source is established, using the nozzle flow rate and the volute's passive rotation velocity as boundary conditions. This leads to a non-submerged rotating jet flow computation with a multi-nozzle setup using the VOF method. This approach streamlines the dishwasher's intricate multi-physics, conserves computing resources, and effectively resolves issues related to free surface divergence and estimating the volute's passive rotation speed, leading to an accurate prediction of the dishwasher's overall hydraulic performance.

title: Power system multi-resource collaborative planning method and system based on attribution analysis
abstract: The invention relates to a multi-resource collaborative planning method for an electric power system based on attribution analysis, and belongs to the technical field of electric power system planning. The method comprises the steps of constructing an objective function based on the load requirement of a power system and the output of each unit, taking the lowest supply-demand mismatch degree as a target, constructing a planning model based on set constraint and objective function, respectively solving the planning model based on multiple groups of boundary condition values of the planning model to obtain corresponding planning schemes, analyzing to obtain quantitative representations of influence degrees of each boundary condition and each constraint on the planning schemes, respectively adjusting the corresponding boundary condition values based on the quantitative representations, respectively solving the planning models, and selecting the planning scheme with the lowest planning cost in the solving result as an optimal planning scheme. According to the invention, the key factors influencing the planning scheme are determined by carrying out attribution analysis on the power planning, and the optimal planning scheme is determined by adjusting the key factors, so that the scientificity and the economical efficiency of the planning scheme are further improved.

title: Intelligent early warning method, device and storage medium for basic flushing of offshore wind turbine
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent early warning method, device and storage medium for basic scouring of an offshore wind turbine, and belongs to the technical field of structural safety early warning; the method comprises the steps of performing basic flushing simulation, collecting time domain data of pile top displacement and pile body node stress, establishing a plurality of proxy models, dividing the time domain data into a training set and a verification set to obtain training and verification results, optimizing an optimal proxy model by using two verification indexes of verification errors and a reserved error, obtaining fan foundation response by taking different flushing conditions as input parameters, comparing the fan foundation response with a set safety early warning threshold, and performing safety warning if the fan foundation response reaches or exceeds the safety early warning threshold. abstract: The application discloses a model training method, a model training device and a readable storage medium, which relate to the technical field of computers and are used for improving the energy consumption optimizing effect of refrigeration equipment. title: Rapid calculation method for broadband sound field of shallow sea complex fluctuation boundary
abstract: The application belongs to the technical field of marine acoustics, and provides a rapid calculation method of a shallow sea complex fluctuation boundary broadband sound field, which comprises the steps of establishing an equivalent source model, extracting a plurality of discrete frequency points from a target frequency band to generate a discrete frequency point combination, sequentially extracting the discrete frequency points from the discrete frequency point combination as first discrete frequency points, and solving the first discrete frequency points The method comprises the steps of determining source intensity of each virtual sound source of an equivalent source model at each first discrete frequency point by a dimensional matrix equation until a trend of the source intensity of each virtual sound source changing along with the first discrete frequency points meets a frequency domain continuation condition of the source intensity, determining the source intensity of each virtual sound source at each second discrete frequency point based on the frequency domain continuation of the source intensity, and calculating a broadband sound field of a target shallow sea area based on the source intensity of each virtual sound source at each discrete frequency point in a discrete frequency point combination. The rapid calculation method provided by the application can remarkably reduce the calculated amount of calculating the shallow sea broadband sound field by using the equivalent source model under the complex fluctuation boundary condition.

title: Wind field data modeling method and system for wind resistance test of small and medium-sized unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract: The invention discloses a wind field data modeling method and system for a wind resistance test of a medium-sized and small-sized unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprise the steps of collecting topographic data, wind speed data and wind turbine data of the test wind field, determining a preset area and an unmeasured area according to a preset track of the unmanned aerial vehicle based on the test wind field, obtaining boundary conditions and disturbance grid wake of the unmeasured area through fluid simulation based on the topographic data and the preset area, carrying out wind speed vector decomposition on grids according to the preset wind field boundary conditions, obtaining a preset wind field model according to disturbance time sequences, maneuvering weights of the unmanned aerial vehicle and disturbance grid wake, obtaining a predicted wind field of the unmeasured area through Gaussian process regression based on the preset wind field model, and obtaining a target wind field model through grid time sequence coupling by using different preset tracks of the unmanned aerial vehicle. According to the method, through space-time collaborative interpolation and fluid simulation of Gaussian process regression, the inlet boundary condition is more in accordance with the fluid mechanics rule, and the physical consistency and reliability of a target wind field are improved.

title: Computer-implemented method and system for planning the behavior of an at least partially automated ego vehicle
abstract: A computer-implemented method for planning the behavior of an at least partially automated EGO vehicle. The method uses a data basis of predefined partial situations and an evaluation model for each of these partial situations as well as a predefined set of rules for assessing possible behaviors of the EGO vehicle in a given situation. The method includes decomposing the given situation into a set of partial situations of the data basis and determining boundary conditions for the behavior of the EGO vehicle on the basis of the evaluation models of the identified partial situations. In doing so, a specified specialization hierarchy for the partial situations of the data basis is used.

title: Building performance analysis (BPA) machine: machine learning to accelerate building energy analysis
abstract: A method and system generate a building operational performance analysis output. A synthetic data set is generated and includes a set of 3D building conceptual mass geometries. The generating includes identifying geometry types, dividing the geometry types into categories, and algorithmically generating the mass geometries using a separate workflow for each category using generative design. Analytical models associated with each of the mass geometries are generated. Simulation results are generated for each of the analytical models. A surrogate model is trained based on a set of features extracted from the simulation results using machine learning (ML). The ML iteratively determines the set of features based on a measured accuracy of the surrogate model. Geometry input is received and processed through the surrogate model to generate the building operational performance analysis output which is then used to inform a designer of an approximate Energy Use Intensity of the geometry input.

title: Auto-calibration for personalized self-driving experience
abstract: An apparatus comprising an interface and a processor. The analysis of the intervention events may comprise the video-to-text analysis of the video frames to generate a text description of the environment. An AI model may generate the edge case parameters in response to the text description.

abstract: The invention provides an intelligent cooperative master control system for physical simulation of ultra-large deep engineering disasters, and relates to the technical field of physical simulation of deep engineering disasters. The system comprises a cross-protocol transparent high-efficiency communication architecture responsible for communication and data transmission among all the constituent systems of the physical simulation facility, a test big data storage and fusion analysis module used for multi-source heterogeneous test big data storage and fusion analysis, a multi-task joint planning module used for making and planning a physical simulation test task plan, an intelligent dynamic cooperative control module used for constructing a cooperative control model and carrying out real-time dynamic cooperative control on a physical simulation test field process, a cooperative control model autonomous optimization module used for realizing continuous optimization of the cooperative control model, and a multi-task intelligent execution fault-tolerant module and a multi-task integrated display module used for providing intelligent fault tolerance and integrated display functions. title: Method for designing composite foundation of reconstruction and extension pile foundation based on new foundation and old foundation rigidity cooperation
abstract: The invention discloses a new and old foundation rigidity synergy-based reconstruction pile foundation composite foundation design method, which comprises the steps of dividing a joint of a new foundation and an old foundation into a plurality of areas according to rigidity differences, respectively establishing a power control equation of each area cushion layer, respectively setting boundary conditions and continuity conditions of each area cushion layer, solving power response complete solutions of each area cushion layer, combining the boundary conditions and continuity conditions with the cushion layer power response complete solutions to obtain undetermined coefficients in the complete solutions, substituting the determined undetermined coefficients to complete solution expressions, and further quantifying influences brought by the new and old foundation rigidity differences through displacement and internal force expressions, thereby guiding the reconstruction pile foundation composite foundation design. According to the invention, the rigidity difference is used as a core factor to be introduced into a dynamic model, a dynamic equation is derived from a vibration elastic sheet theory, the problems of two ends and the joint of a new foundation and an old foundation are fully considered, the key effect of pile-soil coordination rigidity is revealed through partition modeling, the foundation design is guided, and the differential deformation is reduced.

title: Characterization method for shedding degree and migration process of solid particles in carbon dioxide sealing and storing
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of carbon dioxide geological sequestration, and discloses a characterization method of the shedding degree and the migration process of solid particles in carbon dioxide sequestration, which comprises the steps of constructing a shedding-migration model based on the shedding of the solid particles in a stratum solid skeleton and the migration behaviors of the shed solid particles in the carbon dioxide sequestration process; the method comprises the steps of constructing an initial reservoir model of a carbon dioxide sealing target area based on geological conditions and on-site conditions of the carbon dioxide sealing area, setting initial conditions and boundary conditions, and conducting grid division to obtain the initial reservoir grid model, inputting the initial reservoir grid model into a shedding-migration model to obtain shedding amount and shedding rate of solid particles in a stratum solid framework, and representing shedding degree of the solid particles in the stratum solid framework and migration process of the shed solid particles in the carbon dioxide sealing process through the shedding amount and the shedding rate. The method can realize effective analysis and prediction of the falling off and migration processes of the stratum skeleton particles in the injection process.

title: Prediction of steady state heat maps for chip thermal analysis
abstract: A method and apparatus of a device of predicting a heat map for a die model is described. In an exemplary embodiment, the device receives a die model for representing the die and a boundary condition applicable to the die, the die model including dimensions of the die. In addition, the device may include scaling the dimensions of the die model and the boundary condition, wherein the dimensions of the die model are scaled to a target die size, the scaled dimensions including a scaled die thickness. Furthermore, each trained die model including a die surface of the target die size, different trained die models having different die thickness, the plurality of trained die models trained under a plurality of boundary conditions, each trained die model having a plurality of decay curves associated with the plurality of boundary conditions. The method may additionally include determining a relationship between the scaled boundary condition and the plurality of boundary conditions. In addition, the method may include determining a decay curve for the die model according to a combination of decay curves associated with the plurality of boundary conditions for the one or more trained die models using the relationship. Furthermore, the method may include generating the die heat map based on the decay curve determined for the die model.

title: Forging loading mode preferential method from fine grain strengthening angle based on crystal phase field method
abstract: The invention particularly relates to a forging loading mode preferential method from a fine grain strengthening angle based on a crystal phase field method, which solves the problem that the refining evolution process of an original scale crystal grain in the traditional experiment is difficult to characterize. A preferred method for forging loading modes from a fine grain strengthening angle based on a crystal phase field method comprises the following steps of establishing a dual-mode crystal phase field model, determining a numerical method, performing space dispersion on a constructed Cahn-Hillard dynamic equation by adopting a semi-implicit Fourier spectrum method to obtain an atomic density field evolution mode at the next moment, setting initial condition parameters according to each forging loading mode to be compared, performing simulation calculation and result derivation, and performing comparison analysis on crystal evolution processes under different forging loading modes obtained in the step four. The method is used for analyzing the rule of influence of different loading conditions on grain refinement aiming at the growth state of the nano polycrystalline material under different stress loading conditions.

abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent rapid prediction method of hypersonic aerodynamic heat environment based on AI-CFD, which comprises the steps of importing a geometric model file and a cloud image file of a hypersonic blunt body into a CFD numerical simulation software database, constructing a python environment, processing the geometric model file to obtain binarized data, processing the binarized data to obtain directed distance field data, processing the binarized data to obtain flow area channel data, processing the cloud image file to obtain cloud image grid topological structure data, taking the directed distance field, the flow area channel and the cloud image grid topological structure data as input of CNN training, obtaining physical boundary condition parameters under different conditions through investigation, adding the cloud image grid topological structure data as input of RBFNN training, and predicting a flow field, a temperature field, a speed field and a gas phase concentration distribution field by using a model which is completed through training. Compared with the traditional numerical simulation, the method has the advantages that the prediction speed is faster, the method can be used for various prediction scenes, and the degree of freedom is higher.

title: Cross-scale wind power plant wind resource assessment method based on numerical mode
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of wind power generation and discloses a method for evaluating wind resources of a cross-scale wind power plant based on a numerical mode, which comprises the following steps of step 1, acquiring multi-source observation data of a target area; the method comprises the steps of screening a WRF optimal configuration scheme adapting to regional topography, generating annual scale wind resource data serving as initial wind resource data through a WRF dynamic downscaling method, carrying out regional correction on the initial wind resource data to obtain wind measurement data, constructing a WRF-WFP model coupling a WRF mode and a wind farm parameterized model, optimizing WRF lower boundary conditions, simulating atmospheric flow of a target region, quantifying wind farm wake evolution characteristics, constructing a wake analysis model, and formulating collaborative capacity planning of a wind farm group, wherein the WRF-WFP model is constructed. The method can accurately predict the power generation capacity of the wind farm to be developed and provide a reliable basis for scientific decisions of resource distribution development and planning of the million kilowatt wind farm.

title: Lithium ion battery attenuation prediction method and system based on multi-physical field coupling model
abstract: The invention discloses a lithium ion battery attenuation prediction method and system based on a multi-physical field coupling model, which comprises the steps of determining a multi-physical field coupling relation and a model scale, defining each sub-model according to actual simulation requirements and obtaining parameters of the multi-field coupling model, wherein the sub-model is used for simulating mass transfer, electrochemical reaction, temperature rise, thermal expansion, expansion force change and capacity attenuation of a battery, constructing the multi-field coupling model and boundary conditions, defining a coupling mechanism and boundary conditions of the model, comprising electrochemical, thermal conduction and mechanical constraint conditions, determining a numerical solution method based on COMSOL Multiphysics to perform simulation calculation of the electrochemical, thermal, force and aging coupling model, and determining an optimal pre-tightening force value by simulating and analyzing influences of different pre-tightening forces on the expansion force and capacity attenuation of the battery. title: TIR lens and parameter design method thereof
abstract: The invention provides a TIR lens and a parameter design method thereof, the method comprises the steps of constructing an optical system structure of an application scene of the TIR lens, wherein the optical system structure comprises light sources, the TIR lens and an optical chip with microstructures which are annularly arranged, each sub-light source in the light sources is positioned at the center of the round bottom of the corresponding TIR lens, determining a light distribution curve through optical chip parameters and light source parameters, calculating initial parameters of a first free curve and a second free curve in the TIR lens according to the light distribution curve, then establishing a physical simulation model to perform optical tracking simulation, correcting the initial parameters through the simulated light distribution curve obtained by simulation, and then performing optical tracking simulation, and repeating the steps until the size of a light spot and the uniformity of the light spot reach a target. title: Method for establishing prediction model of low cycle fatigue life of exhaust hot end
abstract: The application discloses a method for establishing a prediction model of low cycle fatigue life of an exhaust hot end, which comprises the following steps of setting thermal boundary conditions of different exhaust hot end models according to different powers of an engine, respectively carrying out stress field analysis on the exhaust hot end models according to each boundary condition to obtain a strain form of maximum equivalent plastic strain increment of the exhaust hot end and a temperature form at a corresponding node of the maximum equivalent plastic strain increment, determining an exhaust hot end life checking component according to the maximum equivalent plastic strain increment of the exhaust hot end, respectively carrying out a high-temperature tensile test and a cold-hot impact cycle test on the checking component based on temperature values in the temperature form to obtain a static tensile form and a test life form of materials of the life checking component at corresponding temperatures, and determining the prediction model of the exhaust hot end according to the static tensile form, the test life form and the strain form, thereby predicting the fatigue life of the exhaust hot end and being convenient for reasonably setting overhaul and replacement cycles of the exhaust hot end.

title: Walking slip breaking control effective crack evaluation method based on structural stress field simulation
abstract: The application discloses a sliding break control effective crack evaluation method based on structural stress field simulation, which is a method for determining a target horizon and a break-crack spread characteristic of a research area, defining structural stress field simulation boundary conditions, constructing a reasonable structural model and a mathematical model, developing structural stress field simulation, solving geological and engineering parameters for representing a break-crack system according to simulation results, carrying out weight assignment by using a analytic hierarchy process, comprehensively constructing a break-crack system effectiveness evaluation parameter by multiple parameters, establishing a break-crack system effectiveness evaluation standard by calibrating the break-crack system effectiveness evaluation parameter, and finally precisely determining a space distribution area of an effective crack in the break-crack system. abstract: The invention discloses an electric circuit logic dynamic simulation system based on a DF4D locomotive, which relates to the technical field of locomotive maintenance training, and comprises a circuit schematic diagram simulation module, a gas circuit schematic diagram simulation module, a data interaction module, a fault injection module and an intelligent diagnosis module, wherein the circuit schematic diagram simulation module is used for constructing an interaction interface matched with a DF4D locomotive electric circuit schematic diagram 1:1 by adopting a vector graphic technology and responding to external operation signals in real time by dynamically identifying the power-on and power-off states of circuit elements through colors. The invention realizes the transition of maintenance training from subjective evaluation to quantitative evaluation. By recording fault positioning time, operation steps and parameter judgment results of a student in real time and combining with a standard flow library, accurate comparison is performed, objective scores are generated from three dimensions of positioning accuracy, step integrity and parameter precision, the student is helped to determine own weak links, and powerful support is provided for train engineering section culture high quality DF4D locomotive maintenance talents.

title: Intelligent compressed air system energy efficiency assessment method based on environment compensation
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent assessment method for energy efficiency of a compressed air system based on environmental compensation. The method comprises the steps of firstly collecting operation performance parameters, air quality parameters and environment parameters, establishing thermophysical mapping by utilizing an enthalpy-humidity diagram, forming a quality coupling characteristic data set, and simultaneously constructing a theoretical energy efficiency reference plane and a thermodynamic constraint set based on an isentropic compression principle and a historical optimal sample. Then, a nonlinear machine learning model is trained to learn a nonlinear mapping relationship between the environmental parameter variation and the performance and quality offsets. The model converts the operating parameters in a real-time non-standard environment to equivalent operating performance parameters for standard environmental conditions. And during evaluation, mapping the equivalent operation parameters to a theoretical energy efficiency reference plane, and calculating a distance vector to obtain an evaluation result reflecting the degree of deviation of the energy efficiency and the degree of performance decline of the system. The method effectively eliminates environmental interference and remarkably improves the accuracy and comparability of the energy efficiency evaluation of the compressed air system.
