title: Profile drifting buoy state monitoring method
abstract: The invention relates to a profile drifting buoy state monitoring method, which belongs to the technical field of state monitoring and comprises the steps of constructing a digital twin model of a profile drifting buoy, updating parameters of the digital twin model according to a preset fault type to obtain fault simulation data, dividing the fault simulation data according to a preset sliding window to extract multidimensional statistical characteristics, inputting the multidimensional statistical characteristics into a multi-layer perceptron to calculate to obtain characteristic scores, converting the characteristic scores into probability values through a discrete distribution sampling layer, screening the probability values according to a preset threshold value through binarization coding to obtain screened characteristic vectors, inputting the screened characteristic vectors into a gradient elevator to perform state monitoring to obtain a state monitoring result, performing self-adaptive characteristic screening by using the multi-layer perceptron to avoid limitation of manually selected characteristics, and realizing state monitoring through the gradient elevator.
relevance_reason: ブイ状態監視のデジタルツイン。プリセット故障タイプに応じ故障シミュレーションデータを生成(海洋分野)

title: Multi-view image acquisition fault automatic identification method for rail transit overhaul
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of data processing, in particular to an automatic recognition method for multi-view image acquisition faults for rail transit maintenance, which comprises the steps of acquiring data and processing the data to generate fusion data, processing the fusion data to generate a virtual synchronous frame sequence, inputting the aligned multi-view image sequence into a meta-learning feature extraction network coupled with physical priori to perform feature fusion and time sequence modeling to generate fault feature representation, constructing a digital twin model to generate a fault simulation sequence with labels, comparing and outputting fault pattern recognition results through dynamic time warping, adopting evidence theory to fuse the fault recognition results, similarity scores and sensor time sequence data to calculate a confidence interval, and dynamically adjusting image acquisition parameters through reinforcement learning according to the confidence interval to complete system self-optimization. The invention solves the technical problem that the time synchronization error of multi-view image acquisition causes the confusion of characteristic time sequences in the deep learning model, and reduces the false alarm rate of fault dynamic identification.
relevance_reason: 鉄道車両故障識別。デジタルツインでラベル付き故障シミュレーションシーケンスを生成し訓練に利用。目的に合致

title: Method for estimating natural frequency of laminated building collapse wall under different boundary conditions
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of machinery, in particular to a natural frequency estimation method for a laminated building collapse wall under different boundary conditions, which comprises the steps of constructing a simplified model of the building collapse wall and obtaining a vibration differential equation of a building component wall, obtaining a natural frequency expression of the laminated building collapse wall under the four-side simple support condition based on the four-side simple support boundary conditions and the vibration differential equation, building a basic frequency estimation formula of the collapse wall under the four-side simple support condition, obtaining a natural frequency calculation formula of the laminated building collapse wall under the four-side free condition according to the four-side free boundary conditions and the vibration differential equation, building a basic frequency analysis formula of the collapse wall under the four-side free condition, and obtaining natural frequency (basic frequency) estimation results of the laminated building collapse wall under different boundary conditions by combining the angular frequency analysis formula, the basic frequency estimation formula of the collapse wall and the basic frequency analysis formula of the collapse wall. The invention provides technical support for natural frequency estimation of the building collapse member.
relevance_reason: 積層建物崩壊壁の固有振動数推定、境界条件。構造計算手法

title: Self-adaptive positioning complex structural member surface laser shock reinforcement numerical simulation method
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of metal processing, and particularly relates to a self-adaptive positioning complex structural member surface laser shock reinforcement numerical simulation method which comprises the following steps of (1) establishing a structural model of a part, (2) carrying out grid cloth planting on the structural model of the part, (3) self-defining parameters of VDLOAD subroutines to generate arrayed laser loading positions and shock pressures, (4) establishing a dynamic explicit analysis step and boundary conditions, and calculating by referring to VDLOAD subroutines to obtain a residual compression stress field formed after laser shock on the surface of the part. The method constructs a curved surface self-adaptive judging algorithm based on vertical mapping between a real-time normal vector of a free surface and transient pressure projection in VDLOAD subprograms, ensures that the transient pressure is always accurately aligned with the normal direction of a laser impact curved surface, simultaneously utilizes a full-parameterized space-time array to generate laser loading positions and impact pressures in batches, and realizes simulation of a continuous laser impact strengthening process of the surface of a part with any complex structure.
relevance_reason: レーザーショック強化数値シミュレーション(重複、A版)

title: Multi-dimensional simulation method, device, equipment and medium for icing wind tunnel test section flow field
abstract: The application discloses a multi-dimensional simulation method, device, equipment and medium for a flow field of an icing wind tunnel test section, which comprises the steps of S1, establishing a geometric model according to an actual structure of the test section, S2, dividing the geometric model into grids, S3, determining a control equation, selecting a physical model, S4, defining boundary conditions of a calculation domain of the test section, S5, constructing an aeroengine performance proxy model by utilizing aeroengine performance analysis or test data, and coupling the aeroengine performance proxy model with a CFD solver, and S6, transmitting data between the CFD solver and the proxy model in a time-step iteration mode, and performing coupling calculation to realize multi-dimensional simulation. According to the application, by introducing the aeroengine performance proxy model into the icing wind tunnel flow field simulation, a high-precision and high-efficiency numerical simulation method is developed, and further prediction and analysis of simulation results of aeroengine icing weather conditions are realized.
relevance_reason: 着氷風洞多次元シミュレーション、境界条件。航空機着氷という危険事象を扱うが設計予測ツール

title: Building intelligent control method, device, equipment and medium based on group intelligent algorithm
abstract: The application relates to a building intelligent control method, a device, equipment and a medium thereof based on a group intelligent algorithm. The method comprises the steps of constructing a building energy dynamic model based on a building information model and physical parameters of a building, defining a reinforcement learning state space, an action space and rewarding function parameters based on the building energy dynamic model, generating a synthetic training data set by using the model and the parameters, pre-training a reinforcement learning model based on the synthetic training data set and the parameters, and finally generating a building equipment control instruction based on the pre-training reinforcement learning model. By adopting the method, the zero sample intelligent initialization of the building control system can be realized, the low-efficiency random exploration in the cold start stage is avoided, and the control efficiency, the energy utilization rate and the system safety are improved.
relevance_reason: 建物エネルギーモデルから合成訓練データセットを生成しRLモデルを事前学習。物理ベースの合成訓練データ生成

title: Power distribution automation operation and maintenance practical operation training assessment method and device
abstract: The invention discloses a power distribution automation operation and maintenance practical operation training and assessment device which comprises a terminal fault simulation module, a power distribution terminal module, an assessment and scoring module and a assessment and scoring module, wherein the terminal fault simulation module is used for receiving a command driving relay which is suitable for faults and conducting line adjustment to construct a corresponding fault scene, the power distribution terminal module is used for displaying the result of three teleoperation data, generating first operation data through learner operation based on the result of the three teleoperation data, the first operation data at least comprises telemetry data, remote signaling data and remote control data, the simulation module is used for acquiring simulation data of feeder automation logic based on a power distribution network model and acquiring second operation data through learner operation, and the assessment and scoring module is used for issuing to the terminal fault simulation module or the simulation module based on instructions and acquiring assessment reports through quantization scoring based on the first operation data, the second operation data and theoretical data.
relevance_reason: 配電自動化訓練評価。fault simulation moduleで故障シーンを構築(エネルギー分野)

title: Two-dimensional low-frequency shallow sea sound field calculation method based on physical information neural network
abstract: A two-dimensional low-frequency shallow sea sound field calculation method based on a physical information neural network relates to the technical field of marine acoustic calculation and artificial intelligence and comprises the following steps of 1, obtaining sound velocity profile data of a shallow sea area, 2, carrying out data preprocessing on the sound velocity profile data of a time sequence, 3, designing a physical information loss function, 4, constructing a double-network parallel PINN physical information neural network model, 5, calculating a modal function and corresponding horizontal wave number of the shallow sea area by using the trained double-network PINN model, and embedding a calculation result into a coupling frame to calculate a low-frequency shallow sea sound field with sound velocity level change. The invention designs a loss function by utilizing a modal equation in the simple wave, corresponding boundary conditions and the like, enhances the physical interpretability of the neural network, and overcomes the black box problem of deep learning.
relevance_reason: 浅海音場のPINN計算、境界条件。物理+ML音響計算手法

title: Irregular sampling shear layer flow field prediction method and system based on improved depth operator network
abstract: The invention relates to an irregular sampling shear layer flow field prediction method based on improvement DeepONet, which comprises the steps of S1, constructing a data set covering typical flow characteristics of a shear layer through numerical simulation or experimental measurement, S2, designing and executing an uneven sampling strategy aiming at the characteristic of uneven speed change in a shear layer flow field to obtain an uneven sampling flow field data set used for network training, S3, constructing and training a NFNO-DeepONet network architecture by utilizing the uneven sampling flow field data set, constructing a NFNO structure with irregular input processing capability by utilizing NDFT, combining the network with a backbone network to form a NFNO-DeepONet neural network architecture so as to predict and model an irregular sampling shear layer speed field, S4, inputting initial conditions of a flow field to be predicted obtained based on simulation or experiment into the NFNO-DeepONet network after training, and executing a prediction task to obtain a prediction result. The invention realizes effective modeling of non-uniform sampling data, and supports flexible sampling of areas to optimize computing efficiency.
relevance_reason: せん断層流れ場予測DeepONet、初期条件。物理+ML流体予測手法

title: Method for acquiring boundary and initial value condition of one-dimensional unsteady heat transfer model of greenhouse soil
abstract: The application discloses a method for acquiring boundary and initial value conditions of a one-dimensional unsteady heat transfer model of greenhouse soil, which comprises the steps of setting an upper boundary condition by adopting a first type of boundary conditions in heat transfer science; setting the lower boundary condition based on the long-term observation data, and acquiring the initial value condition through an initial value acquisition stage and a calculation simulation stage. The upper boundary is highly matched with the actual soil thermal condition by a combination scheme of actual measurement of a sensor and anti-interference design of thin soil, deviation caused by an empirical formula is avoided, the short-time scale constant temperature characteristic of the soil at the depth of 1.05m is determined based on actual measurement data, the lower boundary is set to be a second type boundary condition with zero heat flux density, meanwhile, the initial value is converged to a true value through a two-stage process, initial value acquisition is only needed to be executed for the first time, and the accuracy and the calculation efficiency are both considered in the follow-up automatic follow-up preamble simulation result.
relevance_reason: 温室土壌熱伝達の境界/初期値条件取得手法。農業モデリング

title: Deformation analysis method for foundation of inclined anchor short pile under elastic theory and deformation coordination condition
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of data processing, in particular to a method for analyzing the foundation deformation of an inclined anchor short pile under the elastic theory and deformation coordination conditions, which comprises the steps of establishing a displacement balance equation according to the displacement deformation coordination conditions of the short pile and an anchor rod, wherein the displacement component of the short pile at the pile-anchor node in the displacement direction of the anchor rod is equal to the displacement quantity of the anchor rod, and the displacement balance equation is established by the displacement deformation coordination principle; the method comprises the steps of simplifying an elastic deformation calculation method of an inclined anchor short pile foundation according to a single-pile elastic deformation analysis method based on a displacement balance equation to obtain a simplified equation, dividing the foundation into three parts based on the simplified equation by considering boundary conditions of the inclined anchor short pile foundation, calculating internal force and displacement of an upper half pile body and internal force and displacement of a lower half pile body to obtain a solving result, completing design calculation of the resistance to pulling limit bearing capacity of the inclined anchor short pile based on the solving result, carrying out basic deformation analysis to obtain an analysis result, and solving the problem of no basic deformation analysis of the inclined anchor short pile.
relevance_reason: 傾斜アンカー短杭基礎変形解析、境界条件。土木設計計算

title: Dynamic testing of technical systems for complete describability, starting from a predetermined operation situation
abstract: A method for testing to what extent the dynamics of a technical system starting from a predetermined operation situation are completely described through the acquisition of the state of the technical system with multiple sensors in combination with at least one differential equation. The method includes establishing a dynamics function describing the predetermined operation situation and dynamics of the technical system; forming the at least one differential equation from the dynamics function; ascertaining initial conditions, boundary conditions and/or regional conditions based on the predetermined operation situation for solving the at least one differential equation; testing whether the differential equation is analytically solvable; and in response to a positive determination, determining that the acquisition with the sensors and the at least one differential equation completely describe the dynamics of the system.
inventor: BAKUCZ PETER | HRUSCHKA MARTIN
relevance_reason: Bosch: 技術システムの動的テスト、初期/境界条件から微分方程式解を検証する枠組み

title: Saturated porous medium super-surface Schottky wave frequency dispersion relation calculation method and system
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of physical acoustics, in particular to a method and a system for calculating the dispersion relation of a saturated porous medium super-surface Schottky wave, wherein the method comprises the following steps of obtaining expressions of solid skeleton displacement, fluid relative displacement, total stress, solid shear stress and pore pressure under the action of the Schottky wave, obtaining expressions of fluid displacement components and fluid normal stress, obtaining expressions of relative motion of a resonator, applying stress and displacement continuity boundary conditions at the interface of the saturated porous medium and a fluid layer according to all the expressions, obtaining a characteristic equation of dispersion characteristics, and solving the characteristic equation to obtain a dispersion curve. According to the invention, by providing the explicit dispersion relation of the saturated porous medium super-surface Schottky wave, the calculation efficiency and the prediction precision of complex interfacial wave propagation are improved, the optimal design of the super-surface resonator array can be guided, and key theoretical tools and technical supports are provided for the design of high-performance acoustic functional devices and structures.
relevance_reason: 多孔質媒体表面波の分散関係計算、境界条件。音響物理計算手法

title: Well testing interpretation parameter inversion method and system based on decoupling physical constraint network
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of oil and gas field exploration and development, and discloses a well testing interpretation parameter inversion method and system based on a decoupling physical constraint network. The method comprises the steps of pre-training and solidifying a physical process proxy network, so that a forward process from physical parameters to pressure response can be quickly and accurately simulated, constructing a parameter prediction network, and training by utilizing a composite loss function formed by data matching loss and physical consistency loss. The physical consistency loss is calculated by inputting PPN predicted parameters into the cured FPN to reconstruct a pressure curve and comparing the pressure curve with an observation curve, and the inversion result is forced to follow a physical rule. According to the invention, through decoupling physical simulation and parameter inversion, the problem of training pathological conditions is fundamentally avoided, and the high-efficiency fusion of data driving and the rigor of a physical model is realized. The method has the remarkable advantages of high precision, high efficiency, strong physical consistency and full automation, and realizes millisecond-level accurate interpretation of complex oil reservoir well test data.
relevance_reason: 坑井試験パラメータ逆解析の物理制約ネットワーク。物理+ML逆解析手法

title: Method for determining effective refractive index of eigenmodes of coupling waveguide system based on FDTD simulation
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of integrated photoelectrons, and particularly relates to a method for determining an effective refractive index of an eigenmode of a coupling waveguide system based on FDTD simulation. The method comprises the following steps of S1, establishing a coupling waveguide system model, constructing a geometric model comprising at least two optical waveguides which are close to each other in FDTD simulation software, defining geometric parameters of materials, cross section dimensions and spacing G between the waveguides, S2, setting simulation parameters, namely setting basic parameters required by working wavelength, grid precision and boundary condition simulation, and S3, iterating and mode selecting, namely respectively determining effective refractive indexes of an even mode and an odd mode according to a set of given geometric parameters. The method of the present invention selectively and independently excites the target eigenmodes for the particular eigenmode to be solved in a coupled system model comprising two or more waveguides and calculates the effective refractive index for the single mode in a steady propagation field.
relevance_reason: 結合導波路FDTDシミュレーション、境界条件。光学計算手法

title: Electrical control cabinet machining quality detection system based on digital twinning
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent manufacturing and digital twinning of electrical equipment, in particular to a processing quality detection system of an electrical control cabinet based on digital twinning, which comprises a data acquisition module, a space registration module, an energy fitting module and a quality judgment module, wherein the data acquisition module is used for acquiring a wire topological connection table, a wire physical attribute parameter, a rigid element theoretical point cloud and a field real point cloud, the space registration module is used for resolving a rigid body transformation matrix, determining virtual wire endpoint boundary conditions, the energy fitting module is used for constructing a flexible body digital twinning model, resolving internal elastic potential energy and external fitting potential energy in an equilibrium state, the quality judgment module is used for calling the internal elastic potential energy, the external fitting potential energy, a preset distance threshold and a preset deformation energy safety threshold and generating a processing quality detection result, the processing quality detection result comprises a topological error, a hidden damage or a qualified state, and the invention solves the problem that a soft object is difficult to position in the rigid detection and makes up the blank that the prior art cannot sense internal mechanical hidden trouble.
relevance_reason: 電気制御キャビネット加工品質検出のデジタルツイン。製造QC目的

title: Method, device, computer equipment, medium and program product for determining computational complexity of animation resource
abstract: The embodiment of the application discloses a method, a device, computer equipment, a medium and a program product for determining the calculation complexity of animation resources, which are used for determining the calculation complexity of a part to be identified based on the joint number, the material iteration number, the collision sub-step number, the total number of collidable individuals, the number of collided bodies and the constraint number of the part to be identified. Therefore, aiming at one component of the animation resource, the computing complexity of the component is obtained based on a plurality of parameters which possibly influence the computing complexity, and the consumption degree of the computing resource required by the component in the physical simulation process can be quantified through the computing complexity, so that the burden of the component and even the animation resource on the computer equipment can be clarified, and the stability and the reliability of the computer equipment are enhanced. In addition, the component can be modified through the calculation complexity to reduce the calculation complexity of the component and even the animation resource, so that the simulation time can be shortened, and the simulation precision and reliability can be improved.
relevance_reason: アニメーションリソースの計算複雑度算出(物理シミュレーション負荷)。グラフィックス性能指標

title: Industrial equipment operation and maintenance remote inspection simulation system and method based on virtual reality
abstract: The application relates to the technical field of remote operation and maintenance of industrial equipment, in particular to an industrial equipment operation and maintenance remote inspection simulation system and method based on virtual reality. The system comprises a virtual scene construction module, a device data integration module, a VR interaction and presentation module and a patrol logic management module, wherein the virtual scene construction module is used for creating an interactable virtual patrol environment based on a three-dimensional model of target industrial equipment, the device data integration module is used for accessing real-time operation data and a historical fault database of real industrial equipment, the VR interaction and presentation module is used for presenting the virtual patrol environment to a user, and the patrol logic management module dynamically generates patrol tasks, guide information and fault simulation events in the virtual environment. The interactive environment is created through the virtual scene construction module, the equipment data integration module is combined to access the real-time data and the historical fault library, the task and fault simulation are dynamically generated by the inspection logic management module, and three-dimensional visual presentation and standardized operation guidance of the real equipment state are realized.
relevance_reason: VR産業設備巡回シミュレーション。fault simulation eventsを動的生成(産業保守分野)

title: Three-dimensional physical simulation experiment method for carbon dioxide geological buried storage layer-cover layer system
abstract: The invention provides a three-dimensional physical simulation experiment method for a carbon dioxide geological buried storage layer-cover layer system, which belongs to the technical field of physical simulation, and adopts pressure rising rate contrast judgment interface breakthrough by arranging layered measuring points and interface control layers in a three-dimensional storage layer-cover layer physical model and identifying a preferential seepage channel by utilizing a pressure field space gradient matrix, the three level criteria of capillary break-through, seepage break-through and macroscopic break-through are synthesized through a multi-index fusion algorithm, model parameters are dynamically adjusted by combining a history fitting inversion method, a break-through characteristic parameter set is established, quantitative classification of sealing capacity is realized, and the technical problems that a multi-level process of a carbon dioxide break-through cover layer cannot be accurately identified in a three-dimensional physical simulation experiment and sealing performance is quantitatively evaluated are solved.
relevance_reason: CO2地質貯留の三次元物理シミュレーション実験。物理実験手法

title: Intelligent optimization method and system for pneumatic profile of turbine based on three-dimensional full flow field rapid prediction
abstract: A turbine pneumatic appearance intelligent optimization method and system based on three-dimensional full flow field rapid prediction relates to the field of turbine pneumatic appearance intelligent optimization. The method solves the problems of how to predict the local high gradient areas, how to balance the flow field prediction precision, the spatial resolution, the model training cost and the like in the prior art, and comprises the steps of constructing a three-dimensional flow field data set of a turbine by taking a radial rotation surface as a unit sample, constructing a neural network model of a three-dimensional full flow field of a turbine channel, constructing an intelligent optimization framework integrating prediction, evaluation and optimization, describing the geometric characteristics of blades in a parameterized manner, taking key geometric parameters as state variables of a reinforcement learning environment, taking pneumatic performance indexes output by a rapid flow field prediction model under given geometric and boundary conditions as reward signals, and automatically adjusting the blade parameters in a continuous design space by the reinforcement learning agent, and continuously updating a strategy network to realize the self-adaptive optimization of multi-objective performance.
relevance_reason: タービン空力形状のRL+物理最適化、境界条件。設計最適化目的

title: Water quality short-term forecasting method based on parameter disturbance-localized set data assimilation
abstract: The invention provides a water quality short-term forecasting method based on parameter disturbance-localized aggregate data assimilation, which belongs to the technical field of water quality forecasting, and comprises the steps of constructing an initial state vector based on the water quality state and uncertainty of an initial moment T1 of a hydrodynamic force-water quality mechanism model, converting the initial state vector into an initial aggregate member input model, screening model sensitive water quality parameters, generating a parameter disturbance aggregate by disturbance of the parameters and model driving conditions, fusing the parameter disturbance aggregate with the initial aggregate member into a disturbance aggregate, operating the disturbance aggregate input model to the moment T2 to obtain a water quality forecasting aggregate, calculating an analysis aggregate by adopting an EnKF (EnKF) and other aggregate data assimilation algorithm in combination with the moment T2 water quality observation data and errors, updating the initial condition of the model T2 by the analysis aggregate, repeating the steps, and continuously outputting optimal estimation at all moments to realize water quality short-term forecasting. The method can improve the short-term forecasting precision of water quality, save the calculation cost, accurately capture the space-time heterogeneity of the water bloom, and has strong interpretability and popularization.
relevance_reason: EnKFによる水質短期予測のパラメータ擾乱アンサンブル。データ同化手法だがパラメータ変動生成に近い

title: High-voltage submarine cable conductor temperature calculation method considering harmonic current influence
abstract: The invention relates to a high-voltage submarine cable conductor temperature calculating method considering harmonic current influence, and belongs to the technical field of cable conductor temperature calculation and current-carrying capacity regulation. The problem that conductor temperature assessment is inaccurate due to the fact that harmonic currents are ignored in an existing cable temperature calculation method is solved, and the influence of the harmonic waves on the running state of the submarine cable in a long-distance power transmission environment cannot be comprehensively represented. The technical scheme includes that an electromagnetic thermal coupling model is built, the volume loss density of power frequency and harmonic current is calculated, boundary conditions are set according to a sea middle section laying scene, multi-physical-field simulation is conducted to obtain conductor temperature, and effectiveness is verified through experiments. The method can accurately quantify the influence of harmonic current components and content on the heating of the submarine cable conductor, and ensure the long-term stable operation of the high-capacity offshore wind power access high-voltage submarine cable.
relevance_reason: 海底ケーブル導体温度計算、境界条件。物理計算手法

title: Multi-parameter collaborative optimization method and execution device for track fastener construction process
abstract: The application discloses a multi-parameter collaborative optimization method and an execution device for a track fastener construction process, wherein a three-dimensional parameter coupling model comprises independent characteristic parameters, a torque-temperature coupling model, a temperature-strain response coupling model and a strain-torque anti-coupling model of the track fastener, anti-loosening performance boundary conditions are set for the three-dimensional parameter coupling model, a dynamic equation is established for the three-dimensional parameter coupling model, fatigue life estimation and anti-loosening performance analysis are carried out, a dynamic particle swarm optimization algorithm is adopted to carry out multi-parameter collaborative optimization to obtain an optimal parameter range, and after the multi-parameter collaborative optimization method for the track fastener construction process is adopted to carry out process optimization, the process parameter optimization effect is remarkable, the anti-loosening performance is comprehensively improved, the efficiency and economy are greatly improved, and the applicability, engineering practical value, safety and reliability are improved.
relevance_reason: 軌道締結具最適化、境界条件。機械設計最適化

title: Transient temperature field calculation method and system based on depth extrapolation correction
abstract: The application relates to the field of temperature field numerical solution, in particular to a transient temperature field calculation method and a transient temperature field calculation system based on depth extrapolation correction, wherein the method comprises the steps of firstly mapping unstructured grid data into high-dimensional temperature characteristics through an encoder network; and then, carrying out calculation of coarse branches and fine branches in parallel, wherein the coarse branches directly predict a temperature field at multiple moments in the future by adopting a coarse step length through adding time codes, the fine branches gradually predict by adopting an original fixed step length through iterative propulsion, and combining a Lechadson extrapolation method to fuse the results of the coarse branches and the fine branches, so as to obtain a corrected high-precision temperature field, and meanwhile, constructing a loss function constraint model training by using a heat conduction equation and boundary conditions, so that the results are ensured to accord with a physical rule. According to the method, the time difference error is effectively improved from first order to second order precision, long-time sequence error accumulation is restrained while the calculation efficiency of a large time step is maintained, and technical support is provided for high-efficiency and high-precision solving of the transient temperature field of the thermal component of the aviation engineering.
relevance_reason: 過渡温度場計算(深層外挿補正)、境界条件。物理+ML計算手法

title: Outfield semi-physical simulation test system and test method based on RTX real-time system
abstract: The invention discloses an outfield semi-physical simulation test system and a test method based on an RTX real-time system, wherein the test system comprises a notebook computer used for real-time simulation, and an RTX system is arranged on the notebook computer; the system comprises a network port serial port inter-conversion box, an on-bullet single machine, a network port of the network port serial port inter-conversion box, a serial port of the on-bullet single machine, a serial port of the network port serial port inter-conversion box, a network port data of the on-bullet single machine, and a semi-physical simulation test. According to the invention, after the notebook computer and the network port serial port inter-conversion box are used for replacing an industrial personal computer as the simulation computer, the simulation computer can be carried about, so that the convenience of tests in the outfield and the outfield coordination unit is improved, namely the portability of the equipment is improved on the premise of ensuring the real-time performance.
relevance_reason: 野外用可搬型半物理シミュレーション試験システム。試験基盤でレアイベント生成ではない

title: Dynamic evaluation method for physical structure and reliability of bridge vibration along time axis
abstract: The invention discloses a physical principal structure of bridge vibration and a dynamic evaluation method of reliability thereof along a time axis, which relate to the technical field of dynamic evaluation of bridge reliability along the time axis, and establish a loss function of a physical information driving model through a vibration equation of a bridge and initial conditions and boundary conditions of the vibration equation of the bridge; the method comprises the steps of obtaining training samples of a physical information driving model by dividing a feasible region of a sample point into a plurality of feasible region units, predicting amplitude on a bridge after training the physical information driving model, and establishing a system function to obtain dynamic failure probability of the bridge along a time axis. According to the method, the amplitude of the bridge is predicted by using the physical information driving model, the problem that the traditional reliability dynamic evaluation along the time axis needs to rely on a large number of simulation calculation to obtain samples is solved, and the calculation cost is effectively reduced. By adopting the dynamic resampling method, the training speed and the performance response calculation accuracy can be higher.
relevance_reason: 橋梁振動信頼性動的評価。従来法の大量シミュレーションサンプル依存を軽減する物理情報モデル

title: Digital twinning-based solar module production line optimization method
abstract: The invention provides a digital twinning-based solar module production line optimization method, and relates to the technical field of intelligent manufacturing. The method for optimizing the solar module production line based on the digital twin comprises the following steps of S1, based on an Internet of things sensor, S2, based on real-time production data flow, S3, based on a digital twin model instance, S4, based on a synchronous digital twin state, S5, based on an optimized scheduling scheme and the synchronous digital twin state, S6, based on a quality prediction report, and S7, based on an optimized process parameter set and the synchronous digital twin state. Based on the data flow, a three-dimensional modeling technology and a physical simulation method are adopted, a machine learning algorithm is integrated to train a digital twin model, precise virtual mapping of equipment, process and material flow is realized, and the fidelity and the prediction capability of the model are improved.
relevance_reason: 太陽電池生産ラインのデジタルツイン最適化(物理シミュレーション+ML)。製造プロセス目的

title: Power system risk detection method for resampling of parallel Markov chain Monte Carlo
abstract: The invention discloses a power system risk detection method and device based on parallel Markov chain Monte Carlo resampling, wherein the method comprises the steps of defining a risk index, generating sample variables according to power equipment running states and load power losses, simulating according to the Markov chain Monte Carlo method through parallel threads, obtaining a first sample set and a second sample set based on the sample variable simulation, obtaining classification distribution parameters based on the first sample set, obtaining normal distribution parameters based on the second sample set, obtaining an ideal probability density function according to the classification distribution parameters and the normal distribution parameters, and obtaining a risk index importance sampling expression based on the ideal probability density function. The invention shortens the sample collection time and improves the overall calculation efficiency.

title: Geotechnical engineering multi-mode simulation design method and model test loading device thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a geotechnical engineering multimode simulation design method and a model test loading device, which solve the problems of single loading mode, low control precision and poor suitability of the traditional device, the method comprises the steps of establishing a pile-soil system wave equation, setting a boundary initial condition, correcting a vibration equation, deducing a displacement response curve, carrying out PID feedback adjustment, and setting up a complete mathematical model in 2s by using Kp=1.8, ki=0.4 and Kd=0.02 parameters, wherein the loading error is less than 3 percent, and the device comprises a base, a driving device and the like and is adapted to a model box with multiple specifications; the loading assembly is modularized by using an adjustable coupler and a modularized end, and the upper computer is supported to control the parameter. Compared with the prior art, the invention has the advantages of multimode loading, high-precision control, strong adaptability and high operation efficiency, meets the test requirement of complex rock and soil, and provides support for related mechanism research.

title: Fireflood simulation method based on multi-physical field coupling
abstract: The invention provides a fire driving simulation method based on multi-physical field coupling, which comprises the steps of carrying out thermal analysis experiments, dynamics inversion, reaction heat acquisition and small-scale numerical check on a sample to obtain a reaction dynamics parameter set and a reaction heat parameter set, coupling five physical fields based on a geometric model and a grid, setting key coupling variables, outputting a multi-physical field coupling numerical model, defining the coupling relation among the physical fields, defining initial conditions, boundary conditions and solving the settings to obtain an operable model example, utilizing the operable model example to output a simulation result, and processing and optimizing the simulation result to obtain an optimal injection parameter combination. The invention solves the simulation problem of multi-physical field intensity coupling in the fireflood process, not only improves the mechanism authenticity and the prediction extrapolation capability, but also provides the visual diagnosis and the scheme optimizing capability which can be directly applied, and can provide reliable basis for the design and dynamic regulation of the fireflood development scheme of the oil field.

title: Nuclear reactor passive start simulation method based on Monte Carlo method
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of nuclear reactor physical simulation and safety analysis, and discloses a nuclear reactor passive start simulation method based on a Monte Carlo method, which performs single sample calculation based on the Monte Carlo direct simulation method, and obtaining calculation results of a plurality of mutually independent samples by modifying random number seeds in the input card, and finally obtaining a probability distribution result of the weak neutron field through statistics. The invention can accurately describe the physical process of the weak neutron field stage and is suitable for three-dimensional complex reactors.

title: Large-model-based steel wire rope reliable service life calculation method
abstract: The invention discloses a steel wire rope reliable service life calculation method based on a large model, which relates to the technical field of intelligent calculation and comprises the steps of collecting three-dimensional structure data and degradation time sequence data of a steel wire rope, constructing a structure diagram and a degradation sequence, extracting local stress characteristics of the structure diagram through a graph neural network, extracting attenuation trend characteristics of the degradation sequence through the time sequence model, generating structure-degradation coupling representation in a fusion layer, inputting the structure-degradation coupling representation into a physical conservation constraint system consisting of a fatigue rule function, an energy dissipation function and a damage accumulation function, carrying out physical consistency correction, outputting a degradation curve meeting fatigue growth, damage monotonicity and material strength boundary conditions, and searching a time point reaching a failure threshold value for the first time in the degradation curve to serve as a service life prediction value of the steel wire rope. The invention achieves the synergistic lifting effect of considering fine structure expression, degeneration process learning and engineering safety constraint in the calculation of the reliable service life of the steel wire rope.

title: Construction method of stress disturbance path in deep solid resource fluidization loop mining mode
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of deep coal solid mineral resource safe exploitation, and discloses a method for constructing a stress disturbance path of a deep solid resource fluidization loop exploitation mode, which comprises the steps of establishing a three-dimensional numerical model, setting simulation parameters and boundary conditions, and carrying out fluidization loop and conventional exploitation mode numerical simulation under the same conditions; the method comprises the steps of obtaining a supporting stress concentration coefficient in front of a propulsion surface in a conventional mining mode, comparing and checking with an actual engineering range, correcting simulation parameters and boundary conditions when the supporting stress concentration coefficient is not matched with the actual engineering range, and taking the supporting stress concentration coefficient in front of the propulsion surface in a fluidized loop mining mode as a two-dimensional stress disturbance path basis when the supporting stress concentration coefficient is matched with the boundary conditions. The method effectively solves the problem that the stress disturbance path is difficult to determine under the condition that the actual engineering condition is absent in the fluidized loop mining mode.

title: Method, system, apparatus, and medium for generating critical scenarios in autonomous driving tests
abstract: A method, system, apparatus, and medium for generating critical scenarios in autonomous driving tests are provided. The method includes: generating an initial scenario based on a lane-coordinate system; constructing a one-way single-lane car-following scenario, specifically including: creating a road and vehicles based on the initial scenario, the vehicles including an autonomous vehicle controlled by an intelligent driving model (IDM) and an agent vehicle; constructing a one-way dual-lane cut-in scenario, specifically including: creating a dual-lane road and vehicles based on the initial scenario, the vehicles including an autonomous vehicle controlled by the IDM model and an intelligent-agent vehicle; and generating, based on the constructed one-way single-lane car-following scenario and the constructed one-way dual-lane cut-in scenario, critical scenarios for autonomous-vehicle testing. The method efficiently and accurately produces critical scenarios for autonomous-driving systems, thereby accelerating the testing and verification of their performance and safety in complex, high-risk environments.

title: System and methods for simulating the physical behavior of objects
abstract: Embodiments of the present disclosure provide an artificial intelligence (AI)-driven system and methods for modeling the response/behavior of physical objects within a digital environment. In some implementations, digital models of physical objects are processed using a domain decomposition method (DDM) model configured to solve a boundary value problem by splitting the digital model into a plurality of subdomains. Each subdomain can then be individually solved (e.g., using a deep learning model) to predict horizontal and vertical displacements or the whole displacement field, which in turn can be used to predict boundary conditions for the respective subdomain. From the respective boundary conditions, a displacement field over the entire domain and/or a stress field can be predicted.

title: Temperature field calculation method for composite plate heating and serpentine rolling process
abstract: The invention discloses a temperature field calculation method for a composite plate heating and serpentine rolling process, which belongs to the technical field of metal material hot rolling processing and comprises the steps of setting heating initial parameters, calculating heat radiation and convection heat exchange quantity of a composite plate in a heating furnace, establishing heating process boundary conditions, calculating various heat sources and heat exchange coefficients of serpentine rolling, establishing serpentine rolling boundary conditions, discretizing a three-dimensional unsteady heat conduction equation containing all heat sources, correcting heat flow density coefficients according to actual measurement and calculation deviation of temperature, and finally solving discrete equations through a three-dimensional heat conduction numerical solution to obtain the temperature of each key position of the composite plate in an iterative manner.

title: Optical cleaning simulation analysis method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention provides a light cleaning simulation analysis method, a light cleaning simulation analysis device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of light cleaning. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a geometric model of the light cleaning chamber, setting simulation parameters for the geometric model, adding a geometric optical physical field and a laminar flow physical field into the geometric model, setting material initial conditions for the geometric model, carrying out ray tracing on the geometric optical physical field and carrying out steady-state solving on the laminar flow physical field, simulating ultraviolet irradiance and a gas flow field in the light cleaning chamber to obtain a simulation result, and carrying out simulation analysis on the simulation result to obtain a simulation analysis result. The method aims to solve the problems of low research efficiency and high trial-and-error cost caused by the lack of effective guiding directions when the traditional light cleaning technology is used for exploring the layout of the gas circuit and the light source, improve the research and exploration efficiency and reduce the exploration cost in experiments.

title: Nonlinear heterogeneous material layering multi-scale modeling method based on finite volume method
abstract: The invention discloses a nonlinear heterogeneous material layering multi-scale modeling method based on a finite volume method, which belongs to the field of nonlinear solid material multi-scale mechanical behavior simulation and comprises the following steps of S1, constructing a discrete macroscopic equilibrium equation of an incremental Lagrange format, S2, constructing a macro-micro scale mapping mechanism, transmitting a deformation gradient of a macroscopic control volume center point to a microscopic representative volume unit boundary, S3, developing a generalized boundary condition engine, replacing periodic constraint by Hill-Mandel energy equivalent force conditions, S4, solving a microscopic stress field by utilizing finite volume method flux integration, homogenizing the volume average stress of a microscopic representative volume unit through Hill-Mandel energy equivalent force conditions and feeding back to a macroscopic constitutive relation, S5, introducing a numerical diffusion term into the discrete macroscopic equilibrium equation, and triggering diffusion coefficient self-adaptive lifting when the equivalent plastic strain exceeds a preset threshold. The invention realizes efficiency transition, boundary liberation and precision breakthrough through the collaborative innovation of the layered FVM architecture and the generalized boundary engine.

title: Real-time estimation method and system for internal temperature field of cylindrical lithium battery
abstract: The invention discloses a real-time estimation method and a system for an internal temperature field of a cylindrical lithium battery, which are characterized in that a temperature space distribution model is established based on a heat conduction equation, the space-time quantity is normalized through scaling transformation, and a non-homogeneous boundary condition is converted into homogeneous condition through variable substitution; the space-time relationship between the temperature distribution quantity and the heat production quantity item is decoupled by adopting a double decomposition technology, the heat production quantity time variable is taken as a virtual source, and a limited dimension Chang Weifen equation model is established by utilizing the Galerkin method. The method comprises the steps of designing an adaptive observer, combining an adaptive learning algorithm to estimate low-order state variables and virtual source time sequences on line so as to measure and estimate a temperature error driving update rate, and reconstructing temperature distribution quantity and virtual source estimated values through space-time synthesis of the estimated sequences and a preset space basis function. Only temperature measurement data is needed, voltage and current sensors are not needed, and real-time estimation of the internal temperature field and the heat generation capacity of the cylindrical lithium battery can be effectively realized by means of a small amount of thermocouples.

title: Simulation method of multistage supercritical carbon dioxide centrifugal compressor
abstract: The application discloses a simulation method of a multistage supercritical carbon dioxide centrifugal compressor, which belongs to the field of centrifugal compressor simulation and comprises the steps of determining first physical property data of a compressed carbon dioxide working medium in the compressor according to entropy boundary conditions of the compressor, determining second physical property data of the carbon dioxide working medium in the compressor, determining initial flow field data of the carbon dioxide working medium in the compressor based on the first physical property data and the second physical property data, determining third physical property data of the carbon dioxide working medium in the compressor according to the initial flow field data, and determining simulated flow field data of the carbon dioxide working medium in the compressor based on the third physical property data and the second physical property data. The application realizes the accurate characterization of the flow field characteristics under the complex working condition, reduces the adverse effect caused by too high calculation complexity, and ensures that the simulation process is close to the actual running state and has higher simulation efficiency and stability.

title: Power equipment fault maintenance and debugging system and method
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of power distribution equipment maintenance, in particular to a power equipment fault maintenance debugging system and method, wherein the system comprises a multi-mode data fusion acquisition module, a digital twin fault simulation positioning unit, a self-adaptive debugging execution module, a maintenance safety linkage control unit and a full life cycle data closed-loop management module; the method comprises the steps of multidimensional data acquisition, digital twin simulation positioning, self-adaptive strategy debugging, safety linkage monitoring and data closed-loop optimization. According to the invention, the problem of single traditional data is solved through multi-mode data fusion, the 1:1 simulation positioning of a fault scene is realized by combining digital twinning, the self-adaptive module can be automatically matched with various fault debugging strategies, the safety linkage unit interacts with the power grid dispatching system in real time through an IEC61850 protocol, the automatic early warning/power failure of the electric parameter of the overhaul region is realized, the data closed loop module optimizes the strategy library based on historical overhaul data, so that the overhaul efficiency is improved, and the debugging period is shortened.

title: Construction method, equipment and storage medium based on distributed LVC simulation system
abstract: The present application relates to the field of simulation technologies, and in particular, to a method, an apparatus, and a storage medium for constructing a distributed LVC simulation system. The distributed LVC simulation system comprises a digital simulation system, a semi-physical simulation system and a flight simulator simulation system, and the method comprises the steps of dividing and merging simulation resources in all sub-systems based on preset splitting granularity to obtain a plurality of component models with independent simulation functions, selecting target component models from the plurality of component models based on simulation task requirements to be combined to construct a plurality of simulation entities, creating corresponding proxy models in the digital simulation system for external target component models which do not belong to the digital simulation system, and performing bidirectional state synchronization on the proxy models and the corresponding external target component models in the simulation operation process, and performing data interaction on the representation of the external target component models and the digital simulation system. The flexibility and the expandability of the simulation are improved.

title: Topology optimization method and device based on deep learning and considering volume constraint, boundary condition and design domain
abstract: The invention discloses a topology optimization method and a topology optimization device based on deep learning and considering volume constraint, boundary condition and design domain, belonging to the technical field of topology optimization design, according to the method, a training data set under various constraint conditions and design domains is constructed, and the full convolution neural network is used for offline training, so that a full convolution neural network model capable of representing a topological optimization design rule is obtained. In practical application, the topological optimization result can be rapidly output through the trained neural network only by inputting corresponding boundary conditions and design domain information, thereby replacing the traditional iterative calculation process. The invention remarkably reduces the calculation complexity and time consumption while maintaining the topology optimization precision, realizes the high efficiency and the intellectualization of the topology optimization, and has good engineering application prospect.

title: Bionic-driven soil infiltration process simulation optimization method
abstract: The invention discloses a simulated optimization method of a bionic-driven soil infiltration process, which comprises the steps of preprocessing and standardizing multisource data, enabling a root voxel unit to correspond to a hydraulic response of a specific time step through a space-time registration unified coordinate system, constructing a model framework integrating root characteristics and infiltration dynamics, realizing bidirectional mapping of spatial characteristics and time characteristics through a cross-modal fusion cross-attention mechanism module, embedding physical constraints, training and optimizing the model through a staged course learning strategy, adjusting learning rate through a physical perception optimizer, combining importance sampling with anti-training and improving model generalization capability, outputting a priority flow prediction result based on the trained model, and analyzing the prediction result from microscopic, mesoscopic and macroscopic scales through an interpreter. Therefore, the method has the advantages of high prediction precision, strong applicability, low parameter acquisition cost, introduction of a dynamic mechanism, physical rationality and the like.

title: Topology optimization method for simultaneously optimizing supporting position and structure topology
abstract: The invention discloses a topology optimization method for simultaneously optimizing supporting position and structure topology, and relates to the technical field of topology optimization. The method specifically comprises the steps of determining an initial structure design domain, a support design domain and boundary conditions of topological optimization, establishing a topological optimization model with minimum compliance by adopting a variable density method, calculating sensitivity information of an objective function and constraint, solving the structure design domain and the support design domain based on a gradient optimization method and a discrete particle swarm algorithm, and verifying the effectiveness of the method through a numerical value case. The invention can effectively determine the optimal supporting position by a discrete particle swarm algorithm, and can efficiently process density variables in a design domain by adopting a variable density method to establish a structural topology optimization model.

title: Method for improving recovery ratio by injecting water between cracks of dense oil reservoir volume fracturing horizontal well
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of petroleum exploitation, in particular to a method for improving recovery ratio by injecting water among fracturing horizontal well cracks of a tight oil reservoir volume. title: Intelligent automobile reliability calculation method based on restrictive particle swarm algorithm
abstract: The invention relates to an intelligent automobile reliability calculation method based on a restrictive particle swarm algorithm, which comprises the steps of obtaining a whole automobile target parameter, establishing a RXCY equivalent relation model of whole automobile target reliability and confidence coefficient according to the whole automobile target parameter, determining a system-level reliability target, constructing a target function for minimizing the sum of logarithmic deviation of the system reliability and a penalty function, setting constraint conditions of the target function according to the system-level reliability target, carrying out iterative solution on the target function by adopting a particle swarm optimization algorithm, obtaining optimal reliability distribution values of all parts, and introducing the penalty function aiming at the reliability boundary conditions of all the parts in the iterative solution process, so as to provide an optimization direction for a particle swarm.

title: Multi-physical field coupling simulation modeling method, device and equipment for fiber laser and electrolysis and storage medium
abstract: The application provides a multi-physical-field coupling simulation modeling method, device and equipment for fiber laser and electrolysis and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of laser processing and electrochemical processing composite manufacturing. The method comprises the steps of establishing an axisymmetric geometric model, establishing a multi-physical field coupling model comprising a flow field model, a gas generation model, a heat transfer model, an electric field model, an ion diffusion model and a material removal model, setting simulation parameters and boundary conditions, and solving the multi-physical field coupling model by using finite element simulation software to obtain potential, current density, temperature, conductivity, ion diffusion coefficient, gas volume fraction and flow field distribution in the processing process. The application realizes the simulation modeling of the coupling effect of the optical-electric-thermal-flow-mass multi-physical field in the process of simulating the optical fiber laser and the electrolytic composite processing, and can be used for analyzing the dissolution characteristics of materials and obtaining the physical quantity which is difficult to measure by an experimental instrument in the processing.

title: Piston ring structure design and performance analysis method
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of aeroengines, and discloses a piston ring structure design and performance analysis method, which comprises the steps of selecting a piston ring material according to the thermal expansion coefficient and the elastic modulus of the material; the method comprises the steps of determining the size of a geometric model of an assembling state of a piston ring, establishing the geometric model of the assembling state of the piston ring, designing a piston ring structure, obtaining a geometric model of a free state of the piston ring, carrying out material attribute giving, grid division and boundary condition setting, carrying out simulation of the assembling process of the piston ring at room temperature, analyzing the mechanical property and the sealing property of the piston ring at room temperature, carrying out simulation of the common temperature rise deformation process of the piston ring and a casing, and analyzing the mechanical property and the sealing property of the piston ring after the temperature rise deformation.

title: Analysis method, device, equipment and medium for safety function characteristics
abstract: The application relates to the field of vehicle simulation, in particular to a method, a device, equipment and a medium for analyzing safety function characteristics. The method and the device realize standardization and automation of parameter test by presetting a plurality of simulation scenes and automatically executing fault-free and fault injection simulation, avoid randomness of manual test driving, greatly shorten test period, quantitatively analyze difference data of different time points of each scene to determine a torque distribution difference threshold value, ensure repeatability and accuracy of results, overcome subjectivity of engineering judgment, and drive the whole process based on data in the process of deducing safety function features by threshold value, reduce human intervention and improve efficiency and reliability. In summary, the automatic simulation is used for replacing manual operation, the quantitative analysis is used for replacing experience judgment, the determination of the torque distribution difference threshold and the safety function characteristic is efficiently and stably completed, and reliable technical support is provided for the prevention and control of the transverse torque hazard of the vehicle.

title: Roadway caving collapse simulation method
abstract: The invention discloses a simulation method for roadway caving collapse, which belongs to the technical field of data simulation processing and comprises the steps of collecting data of a stratum of a collapse mining area and a roadway, establishing a two-dimensional geological section model perpendicular to the tunneling direction of the roadway in UDEC numerical simulation software, endowing the two-dimensional geological section model with physical mechanical properties, applying boundary conditions and initial conditions to the two-dimensional geological section model, solving and calculating the two-dimensional geological section model to obtain a collapse simulation result, and combining the collapse simulation result obtained by calculation with field investigation data to obtain morphological structure characteristics of a roadway caving collapse body. The simulation method for the caving collapse of the roadway can solve the problem that the existing simulation for caving collapse of the roadway is difficult to accurately simulate the dynamic process and morphological characteristics of caving collapse of the roadway.

title: Intelligent identification method for lithium niobate super-surface defects based on reactive ion beam etching
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of industrial detection, and discloses an intelligent recognition method of lithium niobate super surface defects based on reactive ion beam etching, which solves the problem of scarcity of experimental data systematically through physical driving simulation and a physical-based rendering algorithm and provides large-scale field specific training data for a deep learning model. The bidirectional coupling simulation model generates defect morphology prediction data conforming to an etching dynamics rule based on real process parameters and material parameters, a physical rendering algorithm converts the prediction data into a synthetic image with real microscopic image statistical characteristics, and an automatic labeling and statistical verification flow ensures the quality and consistency of the synthetic data. The method can expand the number of samples of the ternary association database by several times, and cover extreme process conditions and rare defect modes which are difficult to acquire by experimental acquisition.

title: Simulation method for electric power spot transaction
abstract: The embodiment of the invention relates to an analog simulation method based on electric power spot transaction, which comprises the steps of obtaining static structure data such as power grid topology and unit parameters, dynamic time sequence data such as load, new energy prediction and the like, preprocessing the dynamic data, dividing the dynamic data in multiple time scales, constructing a multi-agent model with differentiated characteristics based on the processed data, generating and reporting energy block information such as time blocks, continuous blocks, curve blocks or variable blocks by each agent according to perceived market environment, constructing and solving a market clearing model considering system power balance, network tide, unit operation and energy block characteristic constraint based on all the reports, obtaining clear electricity price and electric quantity, feeding back the result to the agent, and carrying out rolling collaborative simulation between the daily clear result and the real-time market through a deep reinforcement learning update strategy, wherein the daily clear result is used as a boundary condition of the real-time market. The invention improves the authenticity, accuracy and practicability of market simulation.

title: Indoor laser guiding tracking and interference demonstration semi-physical simulation system and method
abstract: The invention discloses a laser guiding tracking and interference demonstration semi-physical simulation system and a method, wherein the simulation system comprises a diffuse reflection plate, a guiding laser, a reflector turntable, a laser detector, a visible light camera, a tracking turntable, an interference laser, a synchronous processing module and a control computer; the control computer is in communication connection with each device and controls the operation of each connection device, meanwhile, the working state and simulation test data of each connection device are collected, the synchronous processing module outputs trigger signals of the guiding laser and the interference laser, the guiding laser irradiates the emitted guiding laser onto the diffuse reflection plate through the reflector turntable, the tracking turntable carries a laser detector and a visible light camera to conduct guiding laser tracking, the interference laser generates interference laser, and the laser detector is interfered to enable the laser detector to be incapable of generating correct deviation.

title: Single-phase medium nonlinear super-surface Schottky wave frequency dispersion relation calculation method and system
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of physical acoustics, in particular to a method and a system for calculating the dispersion relation of a nonlinear super-surface Schottky wave of a single-phase medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps of obtaining an expression of a displacement component and a stress component of the single-phase medium under the action of the Schottky wave; and applying stress and displacement continuity boundary conditions at the interface of the single-phase medium and the fluid layer based on all the expressions, so as to obtain a characteristic equation of the dispersion characteristic of the coupling system, solving the characteristic equation, and finally obtaining a dispersion curve of the coupling system. According to the invention, by providing the explicit dispersion relation of the nonlinear super-surface Schottky wave of the single-phase medium, the calculation efficiency and the prediction precision of the nonlinear super-surface interface wave propagation on the single-phase medium are improved, and the calculation cost and the design period of acoustic super-surface design, vibration suppression and waveguide regulation are reduced.

title: Variable boundary condition real-time physical field simulation method based on deep learning
abstract: A variable boundary condition real-time physical field simulation method based on deep learning belongs to the field of artificial intelligence and scientific calculation intersection, and aims at the bottleneck that the prior art cannot realize real-time simulation when boundary conditions dynamically change, a general simulation model decoupled from specific boundary conditions is built through one-time offline training. For a linear field, a new boundary condition is decomposed into frequency domain coefficients by utilizing Fourier transformation in an online stage through a physical information neural network offline training base Jie Ku, and a physical field is instantaneously synthesized by weighting and linear combination of base solutions, and for a nonlinear field, space-time coordinates are mapped to a group of polynomial coefficients by learning through a training coefficient prediction network, and the frequency domain characteristics of the boundary condition are combined with the network prediction coefficients in the online stage to output a physical field solution in real time. The invention realizes second-level real-time response when boundary conditions change, uniformly supports forward and inverse problem solving, overcomes the defect of repeated training or dependence on mass data, and remarkably improves the efficiency.

title: Power semiconductor heat-conducting silicone grease migration simulation method based on multi-physical field coupling
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of power semiconductor thermal management, in particular to a power semiconductor heat conduction silicone grease migration simulation method based on multi-physical field coupling. The method mainly aims at solving the problems of non-pertinence and the like of research structural design aiming at silicone grease migration in the industry and provides the following technical scheme that a geometric model of a power semiconductor module is built; the method comprises a first step of defining material properties, a second step of configuring a multi-physical field module and a coupling relation, a third step of setting boundary conditions and solving parameters, and a fifth step of outputting simulation key results. According to the invention, through accurate modeling, actual material definition fitting, complete multi-physical field coupling reproduction and scientific solving verification, the silicone grease migration simulation precision and pertinence are improved, a reliable basis can be provided for module structure selection and optimization, part of experiments can be replaced, the research and development cost is reduced, the long-term reliability of the power semiconductor module is improved by assistance, and the operation and maintenance risk is reduced.

title: Distributed multi-physical-field collaborative simulation method
abstract: The application discloses a distributed multi-physical field collaborative simulation method, which relates to the field of electromechanical system simulation, and comprises the steps of respectively configuring independent variable step-length integrators for physical field subsystems with different time constants; the method comprises the steps of establishing a step length mapping function among subsystems through a main controller, associating the maximum allowable step length ratio of each subsystem by the function, activating cross-field boundary condition transfer when a time sequence alignment module detects that simulation moments of at least two subsystems meet synchronous conditions, and triggering joint time step rollback of associated subsystems if Lyapunov indexes of any subsystems exceed a stability threshold. The scheme of the application can break through the global fixed step limit, replace the strong synchronous mode by using a dynamic weak coupling strategy driven by time sequence, and realize the collaborative optimization of the calculation efficiency and the numerical stability.

title: Temperature field calculation method and system based on continuous diving space induction point strategy
abstract: The application relates to the field of temperature field numerical calculation, in particular to a temperature field calculation method and system based on a continuous subspace induction point strategy. The method comprises the steps of firstly obtaining material properties of a thermal component to be detected and unstructured grid and temperature data in a specified application scene, mapping the unstructured grid and the temperature data to a continuous latent space through an encoder, generating a structured feature map by combining induction points, carrying out dynamic feature fitting and time propulsion on the feature map by utilizing a Unet module to obtain a next-moment feature map, reversely converting the feature map into an unstructured temperature vector through a decoder, and optimizing a model through a loss function containing a heat conduction equation and boundary conditions. The application effectively solves the problem that the traditional CNN can not directly process unstructured data, realizes the efficient and high-precision solution of the transient temperature field in the complex geometric model, remarkably improves the efficiency and reliability of engineering thermal simulation, and is suitable for the design of thermal components of aviation engineering and a digital twin system.
