title: Beidou multisource fusion-based reservoir dam group deformation monitoring method and system
abstract: The invention provides a method and a system for monitoring deformation of a stock dam group based on Beidou multisource fusion, wherein satellite observation signals and sensing data of a stock dam group monitoring area are received to obtain multisource input data, a preset stock dam group digital twin body model is input to simulate physical behaviors of a stock dam group structure to generate a global deformation field, the global deformation field is used as an initial boundary condition to be input into a deformation conduction dynamics model module in the stock dam group digital twin body model, deformation key conduction paths existing in the stock dam group are identified, stress-deformation forward algorithm and reverse tracing analysis are executed in the stock dam group digital twin body model based on the deformation key conduction paths, influence weights of core risk sources on deformation of the stock dam group are calculated, simulation scenes of various regulation strategies are constructed in the stock dam group digital twin body model, and simulation deduction is carried out on the deformation trend of the stock dam group under each simulation scene to obtain deformation early warning information. The invention effectively improves the reliability of early warning response.

title: High-altitude physical training system based on VR and entity simulation and control method
abstract: The invention discloses a high-altitude physical training system based on VR and entity simulation and a control method. The system comprises a training cabin body, an entity simulation device, a VR virtual reality device, an environment simulation device, a data acquisition device and a central control unit, wherein the entity simulation device, the VR virtual reality device, the environment simulation device and the data acquisition device are arranged in the cabin body. The physical simulation device comprises a lever bridge structure with adjustable difficulty, the environment simulation device comprises fans which are arranged in multiple directions, the data acquisition device is used for acquiring position and action data of a trainer in real time, the central control unit synchronously controls the VR virtual reality device to generate corresponding high-altitude scenes according to a preset training scheme and drives the environment simulation device and the physical simulation device to generate corresponding physical environment feedback, so that an immersive and multi-sense high-altitude psychological stress training environment is formed. The invention realizes accurate, controllable and safe training of psychological stress response in high altitude environment by combining deficiency and excess, and effectively improves psychological adaptability and bearing capacity of a trainer.

title: VR-based hydrogen fuel cell car fire rescue treatment training exercise system
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of fire rescue training of hydrogen fuel cell automobiles and discloses a VR-based fire rescue treatment training exercise system for hydrogen fuel cell automobiles, which comprises a storage module, wherein the storage module is used for storing training data, constructing a knowledge graph based on the training data, constructing a basic vehicle model through the knowledge graph by the construction module, and generating an countermeasure sample based on the training data. The invention constructs an immersive training environment which is highly realistic, dynamically evolved, can be cooperated by multiple persons and has self-adaptive teaching capability through integrating advanced technologies such as knowledge graph, countermeasure sample generation, physical simulation, natural language interaction, intelligent behavior analysis and the like. An operator can repeatedly exercise the standardized disposal flow of various hydrogen fuel cell car accidents under the zero risk condition, obtain real-time principle explanation and operation correction, and obviously improve emergency disposal capacity and safety awareness.

title: Targeting digital twin construction method for construction control of large-span arch bridge
abstract: The invention discloses a targeted digital twin construction method for construction control of a large-span arch bridge, and relates to the field of digital twin and intelligent construction control of the large-span arch bridge. title: Frozen soil hydrothermal coupling model based on physical information neural network
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of frozen soil hydrothermal coupling, in particular to a frozen soil hydrothermal coupling model based on a physical information neural network, which comprises the following steps of deducing a control equation, namely deducing an energy conservation equation and deducing a mass conservation equation; the method comprises a first step of calculating physical field distribution in the whole domain at the beginning of calculation according to initial condition description, a second step of assisting an equation, a third step of calculating physical field distribution in the whole domain at the beginning of calculation according to initial condition description, wherein in practical application, the initial condition is usually determined based on field observation data or theoretical analysis, a fourth step of calculating physical field constraint on a domain boundary according to boundary condition description, and a fifth step of a physical information neural network method. The method realizes high-efficiency gridless calculation, provides powerful support for model parameter inversion and cold region engineering real-time prediction, and remarkably improves the practical value and application potential of the method.

title: Explosion funnel volume solving method based on improved physical information neural network
abstract: The invention discloses a blasting hopper volume solving method based on an improved physical information neural network. The method comprises the steps of 1, establishing a mechanical model of blast load of a blast hole wall, 2, establishing a blasting physical model of a columnar explosive package equivalent to a spherical explosive package by utilizing a Starfied superposition method, 3, establishing a blasting funnel volume prediction model based on a wavelet multi-scale synchronous compression transformation enhanced physical information neural network, constructing a solution space of a physical field by utilizing the wavelet multi-scale synchronous compression transformation, training a physical information neural network embedded with a blasting funnel physical control equation, an initial condition and a boundary condition as loss functions, and 4, intelligently predicting the blasting funnel volume by adopting the trained enhanced physical information neural network. The trained physical information neural network enhances the robustness and generalization capability of the blasting hopper volume prediction model, and provides high-precision theoretical support for blasting design optimization in engineering blasting.

abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent reconstruction method for fan vibration data loss based on a deep network structure, which particularly relates to the field of data loss reconstruction, and comprises the steps of collecting fan vibration and working condition data, normalizing, designing three loss modes of random point, continuous block and channel total loss, constructing a data set, simultaneously establishing a normal working condition vibration characteristic memory bank, constructing three heterogeneous expert networks of time sequence prediction of a space-time transducer, physical simulation of a physical information neural network and contrast learning of a deep memory network, completing pre-training, constructing a dynamic arbitration fusion network, inputting expert high-level characteristics and meta-task characteristics, realizing dynamic weight distribution and divergence detection, carrying out physical verification correction on divergence results based on an energy flow and coherence constraint rule bank, carrying out weighted fusion according to expert results, and evaluating and outputting through reconstruction accuracy, physical rationality and real-time indexes.

title: Two-stage simulation method of liquid forming process using flow auxiliary material
abstract: The invention discloses a two-stage simulation method of a liquid forming process using a flow auxiliary material, which comprises the steps of determining a liquid forming near net-shaped body geometric model, simplifying the cleaning of the liquid forming near net-shaped body geometric model, importing/drawing and repairing the geometric model, adding a geometric entity of a reinforcing body lamination group or a single layer in geometric modeling or simulation software, meshing/directly importing a grid, liquid forming injection simulation and the like. According to the simulation method, the technological process is decoupled into two serial stages of flow auxiliary material flow and preform impregnation, the influence of the first stage is equivalent to a high-precision pressure boundary condition and is applied to the second stage, and meanwhile, a multi-stage micro flow model driven by viscosity-capillary effect is introduced and subdivided in preform impregnation, so that the resin flow and impregnation process can be predicted more quickly and accurately from a macroscopic scale to a microscopic scale, and a reliable basis is provided for optimizing technological parameters, predicting and eliminating manufacturing defects.

title: Airport photovoltaic glare detection method based on multi-source data coupling
abstract: The application discloses an airport photovoltaic glare detection method based on multi-source data coupling, which breaks through the limitation of single model prediction through multi-source data fusion, the measured data provides a dynamic calibration standard for simulation, and the machine learning algorithm effectively compensates errors caused by fluctuation of environmental variables under physical constraint. The three-dimensional scene projection and space-time matching technology solves the problem of collaborative analysis of multi-source heterogeneous data, provides a high-precision spatial expression basis for risk assessment, and provides a high-precision spatial reference for coupling subsequent physical simulation and measured data by integrating multi-source data such as runways, taxiways, terrains, vision and flight paths, thereby reducing dependence on high-frequency field measurement.

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of semiconductor packaging, in particular to an intelligent leveling system and process for pin coplanarity in high-density QFN packaging, comprising the following steps: the method comprises the steps of constructing a theoretical model based on element design data, acquiring multi-dimensional scanning data of a QFN element by using a multi-dimensional scanner, constructing a physical simulation model by combining physical properties of materials, comparing the physical simulation model with the theoretical model to obtain an initial difference sequence, generating an initial correction instruction for the initial difference sequence by using a correction decision intelligent model, performing simulation correction on the physical simulation model to acquire an optimized final correction instruction, and finally executing the final correction instruction by using a piezoelectric actuator and circularly detecting whether the element is qualified or not. title: Intelligent heat transfer prediction method and system for heat exchanger based on deep learning
abstract: The invention discloses a heat exchanger intelligent heat transfer prediction method and system based on deep learning. The method comprises the steps of firstly obtaining input characteristic data comprising a fluid state and a heat transfer state, secondly, adopting a cascade calibration architecture to conduct prediction, utilizing a first machine learning model to generate an initial heat transfer performance predicted value, utilizing a second machine learning model to predict and correct a predicted residual of the initial heat transfer performance predicted value, obtaining a high-precision final predicted value after superposition of the initial heat transfer performance predicted value and the predicted residual of the second machine learning model, and finally, generating an operation parameter adjustment scheme which takes heat transfer efficiency and energy consumption into consideration through a multi-objective optimization algorithm based on the final predicted value and flow resistance data. The invention solves the problems of low prediction precision, incapability of balancing optimization and poor adaptability of the prior art by combining physical simulation with AI, cascading residual error calibration, dynamic balancing optimization and self-adaptive updating mechanism, and remarkably improves the prediction precision, decision scientificity and reliability of long-term operation of the system.

title: Three-dimensional dynamic simulation method and system for whole tunnel blasting process
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of three-dimensional simulation, in particular to a three-dimensional dynamic simulation method and system for the whole process of tunnel blasting. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a three-dimensional set counting model of a tunnel, identifying a high-risk geometrical region of the tunnel in the three-dimensional set counting model of the tunnel, constructing a space blasting constraint field covering blasted rock mass based on the high-risk geometrical region of the tunnel, reversely planning an ideal blasting drilling path, deducing a blasting energy sequence according to the ideal blasting drilling path, executing rock damage dynamics blasting simulation by taking the ideal blasting drilling path as a boundary condition, evaluating drilling layout correction parameters for correcting undermining risks, and applying the drilling layout correction parameters to a preset tunnel blasting scheme to obtain an optimized tunnel blasting scheme. According to the invention, by constructing the space blasting constraint field, the accurate dynamic simulation of the non-circular tunnel blasting process is realized, so that the problem of the super-undermining prediction misalignment of the key position of the complex section is solved.

title: Water supply network hydraulic model calibration and leakage positioning method and system
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent water affairs and urban water supply system informatization, in particular to a water supply network hydraulic model calibration and leakage positioning method and system, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring pressure and flow data of a plurality of monitoring points in a network in real time; the method comprises the steps of driving a hydraulic model to conduct real-time simulation by taking the hydraulic model as a boundary condition, calculating a theoretical value, calculating residual errors of the theoretical value and the actual value of a monitoring point, judging a trigger model calibration event or a leakage suspicion event based on a residual error abnormal mode, inverting and updating a model global parameter through an optimization algorithm to achieve self calibration if the calibration is triggered, determining a suspicion area if the leakage is triggered, and accurately positioning a leakage pipe section through simulation and correlation analysis. According to the invention, the model can adapt to the change of the pipe network system through the closed-loop feedback of the real-time data and the model, so that the dynamic self-calibration of the hydraulic model of the water supply pipe network is realized, and the problem of the precision attenuation of the traditional static model is solved.

title: CFD-based cultivation pool set pollution discharge efficiency prediction method

title: PINN-based proxy modeling using local turbulence estimation
abstract: Systems and methods use physical information neural networks (FINNs) and Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) to optimize hydrodynamic modeling. The DNN is trained to create a data driven map of invariant and reynolds stress tensors associated with the fluid field based on the simulation data. The FINN is trained using the Reynolds stress tensor correction term derived from the mapping and invariants and tensors derived from the estimated flow field variables using the loss based on the Navier-Stokes and continuity equations. The FINN inputs include boundary conditions, as well as the spatiotemporal coordinates of the sampling points in the fluid flow field, which describe the time evolution of turbulence problems depending on the geometric boundaries of the flow field.

title: Runner blade optimization method and runner of mixed-flow water turbine
abstract: The application provides a runner blade optimization method and runner of a mixed flow turbine, the method comprises the steps of establishing a full-runner three-dimensional model of an overflow component of the mixed flow turbine in a water flow direction, selecting a mixed turbulence model, setting boundary conditions to obtain simulation results of the runner under different design working conditions and critical working conditions, determining a core loss area for restricting maximum output, setting meridian plane parameters, airfoil section parameters and space distortion parameters of the runner blade according to the positions of the core loss area, respectively establishing a parameterized model of the runner blade based on a plurality of groups of blade parameters, comparing and analyzing the simulation results of the parameterized models under the same working condition, screening target blade parameters with high correlation with the maximum output, and optimizing the runner blade based on the target blade parameters to improve the maximum output of the mixed flow turbine. The optimization method provided by the application solves the problems of insufficient flow field coupling consideration, limited parameterized modeling dimension, single optimization target and the like.

title: Satellite multi-physical-field prediction method and system based on structured self-supervision training
abstract: The invention discloses a satellite multi-physical-field prediction method and system based on structured self-supervision training. The method includes providing a satellite dataset, providing a progressive predictive network model of a "branch-trunk" structure, and performing structured self-supervised training. The progressive prediction network model takes a high-fidelity reference field as a starting point, plans a path according to the parameter variation amplitude, and iteratively outputs a physical field prediction result. Meanwhile, in the reasoning process, an external reference field with high fidelity can be accessed according to a new working condition or a high-reliability requirement scene, so that the local prediction accuracy is improved. The system comprises a data preparation module, a model training module and a progressive prediction module. The method and the system can obviously improve the prediction speed and the prediction precision of satellite multi-physical-field prediction, and solve the core technical problem of error accumulation in long-range and multi-step prediction tasks of the conventional AI proxy model.

abstract: A method for improving a system model includes selecting a continuous-time model that includes numerically constant model parameters and time-varying variables; selecting an objective function; selecting from the model parameters a set of model parameters whose numerically constant values are to be estimated; selecting a data acquisition system to supply data for model operation and for estimation of the numerically constant values of the set of model parameters. title: Optimization method and system for turbines of thermal power unit based on sparse big data mining
abstract: An optimization method for turbines of a thermal power unit based on sparse big data mining in the technical field of turbine optimization. title: Equivalent analysis method, system, medium and electronic equipment for high-temperature superconducting cable
abstract: The invention discloses a high-temperature superconducting cable equivalent analysis method, a system, a medium and electronic equipment, which relate to the technical field of power devices and superconducting transmission and comprise the following steps of collecting a structural characteristic parameter set of a high-temperature superconducting cable, constructing a first equivalent circuit model based on the structural characteristic parameter set, adopting a multi-factor influence separation method to carry out cross commonality screening on material parameters to obtain the first equivalent parameter set, constructing a first coupling model based on the first equivalent parameter set, applying disturbance signals with different frequencies to carry out fault simulation to obtain a working condition equivalent model, extracting transient response data based on the working condition equivalent model, identifying transient quench response characteristics of the high-temperature superconducting cable based on the transient response data, constructing a multi-objective optimization function based on the transient quench response characteristics, optimizing control parameters by adopting an NSGA-III algorithm to obtain an optimal control strategy, and solving the problems that the high quench expansion risk of the high-temperature superconducting cable is difficult to regulate in time under transient faults.

title: Calculation method and system for equivalent heat conductivity coefficient of electric propulsion motor winding
abstract: The invention discloses a method and a system for calculating equivalent heat conductivity coefficients of an electric propulsion motor winding, and relates to the field of electric propulsion motor temperature field calculation, wherein the method for calculating the equivalent heat conductivity coefficients of the electric propulsion motor winding comprises the following steps of dividing the winding into a multi-unit circular structure according to the arrangement state of the whole winding in the electric propulsion motor in a groove; according to boundary conditions in the multi-unit circular structure, solving the temperature rise of each subdomain, solving the total temperature rise of the multi-unit circular structure, enabling the whole winding to be equivalent to a circular heating body, enabling the total temperature rise of the multi-unit circular structure to be the temperature rise of the circular heating body, and calculating to obtain the equivalent heat conductivity coefficient of the whole winding. The winding equivalent model based on the analysis method provided by the invention has the advantages that the winding temperature is more accurate, and the method also provides references for temperature solving of other types of motors.

abstract: The invention provides a particle filtering method based on state track clustering similarity and application thereof, comprising the steps of S1, initializing, S2, assuming prior probability density distribution as an importance probability density function, namely proposing distribution to guide particles to conduct sequential importance sampling, further recursively calculating importance weights of sampled particles, S3, combining a system real state and sampled particle state track consistency principle, conducting similarity measurement on current filtering and future multi-stage Gaussian filtering prediction measurement information by utilizing a data mining idea-clustering analysis method, S4, modifying proposition distribution in S2 by utilizing the similarity measurement of the step S3, S5, updating importance weight calculation in sequential importance sampling in the step S2 through the proposition distribution modified in the step S4, normalizing the particle weights, further obtaining an estimated value of the system state at the current moment, and S6, repeating the steps S2-S5, and sequentially outputting estimated values of the system state at different moments. title: Method, system and device for detecting state of tobacco storage cabinet
abstract: The invention discloses a method, a system and a device for detecting the state of a tobacco storage cabinet, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting at least one cabinet body image corresponding to a target tobacco storage cabinet; the method comprises the steps of constructing an empty cabinet environment model corresponding to a target tobacco storage cabinet by using a preset nerve radiation field modeling tool based on a cabinet body image, simulating tobacco by using a pre-trained discrete element model based on tobacco parameters corresponding to the cabinet body image to generate a dynamic mask image corresponding to the target tobacco storage cabinet in the empty cabinet environment model, detecting state characteristics of the dynamic mask image to obtain characteristic parameters corresponding to the target tobacco storage cabinet, and determining the material state of the target tobacco storage cabinet based on the characteristic parameters. By means of the technical means of combining physical simulation and visual generation, the high-precision identification and error-proof control of the state of the tobacco storage cabinet in the cross-equipment environment are realized, and the accuracy, stability and efficiency of detecting the material state of the tobacco storage cabinet are improved.

title: Vehicle fault simulation monitoring terminal system based on virtual reality technology
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of vehicle fault monitoring, and discloses a vehicle fault simulation monitoring terminal system based on a virtual reality technology, which comprises a modeling device, sensing equipment, a data transmission device and virtual reality equipment, wherein the modeling device is used for acquiring a vehicle fault; the system comprises a modeling device, a sensing device, a data transmission device and a virtual reality device, wherein the modeling device is used for generating a three-dimensional digital model of a vehicle, the sensing device is arranged on the vehicle and used for collecting state data of the vehicle in real time, the data transmission device is used for transmitting the state data collected by the sensor to the virtual reality device, and the virtual reality device is used for displaying the state data of the vehicle in the three-dimensional digital model and carrying out fault monitoring based on the state data. The invention realizes the real-time remote monitoring of the vehicle state, improves the accuracy and timeliness of the vehicle fault detection and reduces the maintenance cost. Meanwhile, due to the application of the virtual reality equipment, a user can intuitively know the running state and the fault condition of the vehicle in the virtual environment, and monitoring intuitiveness and user experience are improved.

title: Digital twin simulation platform for acoustic wave rain-increasing meteorological condition response of river basin
abstract: The invention discloses a watershed-oriented acoustic rain-increasing meteorological condition response digital twin simulation platform which comprises the steps of constructing a three-dimensional space lower boundary condition with physical reality, continuously receiving a multi-source meteorological observation data stream, generating a meteorological initial field and boundary conditions through data preprocessing and multi-source data fusion, coupling a non-static mesoscale meteorological model and a double-parameter cloud micro-physical parameterization scheme, outputting four-dimensional space-time distribution data, dynamically correcting the double-parameter cloud micro-physical parameterization scheme by utilizing the output of a solution acoustic wave propagation equation based on a micro-physical model, iteratively adjusting acoustic wave parameter combinations according to a preset rain-increasing objective function by adopting a global optimization algorithm and a deep neural network proxy model, and outputting optimal acoustic wave parameter combinations and corresponding predicted rain-increasing effects. The invention can realize the full-process simulation with high fidelity, reveal the sound wave-cloud interaction mechanism, and promote the applicability and economic benefit of the sound wave rain increasing technology in the actual river basin water resource management.

title: Variational physical information neural network solving method based on self-companion operator functional constraint
abstract: The invention discloses a solution method of a variational physical information neural network based on self-companion operator functional constraint, which relates to the field of intersection of neural networks and scientific computation, and comprises the steps of S1, constructing an energy functional which directly associates energy with a differential equation constraint term by means of symmetrical conservation characteristics of the self-companion operator based on preset boundary conditions and initial conditions, wherein each component of the energy functional is mapped with a corresponding physical field quantity in a differential equation one by one, the physical field comprises a diffusion coefficient and a convection speed, S2, verifying the correctness of the energy functional constructed in S1, and S3, substituting the verified energy functional into the variational physical information neural network for iterative training. According to the invention, functional constraints are introduced into the variational physical information neural network, so that the cooperative satisfaction of the neural network on the 'equation-boundary-functional' multi-constraints can be regulated and controlled more accurately, and the overall accuracy and the spatial stability of the solution are improved.

title: Mine sector medium-length hole rock blasting numerical simulation method based on Lsdyna and HYPERMESH
abstract: The invention discloses a mine sector medium-length hole rock blasting numerical simulation method based on Lsdyna and HYPERMESH, which comprises the steps of firstly constructing a three-dimensional numerical model by utilizing CAD and SOLIWORKS software, then carrying out grid division and optimization by HYPERMESH software, and finally setting a material structure, a fluid-solid coupling algorithm and boundary conditions in LSDYNA software to complete numerical simulation. The invention solves the difficult problems of complex model construction and grid division through multi-software cooperation, improves simulation efficiency and accuracy, and provides theoretical support for mine blasting parameter optimization.

title: Optimization method of FPSO super-heavy type module structure based on offshore floating hoisting
abstract: The invention discloses an optimization method of an ultra-heavy type FPSO module structure based on offshore floating hoisting, which belongs to the technical field of FPSO ultra-heavy type module structure optimization, and comprises the following steps of S1, establishing an ultra-heavy type module overall structure model, S2, establishing an ultra-heavy type module overall quality model, S3, establishing an ultra-heavy type module floating hoisting model, S4, calculating equivalent loads under the action of various load couplings, S5, obtaining boundary conditions of the module structure floating hoisting, S6, calculating stress distribution of the ultra-heavy type module overall structure, and S7, strengthening the structure of the ultra-heavy type module overall structure. By implementing refined structural strength calculation and key part optimization design, the method can realize advanced pre-judgment and prevention control of potential failure modes in the floating type hoisting process, improve the safety of floating type hoisting of the extra-heavy type module, reduce the risks of structural failure and accidents, and protect the safety of personnel and the environment.

title: Battery thermal management optimization method and device
abstract: The application provides a battery thermal management optimization method and device. The method is applied to a collaborative platform, the collaborative platform comprises a physical simulation platform, an intelligent optimization platform, an intelligent processing platform and an acquisition control platform, the physical simulation platform takes preprocessed data as simulation parameters, executes battery thermoelectric coupling simulation to obtain simulation results of battery thermoelectric coupling simulation, the intelligent optimization platform adjusts the simulation parameters according to the simulation results to obtain adjusted simulation parameters, the intelligent optimization platform calls the physical simulation platform to conduct one or more times of iterative simulation of battery thermoelectric coupling according to the adjusted simulation parameters to obtain optimized parameters, the intelligent processing platform conducts post-processing on the optimized parameters to obtain control parameters, the acquisition control platform conducts logic verification on the control parameters and transmits the control parameters to a test system to conduct battery charging test, and overall efficiency of battery thermal management optimization is improved.

title: Modeling method and system for cement industry whole-flow production considering energy flow-material flow
abstract: The invention discloses a modeling method and a modeling system for cement industry whole-flow production taking energy flow-material flow into account, which belong to the technical field of cement industry and comprise the steps of constructing a modeling structure for covering cement production flow, respectively constructing a modeling module for describing material behaviors and a modeling module for describing the energy behaviors, respectively connecting coupling models of all the process units according to the process flow sequence, setting output variables of an upstream process unit as input boundary conditions of a downstream process unit, constructing a cross-unit continuous modeling structure, constructing a dynamic simulation system comprising a time stepping calculation mechanism based on the modeling structure, and updating the material and energy state variables by time by the simulation system to realize joint description of energy distribution and material evolution process in the cement production flow. According to the invention, through full-flow coupling modeling, parameters of each link can be dynamically adjusted, so that the total energy consumption of the system is minimum, and the global optimal energy efficiency is realized.

title: Digital twin and AI-based platform door intelligent simulation training system
abstract: The invention discloses a platform door intelligent simulation training system based on digital twinning and AI, and belongs to the technical field of rail transit training. The invention discloses a platform door intelligent simulation training system based on digital twinning and AI, which comprises a system architecture module, a hardware composition module, a software composition module and a core function module. The invention solves the problems that the existing platform door training mode depends on physical equipment, has single function, is difficult to simulate a complex fault scene and lacks intelligent teaching assistance, realizes high-precision control by constructing a hardware and software collaborative simulation training system and adopting a three-layer distributed control architecture, combines digital twin technology 1:1 to restore the structure and the running state of a real platform door, integrates AI voice interaction and a professional knowledge base, supports fault simulation, principle teaching, actual operation exercise and intelligent question answering, effectively improves the immersion sense, interactivity and teaching efficiency of training, and meets the urgent demands of modern rail transit on specialized and intelligent training.

title: Automatic generation method and system for modular design of AI-driven curtain wall
abstract: The application discloses an automatic generation method and system for AI-driven curtain wall modularized design, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining real-time state data of a main structure to construct and update a built state digital twin model; the method comprises the steps of extracting transient boundary conditions of a module to be installed from the model, inputting the boundary conditions into an adaptive design generation model to generate adaptive adjustment parameters, correcting a standardized digital model by the parameters, generating an adaptive module digital model which is accurately matched with a built-up state structure, and converting the adaptive module digital model into manufacturing instructions to be output. According to the application, through automatic real-time design adjustment, the problem of curtain wall installation conflict caused by dynamic deformation of a main body structure is solved, accurate matching of a prefabricated component and an actual structure interface is realized, the construction efficiency and the construction quality are improved, and the construction cost is reduced.

title: Dynamic scene generation method and device
abstract: The application relates to the technical field of virtual scene generation and discloses a dynamic scene generation method and device, wherein the method comprises the steps of modeling a multi-view scene image based on three-dimensional Gaussian splatter and establishing an object geometric model of a target scene; the method comprises the steps of carrying out surface Gaussian point cloud analysis on an object geometric model, sampling to obtain a simulation driving point used for simulating a target scene, constructing a driving framework of the target scene according to the simulation driving point, mapping deformation of the driving framework to deformation of a three-dimensional Gaussian kernel through deformation physical simulation to obtain a dynamic framework of the target scene, and rendering the dynamic framework to generate a corresponding dynamic scene.

title: Physical simulation experiment system, method and equipment based on geological structure
abstract: The invention discloses a physical simulation experiment system, a physical simulation experiment method and physical simulation experiment equipment based on a geological structure, and relates to the technical field of geological structures. Obtaining relevant geological data, geometric parameters, kinematic parameters and lithology parameters of a simulation area to be researched, constructing a sand box physical model of the simulation area to be researched by adopting a similarity constitutive relation method, determining the size of the sand box physical model, the size of magnetic fluid, the thickness of an overlying sand body and the range of the overlying sand body according to the relevant geological data, obtaining the magnetic fluid sand box physical model in an environment with zero magnetic field intensity, then adjusting the magnetic field intensity to a first preset intensity value to obtain the overlying sand box physical model, obtaining shear stress and yield stress, obtaining stratum viscosity relation according to the shear stress and the yield stress, and using the stratum viscosity relation to represent a physical simulation experiment result based on geological structures. The invention improves the accuracy and reliability of the physical simulation experiment data of the geological structure and greatly reduces the experiment consumable cost and the time cost.

title: Dynamic magnetic coupling structure design method
abstract: The invention provides a dynamic magnetic coupling structure design method, which comprises the steps of determining a magnetic core model according to output power/secondary voltage and calculating an AP value of a constraint magnetic core, establishing a three-dimensional geometric model of a magnetic coupling coil, dispersing a solving domain in the three-dimensional geometric model through grids, conducting encryption/sparseness operation on the grids according to error values, setting boundary conditions according to actual working conditions, conducting iterative solution, controlling convergence accuracy within 10  ‑6  in the iterative process, keeping the AP value of the constraint magnetic core unchanged, and maximizing a coupling coefficient by changing the cross-section area and window area of the magnetic core, so that transmission efficiency is optimal. The automatic charging device is used for solving the problems of high cost, severe requirements on AGV charging coils and coil arrangement on a driving path and complex charging path of the dynamic wireless charging technology in the prior art.

title: Microdischarge inhibition method based on microdischarge causes
abstract: S1, continuously testing an insulating medium under different voltage levels and frequencies to obtain the relation between parameter changes and micro-discharge, wherein the method has the beneficial effects that the numerical relation between the parameter changes and the micro-discharge is accurately obtained by continuously testing the insulating medium under different voltage levels and frequencies and recording related parameter changes in detail, so that a rich and accurate data basis is provided for deep analysis of the micro-discharge causes, scientific understanding of a micro-discharge generation mechanism is facilitated, and a powerful support is provided for formulating an effective inhibition strategy; the ANSYS I CEPAK software is utilized to perform physical field simulation processing on a plurality of key aspects of the high-voltage power supply, physical parameters and boundary conditions are reasonably set, the physical field distribution condition of the high-voltage power supply in an actual working state is simulated, and the recording simulation result provides important data support for the subsequent analysis of the relationship between the micro-discharge phenomenon and the power supply parameters.

title: DLL simulation interface conforming and fault injection method for reuse carrier
abstract: The invention relates to a DLL simulation interface conforming and fault injection method for a reusable carrier. The method comprises the steps of 1, automatically identifying parameter types and pointer marks through analyzing DLL function interface definitions, generating standardized parameter configuration, and constructing a unified DLL simulation container through designating input and output ports. 2. The initialization dynamic loading, single step execution and resource release of the DLL function are achieved by predefined start, step, stop functions. 3. Support for fault function hot switching based on external signals. The invention solves the problems of complex interface adaptation and insufficient safety in the traditional DLL integration, can be widely applied to embedded system simulation, hardware in-loop test and third-party closed source assembly integration scenes, and remarkably improves the flexibility, testability and safety of a simulation system.

title: SBFEM-based analysis method for structural foundation interaction of regional non-uniform foundation gravity dam
abstract: The invention discloses a method for analyzing structural foundation interaction of a partitioned non-uniform foundation gravity dam based on SBFEM, which realizes fine simulation of seismic wave propagation, reflection and energy dissipation processes under the condition of the partitioned non-uniform foundation through coupling modeling of a proportional boundary finite element method and a finite element method, avoids calculation deviation caused by simplifying boundary conditions or neglecting material non-uniformity in the traditional method, establishes a finite element model containing a layered foundation by utilizing general finite element software in the analysis process, realizes SBFEM core algorithm solution by programming software, and finally completes convolution integral and dynamic response analysis in a numerical calculation software platform to form a complete and efficient dynamic response analysis system. The earthquake response spectrum output by the method can truly reflect the dynamic characteristics under the coupling action of the foundation and the structure, has clear calculation logic and standard operation flow, and can effectively avoid the problem of analysis result distortion caused by oversimplification or conservation of the assumed conditions.

title: Device and method for simulating hydraulic fracturing of multi-horizontal well of shale in stratum based on real-time CT scanning
abstract: A simulated device and a simulated method for hydraulic fracturing of a multi-horizontal well of a shale in a stratum based on real-time CT scanning are used for obtaining a fracture form under the condition of construction parameters by adopting different well pattern hydraulic pressure physical simulation tests on a target reservoir according to a real-time CT scanning detection system, and a construction scheme is optimized and is suitable for the simulated test of hydraulic fracturing of the shale in the stratum and engineering application.

title: Battery cooling plate design method integrating topological optimization and bionic design
abstract: The invention discloses a battery cooling plate design method integrating topological optimization and bionic design, which comprises the following steps of firstly carrying out dimension reduction treatment, taking a cooling plate neutral layer as a topological optimization design domain, setting boundary conditions, establishing a two-dimensional topological model, describing fluid flow characteristics by adopting a Brinkman model, constructing a topological optimization model with a multi-objective optimization function and volume fraction as constraint conditions, carrying out optimal design on the two-dimensional topological model, outputting the topological optimization cooling plate, analyzing flow channels of the topological optimization cooling plate, filling solid areas by using a feather-shaped structure to obtain the bionic cooling plate, calculating the flow channels of the two by adopting a box dimension method, outputting the corresponding bionic cooling plate if the box dimension difference is smaller than a set threshold, and returning to a replacement link for correction if the box dimension difference is not smaller than the set threshold until the box dimension difference is smaller than the set threshold. The invention improves the structural stability and manufacturability while guaranteeing the heat radiation performance.

title: Rapid prediction method for DNAPL pollutant migration in groundwater based on RRDB-UNet neural network
abstract: The invention discloses a rapid prediction method for DNAPL pollutant migration in groundwater based on RRDB-UNet neural network, belonging to the technical field of polluted hydrogeology. Aiming at the problems of high cost and low efficiency of two-phase flow numerical simulation calculation in a low-permeability heterogeneous medium, the method provides a U-Net deep learning structure combining a residual error intensive module and a spatial attention mechanism so as to realize efficient prediction of space-time evolution of a saturation field. The method comprises the steps of generating a random permeability field through Karhunen-Loeve expansion and embedding the random permeability field into a low-permeability lens body structure, generating saturation field time sequence data in batches by utilizing COMSOL Multiphysics simulation, constructing a RRDB-UNet neural network model and training, and realizing single-step prediction and autoregressive prediction mode output by taking the permeability field and the initial saturation field as inputs. Experimental results show that the method can remarkably improve the calculation efficiency and the prediction accuracy in the low-permeability medium two-phase flow simulation, and has wide application prospects in the fields of groundwater pollution restoration, petroleum exploitation optimization and the like.

title: Underground acoustic attenuation model construction method based on random forest machine learning algorithm
abstract: The invention discloses an underground acoustic attenuation model construction method based on a random forest machine learning algorithm, which comprises the following steps of S1, establishing an underground tubular column system three-dimensional model and converting the model into a two-dimensional axisymmetric simulation geometric model, wherein the three-dimensional model comprises an oil pipe, a base pipe, a sleeve, a packer, a reducing coupling and an acoustic wave generator, S2, setting acoustic-solid coupling physical field parameters, material properties, grid parameters, boundary conditions and acoustic source excitation based on the simulation geometric model, executing parameterization scanning simulation on a plurality of structural parameters to generate a simulation data set containing sound pressure level and frequency data, S3, extracting sample points by using Latin hypercube sampling based on the simulation data set and carrying out standardization processing, dividing the sample points into a training data set and a test data set, and S4, constructing the model based on the training data set by using a random forest algorithm and optimizing the super parameters through grid search to generate an underground acoustic attenuation prediction model. The prediction model can quickly respond to the performance prediction requirements of different well structure designs.
relevance_reason: 地下音響減衰モデル。構造パラメータのパラメータ化走査シミュレーションでデータセットを生成しML訓練(地下分野)

title: Near-field fluctuation numerical simulation method based on physical driving deep learning
abstract: The invention relates to a near-field fluctuation numerical simulation method based on physical driving deep learning, which comprises a sampling step, a training step and a simulation step, wherein in the sampling step, space-time sampling points are acquired by a Sobol sequence algorithm, in the training step, an artificial neural network model and a loss function are constructed, an optimizer mode is optimized, and in the simulation step, the trained artificial neural network is adopted to predict a fluctuation equation solution of near-field fluctuation of any space-time point under any resolution and each order of partial derivative of the solution. The invention has the advantages of no grid, refinement, full transmission of wave field side boundary and the like, and aiming at typical working conditions, the neural network formed by training has generalization capability under different initial conditions, and can effectively improve the training efficiency of the network by combining migration learning.

title: Semi-physical simulation method and system based on FPGA neural network control method
abstract: The invention discloses a semi-physical simulation method and a semi-physical simulation system based on an FPGA (field programmable gate array) neural network control method, wherein an aircraft dynamics model is operated at a simulation end, state variables such as attitude angle, speed, angular rate and the like are transmitted to the FPGA end in real time through Socket communication, a fixed-point neural network controller is arranged at the FPGA end, control instructions are inferred in a parallel flow mode and are transmitted back to the simulation end through a TCP/IP (transmission control protocol/Internet protocol) protocol, the system realizes zero-copy data transmission by adopting a PS-PL (packet switched protocol) cooperative bus, hardware-level inference acceleration is realized by combining a Vitis HLS and a PYNQ framework, and communication delay is smaller than 400 mu s. Through closed loop verification, the FPGA reasoning result and floating point simulation error is smaller than 4.5 multiplied by 10  ‑5 , and microsecond real-time response and high consistency of a flight control algorithm are realized.

title: Rare event sensitivity calculation method and system for comprehensive energy system
abstract: The invention discloses a method and a system for calculating rare event sensitivity of a comprehensive energy system, which sequentially establish a probability energy flow model of the comprehensive energy system, establish a characterization model of the rare event of the comprehensive energy system considering uncertainty of a random source model, decompose the rare event into larger probability events by adopting subset simulation, reduce the number of samples, accelerate the estimation of the rare event, lighten the calculation load, establish a multi-chaos agent model of the rare event probability, reduce the number of samples required by high-efficiency global sensitivity, and calculate the uncertain global sensitivity of the model parameters of the comprehensive energy system according to the rare event probability.

title: Heat supply pipe network analysis solving method and system based on frequency spectrum decomposition
abstract: The invention provides a heat supply pipe network analytic solution method and system based on spectrum decomposition, which belong to the technical field of heat supply simulation and comprise the steps of constructing and solving a primary network water supply matrix operation model based on a heat supply pipe network topological structure to obtain primary network water supply temperature, constructing an analytic response model based on a secondary network multi-node structure, performing spectrum decomposition on the primary network water supply temperature to obtain harmonic components serving as sine boundary conditions, obtaining analytic solution temperature of a secondary network first node by utilizing a characteristic equation and the sine boundary conditions of the analytic response model, and constructing and solving a primary network backwater and CHP inlet temperature calculation model based on the primary network water supply temperature and the analytic solution temperature of the secondary network first node to obtain primary network backwater temperature and CHP inlet temperature. According to the invention, the integral solution of the whole process of primary network water supply, secondary network heat exchange and primary network water return is realized from the viewpoint of heat flow, so that the whole process of the heat supply network is efficiently simulated.

title: Medical operation training system based on virtual simulation technology
abstract: The invention discloses a medical operation training system based on a virtual simulation technology, which relates to the technical field of medical simulation training, and comprises a simulation human model, a training project management platform and a training program management system, wherein the simulation human model is used for simulating the physiological state of a patient and detecting operation data, the simulation human model comprises a pressure sensing unit arranged at a chest pressing position, an air flow sensing unit arranged at a circuit board position of a waist and a Bluetooth sensing unit, and the training project management platform comprises a virtual scene display module, wherein the virtual scene display module is used for generating a virtual scene and a virtual patient which are synchronous with the physiological state of the simulation human model in real time. According to the medical operation training system, by innovatively fusing the virtual simulation and the physical simulation technology, the effect and the practicability of medical operation training are remarkably improved, the physical simulation human model is utilized to accurately simulate the physiological state of a patient, the near-real tactile feedback is provided, the problem of insufficient realism of the operation feedback in the pure virtual simulation is solved, the immersion of a learner is enhanced, and the training cost is reduced.

title: Full flight profile test evaluation method based on virtual-real combined flight control simulation
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of semi-physical simulation, and particularly relates to a full flight profile test evaluation method based on virtual-real combined flight control simulation, which comprises the following steps of 1, constructing a semi-physical system topology architecture; step 2, developing full flight profile test evaluation based on virtual-real combined flight control simulation based on the constructed topological structure of the semi-physical subsystem; the invention can be obviously superior to the traditional method in terms of safety, cost effectiveness and efficiency through the integration of the virtual simulation with high confidence and the physical subsystem. The method can provide more diversified testing environments, reduce the requirements of actual flight testing, reduce cost and risk, and improve the accuracy and depth of data acquisition and analysis. This approach provides a more advanced and comprehensive solution for testing and evaluation of flight control systems.

title: Well distributed optical fiber and surface detector data combined full-waveform inversion modeling method
abstract: The invention discloses a well distributed optical fiber and surface wave detector data combined full-waveform inversion modeling method, which relates to the technical field of exploration geophysics and comprises the steps of establishing a pressure-strain rate equation, obtaining input data, simulating and calculating a strain rate and a pressure wave field based on the pressure-strain rate equation, simultaneously obtaining data synthesized by a wave detector and DAS, constructing a well-ground combined inversion target functional, using an accompanying state method to derive the target functional to obtain an accompanying source, loading the accompanying source to a physical component corresponding to the pressure-strain rate equation to serve as a boundary condition to carry out counter-transmission to obtain an accompanying wave field, carrying out cross-correlation on a positive transmission synthetic wave field of the pressure and the accompanying wave field to obtain a velocity gradient, further calculating energy distribution of the seismic wave field to construct an illumination item, and carrying out iterative updating on model parameters by using an optimization algorithm to realize well-ground combined full-waveform inversion. The method of the invention can greatly improve inversion precision, stability and reliability while guaranteeing data physical consistency.
relevance_reason: 坑井-地表結合フルウェーブフォームインバージョン、境界条件。地球物理逆解析手法

title: PINN proxy model construction method based on inaccurate sparse sampling information
abstract: The invention discloses a PINN agent model construction method based on inaccurate sparse sampling information, which particularly relates to the field of physical field reconstruction, and comprises the steps of performing sparse sampling on a coarse grid result with lower calculation cost or reading data possibly with deviation from a small number of sensors, forming sparse inaccurate tag data, normalizing the sparse inaccurate tag data, simultaneously carrying out equivalent normalization on physical information by utilizing normalization parameters of the tag data, wherein the physical information is expressed through a control equation and boundary conditions, constructing a physical information neural network based on a physical model of a current problem, constructing a data residual on the sparse inaccurate tag data, multiplying a trainable parameter for describing the reliability of the data residual and correcting in a training process, constructing the physical information residual at more dense structured nodes, and training the neural network to obtain an agent model of a corresponding physical field, thereby realizing efficient reconstruction of any resolution and local detail of the physical field.

title: Heat supply pipe network heat loss real-time monitoring and energy efficiency evaluation system
abstract: The application belongs to the technical field of heat loss monitoring of a heat pipe network, and discloses a heat loss real-time monitoring and energy efficiency evaluation system of a heat supply pipe network, which comprises a temperature measurement unit, a heat loss calculation unit, a contribution degree determination unit, an energy efficiency dynamic evaluation unit and a visual display unit; the heat loss calculation unit can take the temperature data set as a boundary condition to be substituted into a pre-constructed finite element model, and calculate the additional heating loss power directly caused by the bracket based on the actual total heat dissipation. According to the application, by calculating and processing the heating loss of the bracket part, the energy efficiency evaluation result of the heating pipe network is more real and comprehensive, unprecedented data support is provided for accurate energy conservation, and the technical problems that the temperature field gradient is large and the traditional sparse distribution point is difficult to accurately measure under a complex structure are solved.

title: River and lake composite system hydrodynamic modeling method based on machine learning
abstract: The embodiment of the application provides a river and lake composite system hydrodynamic modeling method based on machine learning, wherein boundary conditions of a one-dimensional hydrodynamic model provide input for machine learning, and output of the machine learning provides complex boundary conditions and downstream boundary conditions at a river and lake junction for the one-dimensional hydrodynamic model. The method improves the operation efficiency of hydrodynamic force simulation of the river and lake composite system, can quickly calculate the water level and flow of the important section position of the river and lake composite system, simultaneously reduces the requirement on topography data, does not need to input complex lake topography elevation survey data, and can effectively improve the water level simulation precision of the section near the downstream boundary.
relevance_reason: 河川-湖沼水理ML境界条件モデリング。物理+ML手法

title: Multi-axis machining physical simulation method based on matrix mapping
abstract: The invention discloses a multi-axis machining physical simulation method based on matrix mapping, which comprises the steps of firstly dispersing and mapping a cutter cutting edge and a cutter-workpiece cutting contact area with any shape into a unified two-dimensional matrix coordinate system to generate a cutter edge position matrix and a cutting contact area matrix, then calculating the instantaneous cutting thickness of each discrete point in the cutting contact area by analyzing complex kinematics of multi-axis machining to generate a cutting thickness matrix, finally determining effective cutting edge points by combining three matrixes at each moment of simulating cutter rotation, inputting relevant cutting parameters into a calculation model, predicting physical simulation parameters such as micro-element force, cutting temperature and the like according to characteristics such as cutting thickness and finally obtaining physical simulation parameters in a required coordinate space after coordinate transformation and synthesis. The method can rapidly and accurately predict the multi-axis machining physical simulation parameters in any complex cutting contact area, and has the advantages of strong geometric processing capability, good modularization and universality and high calculation efficiency.
