title: Metamaterial structure design method based on artificial intelligence generation model
abstract: The invention discloses a metamaterial structure design method based on an artificial intelligence generation model, which comprises the steps of constructing a mapping framework from multi-granularity text description to a physical field, injecting physical constraint into a diffusion generation network through LoRA fine tuning, converting the text description into the physical field, utilizing hypergraph neural network modeling field to divide high-order interaction among fields, taking optimized physical field representation as a structure generation network input by boundary conditions, and generating a metamaterial structure which keeps strict consistency with a target physical field. Besides the method and the device can meet the requirement of inputting multi-granularity text description and generating a metamaterial structural design, the cascading characteristics of the framework can directly receive a physical field as input, so that the application scene of structural replacement is met, for example, the structural design consisting of materials which are difficult to process or high in processing cost is replaced by the structural design consisting of materials which are easy to process and lower in cost.
relevance_reason: AI生成モデルによるメタマテリアル設計、物理制約境界条件。生成的設計手法だがレアイベント生成ではない

title: Modeling method for photon transmission mechanism of optical fiber cone-CMOS coupling system
abstract: The invention discloses a modeling method of a photon transmission mechanism of an optical fiber cone-CMOS coupling system, which belongs to the technical field of physical simulation, and comprises the steps of constructing an optical fiber cone-CMOS coupling system model and initializing parameters; the optical fiber light cone-CMOS coupling system comprises a light source, an optical fiber light cone and a CMOS sensor, wherein the model is used for generating and tracking light rays, performing light ray-object intersection simulation test, calculating the transmittance of the optical fiber light cone and counting the spatial distribution and the energy distribution of photons on the surface of the CMOS sensor based on the light ray-object intersection simulation test result. The invention can explore the influence of different taper ratios and taper lengths on the light transmission characteristics of the optical fiber taper and the photon distribution rule on the CMOS sensor, thereby providing theoretical basis and method support for optimizing the structural design of the optical fiber taper-CMOS sensor coupling system and improving the coupling efficiency.
relevance_reason: 光ファイバーコーン-CMOS光子伝搬モデリング。光学物理シミュレーション

title: Equi-geometric analysis-based method for calculating multidirectional stress of composite material laminated plate
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of composite material simulation, and provides a method for calculating the directional stress of a composite material laminated plate based on isogeometric analysis, which comprises the steps of establishing a mapping relation between a physical model and a spline surface based on the size of the composite material laminated plate, establishing a displacement strain relation of the composite material laminated plate through a high-order shear deformation function, establishing a stress strain relation of the composite material laminated plate through a constitutive equation, the displacement of a control point on the composite material laminated plate is solved and obtained by applying boundary conditions, adopting an isogeometric analysis method and a virtual work principle and a discrete balance equation, and the stress distribution in the plate thickness direction of the composite material laminated plate is obtained by a displacement strain relation, a constitutive equation and a high-order shear deformation function, so that the stress calculation of the composite material laminated plate is completed. The method has the advantages of high solving efficiency, accurate obtained stress value, small simulation calculation amount and great significance for evaluating the structural strength of the composite material.
relevance_reason: 複合材積層板応力の等幾何解析、境界条件。構造計算手法

title: Gas turbine performance quantitative evaluation method and system based on blade tip abrasion
abstract: The embodiment of the application provides a quantitative evaluation method and a quantitative evaluation system for turbine performance of a gas turbine based on blade tip abrasion, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining turbine geometric parameters of a target gas turbine, constructing a turbine three-dimensional model based on the geometric parameters, establishing a dynamic association relation of random group operation time length changes of cold blade tip clearances of turbine blades based on periodical overhaul actual measurement data, establishing a numerical calculation grid based on the turbine three-dimensional model, setting multi-load working condition boundary conditions, determining operation thermal deformation amounts of the turbine blades under different loads corresponding to the unit operation time length through multi-physical field coupling numerical calculation, determining hot blade tip clearances with different operation time lengths based on the dynamic association relation and the operation thermal deformation amounts, constructing a turbine numerical calculation model corresponding to the operation time length and the load working conditions based on the hot blade tip clearances, comparing the performance parameters of the different blade tip clearances under the same boundary conditions, and quantifying the influence of the blade tip abrasion on the turbine performance.
relevance_reason: ガスタービン翼先端摩耗評価、多負荷境界条件。物理性能評価目的

title: Method for determining out-of-plane model of cable structure with cross-inside lateral spring support
abstract: The invention discloses an out-of-plane model determining method of a cable structure with a lateral spring support arranged in a crossing manner, which comprises the following steps of 1) establishing a single-gear cable-multipoint spring constraint system with lateral spring constraint to obtain a general solution of an out-of-plane self-vibration model of the system, 2) establishing a local coordinate system for each cable segment to obtain a local model function of each segment of cable, 3) establishing boundary conditions, wherein the boundary conditions comprise that displacement of two ends of the cable is 0 and displacement of the spring support is continuous, 4) obtaining a model function of an arbitrary cable segment structure according to the boundary conditions in the step 3), 5) obtaining constraint conditions according to force balance at spring constraint points, 6) establishing an overrun equation by utilizing the force balance of the spring constraint points, and 7) solving the overrun equation to obtain frequency and vibration mode of the cable structure. The method provides a theoretical basis for vibration control design of the lateral restraint cable system, and remarkably reduces test and numerical simulation cost.
relevance_reason: ケーブル構造振動モデル、境界条件。構造計算手法

title: Intelligent system failure analysis method based on fault identification
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent system failure analysis method based on fault identification, which relates to the technical field of intelligent system reliability analysis, and the specific steps of the analysis method are that Modelica is adopted to construct a multi-physical-domain digital twin model, and historical data are combed to construct a structured fault mode library; the method comprises the steps of developing a fault injection algorithm to collect data to form a standardized data set, preprocessing the data to construct a causal link and a probability flow network, combing task scenes to construct a reliability assessment model and training, inputting actual parameters to trace faults to generate an optimized plan, and outputting an analysis report and the plan after verification.
relevance_reason: 知的システム故障解析。Modelicaマルチフィジックスデジタルツイン+fault injectionアルゴリズムで標準化故障データセットを構築し信頼性評価モデルを訓練。目的に合致

title: Method, system, equipment and medium for calculating diffusion distribution concentration of dissolved gas in transformer oil
abstract: The invention discloses a method, a system, equipment and a medium for calculating the diffusion distribution concentration of dissolved gas in transformer oil, which relate to the technical field of power equipment state monitoring and fault diagnosis and comprise the steps of establishing a three-dimensional dynamic transportation model of the dissolved gas in the oil in a transformer, setting initial release conditions of the three-dimensional dynamic transportation model, setting limited boundary conditions of the three-dimensional dynamic transportation model, and solving the three-dimensional dynamic transportation model by an integral transformation method to obtain a gas concentration distribution function under the instantaneous gas production source, constructing three-dimensional gas concentration distribution under the continuous gas production state by time integration based on the instantaneous gas production concentration distribution, and calculating the concentration of dissolved gas in oil by combining the fluid motion parameters in the transformer. The method realizes high-precision and high-efficiency calculation of the concentration distribution of the dissolved gas in the transformer oil, solves the problem that the traditional method cannot consider the calculation speed and the calculation precision, and provides a core technical support for real-time monitoring and digital twinning of the transformer faults.
relevance_reason: 変圧器油中ガス拡散計算、境界条件。物理計算手法

title: FCNN-based satellite electromagnetic docking process generalization simulation method
abstract: The invention discloses a satellite electromagnetic docking process generalization simulation method based on FCNN, which belongs to the field of spacecraft electromagnetic docking dynamics simulation and comprises the following steps of firstly generating magnetic field data of electromagnetic actuators of different types under random excitation current through finite element simulation, constructing and training FCNN-D models to realize prediction of input of parameters, spatial positions and currents of the actuators to magnetic field intensity, secondly collecting stress data of the actuators in an external magnetic field, constructing FCNN-F models to predict electromagnetic force/moment by taking model, pose and currents of the actuators as input, then carrying out dynamics simulation, carrying out stepping input on the force/moment calculated by FCNN-F, calculating electromagnetic force according to the current pose in each step simulation, updating Wei Xingwei poses until boundary conditions are met, and finally realizing the docking process visualization. The invention utilizes FCNN to avoid electromagnetic force/moment model, solves the defect of limited application scale of electromagnetic simulation, and obtains a full-scale and high-precision electromagnetic butt joint simulation method.
relevance_reason: 衛星電磁ドッキングFCNNシミュレーション、境界条件。物理+ML手法

title: Photovoltaic system fault modeling simulation method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract: The application relates to a photovoltaic system fault simulation method, device, equipment and medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of carrying out equivalent circuit modeling according to physical characteristic parameters of a photovoltaic module to obtain an equivalent circuit model of the photovoltaic module; performing array modeling based on a photovoltaic module equivalent circuit model to obtain a photovoltaic array model containing the characteristic of uneven parameter distribution among modules, performing fault coupling modeling according to a preset fault type and a corresponding logic relation to obtain a multi-fault coupling model, performing model coupling processing on the photovoltaic array model and the multi-fault coupling model to obtain a photovoltaic system fault model, and performing fault simulation according to the photovoltaic system fault model to obtain a photovoltaic system fault simulation result. By adopting the method, the conditions of uneven parameter distribution and multi-fault coupling among modules in the photovoltaic system can be accurately simulated, and the accuracy of fault early warning and the scientificity of operation and maintenance decisions are improved.
relevance_reason: 太陽光発電システム故障モデリングシミュレーション。モジュール間パラメータ不均一分布のマルチ故障結合シミュレーション(エネルギー分野)

title: Lithium ion battery lithium precipitation quantitative grading evaluation method based on electrochemical simplified model
abstract: The invention discloses a lithium ion battery lithium analysis quantitative grading evaluation method based on an electrochemical simplified model, which utilizes a voltage curve of the simplified electrochemical-lithium analysis model to simulate a battery under different temperatures and working conditions to determine lithium analysis conditions and lithium analysis trigger current boundary values of the battery, calculates reversible lithium analysis quantity, irreversible lithium analysis quantity and total lithium analysis quantity of the battery, takes the determined lithium analysis trigger current boundary values as initial conditions of the model, simulates lithium analysis quantity change and capacity attenuation rate in a battery circulation process, establishes association relation between lithium analysis degree and capacity attenuation rate, determines grading indexes and values of lithium ion battery lithium analysis degree, utilizes the electrochemical simplified model and the lithium analysis model to dynamically simulate and calculate the irreversible lithium analysis quantity in the battery operation process, and combines the battery capacity attenuation rate to realize the grading evaluation of lithium analysis of the battery. The invention can quickly simulate the lithium precipitation conditions and lithium precipitation amount of the battery under different working conditions, and realize automatic grading evaluation of lithium precipitation of the battery in operation.
relevance_reason: 電池リチウム析出電気化学シミュレーション、異なる作動条件下。劣化評価目的

title: Dynamic simulation test verification method and system for monitoring system of pumped storage unit
abstract: The invention discloses a dynamic simulation test verification method and system for a pumped storage unit monitoring system, which comprises the steps of establishing a high-dimensional system state matrix of the pumped storage unit based on physical parameters and structural characteristics of hydraulic, mechanical and electrical systems of the unit, performing dimension reduction treatment on the high-dimensional system state matrix to obtain a dynamic simulation model of multi-physical field coupling of the unit, constructing a multidimensional parameter space based on parameter sensitivity coefficients and working condition boundary conditions of the dynamic simulation model, calculating optimal test point distribution through a high-dimensional point flow diameter algorithm to obtain a test scene library, obtaining a real-time monitoring signal sequence conforming to a communication protocol of the monitoring system based on the dynamic simulation model and the test scene library, and testing signal acquisition, logic judgment and alarm control functions of the monitoring system through an automatic test script based on the real-time monitoring signal sequence to obtain a performance evaluation result of the monitoring system. The invention improves the comprehensiveness and effectiveness of the test of the monitoring system of the pumped storage unit.
relevance_reason: 揚水発電監視動的シミュレーション検証。作動条件境界条件からテストシーンライブラリを生成(エネルギー分野)

title: Single particle selective reinforcement method based on machine learning
abstract: The invention relates to a single particle selective reinforcement method based on machine learning. The method comprises the steps of reading basic information and structural information of triggers in a target circuit, randomly extracting part of triggers to perform fault injection, counting soft error rates and functional masking rates of the triggers to obtain a golden model, training weight factors of different features of the soft error rates and the functional masking rates through the golden model respectively, clustering all the triggers in the circuit by using K-Means classifiers with feature weights for the soft error rates and the functional masking rates respectively, and determining sensitive triggers in the circuit and selectively reinforcing the sensitive triggers by arranging products of the soft error rates and the functional masking rates. The invention reduces the number of fault injection times required by the circuit, thereby improving the efficiency and being applicable to the selective design reinforcement for coping with single-particle soft errors in the integrated circuit design.
relevance_reason: 単一粒子選択強化ML。fault injectionでソフトエラー率を取得(半導体分野)

title: Three-dimensional space field prediction method, device, equipment and medium based on large model and data compression
abstract: The application discloses a three-dimensional spatial field prediction method, device, equipment and medium based on a large model and data compression, and relates to the field of spatial field prediction. The method comprises the steps of generating a dynamic three-dimensional space field data set of each irregular grid under different boundary conditions in a simulation mode, mapping the irregular grids into regular grids, compressing dynamic three-dimensional space field data by using a downsampling method, constructing a training set according to the three-dimensional space field compressed data and the boundary conditions and the three-dimensional space field compressed data at the next historical moment, thereby training a large model pre-training network, combining a 3D convolutional neural network and a self-encoder structure, obtaining a three-dimensional space field prediction large model, and predicting three-dimensional space field distribution at the future moment by using the model. The application can accurately and efficiently predict the three-dimensional space field.
relevance_reason: 大規模モデルによる3次元空間場予測。異なる境界条件下でのシミュレーションデータセットを生成し訓練

title: Neural network-based rapid heat transfer simulation method and device
abstract: The application discloses a method and a device for simulating rapid heat transfer based on a neural network, and relates to the technical field of physical simulation. The method comprises the steps of training a hybrid neural network model, learning operator mapping from an input function to a temperature or a heat flow field, encoding physical constraints such as a heat conduction partial differential equation and the like into a loss function, carrying out single forward inference by using the operator mapping for a new simulation task, quickly generating an initial prediction result, calculating a physical residual error of the initial prediction according to the encoded physical constraints, and carrying out a small amount of optimization iteration to quickly and locally correct when the residual error exceeds a preset threshold value by taking the prediction as an initial value. The application solves the problems of long calculation time consumption of the traditional numerical method and insufficient physical fidelity of the traditional neural network method, and realizes high efficiency and high precision of heat transfer simulation.
relevance_reason: ニューラルネットによる高速伝熱シミュレーション、物理制約。物理+ML手法

title: SOFC-PV/T-HP semi-physical simulation system design method
abstract: A design method of an SOFC-PV/T-HP semi-physical simulation system comprises physical equipment, operation monitoring software of the physical equipment and a simulation model, and comprises the following steps of firstly establishing a basic structure of the SOFC-PV/T-HP system and a steady-state model of the equipment, carrying out capacity configuration on virtual equipment based on the steady-state model on the basis of capacity of the PV/T-HP physical equipment, establishing an equipment mechanism model, setting up a dynamic simulation model of a cogeneration system according to the capacity of the equipment, initializing virtual equipment parameters and simulation initial parameters, setting up a communication interface of the physical equipment and the virtual equipment, realizing data transmission of the physical equipment and the virtual equipment, carrying out semi-physical simulation, carrying out control system design according to the dynamic characteristics of the system, and carrying out control operation on the semi-physical simulation system according to equipment control parameters. The invention reduces the research cost, improves the control experiment research safety and research efficiency, and has higher credibility compared with the control research by adopting a simulation model.
relevance_reason: SOFC-PV/T-HP半物理シミュレーションシステム設計。シミュレーション基盤設計

title: Sea state mapping-based FPV system strength evaluation method
abstract: The invention discloses a sea state mapping-based FPV system strength evaluation method, which belongs to the technical field of floating photovoltaic system design, and comprises the following steps of 1 inputting preliminary parameters established by an FPV system and establishing a preliminary design scheme of the FPV system, 2 establishing a local strength model of the FPV system by using the preliminary parameters, 3 inputting sea state parameters, calculating a time domain dynamic response result by using the sea state parameters, generalizing, 4 determining an environment boundary condition according to the generalization result, 5 carrying out strength evaluation on the FPV system by combining the boundary condition, and 6 generating an optimal design decision guide according to the strength evaluation result.
relevance_reason: 浮体式太陽光発電の海象境界条件下強度評価。環境条件変動下の設計評価目的

title: Power distribution network toughness improving method based on data fusion algorithm
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of power distribution networks, and provides a power distribution network toughness improving method based on a data fusion algorithm, which comprises the steps of collecting and fusing multi-dimensional data of the power distribution network, identifying regional-level toughness blocks with similar toughness characteristics by using a clustering algorithm, and identifying system-level toughness key nodes with the greatest influence on the overall survivability of a system by combining a complex network theory and fault simulation to form a toughness region and key node set; aiming at the toughness region and the key node set, evaluating the node level, region level and system level toughness index values corresponding to different distributed resource space allocation schemes under a preset extreme scene, and calculating the toughness increment by comparing whether the toughness increment exists or not. An optimization model integrating the verified causal relationship and multi-objective coordination is established, and a scientific resource allocation strategy which ensures the maximization of the overall toughness of the system and gives consideration to the balance of the toughness among areas is output, so that the precision, reliability and coordination promotion of the toughness of the power distribution network are realized.
relevance_reason: 配電網靭性向上。複雑ネットワーク理論+fault simulationでレジリエンスノードを特定、極限シーン下で評価(エネルギー分野)

title: Optical fiber cone modeling and transmittance calculating method
abstract: The invention discloses a fiber light cone modeling and transmittance calculating method, which belongs to the technical field of three-dimensional modeling and physical simulation, and comprises the steps of constructing a simplified fiber light cone three-dimensional physical model; classifying the primary multifilament rods according to radial distances based on a simplified three-dimensional physical model of the optical fiber taper, and counting to obtain a functional relation between the number of the primary multifilament rods and the radial distances, wherein the radial distances refer to the distances between the central position of the primary multifilament rod on the end face of the large end of the optical fiber taper and the central position of the optical fiber taper, the transmittance of the primary multifilament rods is calculated in a numerical simulation mode to obtain the transmittance of the primary multifilament rods with different radial distances, a curve between the radial distances and the transmittance is fitted, and the effective transmittance of the optical fiber taper is calculated based on the functional relation and the curve. The invention can realize efficient modeling of the optical fiber cone and effectively balance the calculation precision and the calculation complexity.
relevance_reason: 光ファイバーコーンモデリング透過率計算。光学物理シミュレーション

title: Helicopter simulation system with 6-degree-of-freedom turntable
abstract: The invention relates to a helicopter simulation system based on a 6-degree-of-freedom turntable. The system simulates various attitudes and motion states of the helicopter in flight through the 6-degree-of-freedom turntable, and combines a high-precision sensor and simulation software to realize real-time simulation of the flight process of the helicopter. Experiments show that the system can efficiently and accurately simulate the flight characteristics of the helicopter, and is suitable for pilot training and flight performance testing. The technical scheme is that the three-degree-of-freedom semi-physical simulation platform and the experimental method of the single-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle are provided. The prior art can only perform the algorithm simulation of the controller, and has no education training and flight training functions of the simulation system. The existing simulation system is difficult to comprehensively simulate the complex flight attitude and motion state of the helicopter. This patent provides a helicopter simulation system based on 6 degrees of freedom revolving stage, can effectively solve this problem.
relevance_reason: ヘリコプター6自由度ターンテーブルシミュレータ。訓練シミュレータ一般

title: Vehicle track generation method, device and medium based on variable neighborhood search
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of automatic driving, and relates to a vehicle track generation method, device and medium based on variable neighborhood search, wherein a trapezoid neighborhood and an annular neighborhood at the moment t are constructed, a track planning path equation of a vehicle and boundary conditions thereof are constructed, when the curvature change rate of a road where the vehicle is located is smaller than a preset threshold value, the trapezoid neighborhood at the moment t+1 in the track planning path of the vehicle is used as a constraint, the track planning path equation of the vehicle and the boundary conditions thereof are solved, when the curvature change rate of the road where the vehicle is located is greater than or equal to the preset threshold value, the annular neighborhood at the moment t+1 in the track planning path of the vehicle is used as the constraint, the track planning path equation of the vehicle and the boundary conditions thereof are solved, and a track candidate set of the vehicle is obtained.
relevance_reason: 可変近傍探索による車両軌道生成、境界条件。オンライン軌道計画手法

title: Gradient utilization battery detection rack and method for teaching in professional universities
abstract: The application relates to the technical field of battery teaching equipment, and discloses a gradient utilization battery detection rack and a method for teaching in professional institutions, wherein the gradient utilization battery detection rack comprises a semi-closed cabin body, a cabin door is arranged on the cabin body, and a transparent observation window is arranged on the cabin door; the intelligent control system is characterized in that an exhaust fan and a smoke sensor are arranged on the inner side of a cabin body, a battery cassette assembly is arranged in the cabin body, the battery cassette assembly is adaptive to various battery core types and is provided with a 12-pin foolproof plug, a central monitoring unit and a fault simulation module are arranged in the cabin body, the central monitoring unit is used for collecting battery voltage, current, temperature and cabin body smoke concentration parameters in real time, the fault simulation module is used for injecting various controllable faults, and a plurality of external test interfaces are arranged on the lower portion of a cabin door. The application not only gives consideration to the industrial-grade test function and the safety guarantee, but also has the openness, interactivity and fault simulation function required by teaching, and the cost is controlled within 20-30% of industrial-grade equipment, thereby improving the teaching efficiency and quality.
relevance_reason: 勾配利用電池教習ラック。fault simulation moduleで様々な制御可能故障を注入(電池教育分野)

title: Electrical simulation training system for medium-sized high-speed motor vehicle
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of vehicle simulation training, and provides an electric simulation training system of a medium-sized high-speed motor vehicle, which comprises an electric loop simulation module, a fault injection and diagnosis module, a data acquisition and analysis module, a virtual-real interaction control module and a safety protection module, wherein the electric loop simulation module comprises a power supply simulation unit, a load simulation unit and a line impedance simulation unit, the output voltage of the power supply simulation unit is regulated within the regulation range of 12V-28V, the voltage ripple is less than or equal to 50mV, and the load simulation unit supports 0.5A-20A adjustable constant current load output. The electric loop simulation module is used for accurately reproducing various electric working conditions of the vehicle, the fault injection module can simulate various common and complex faults such as short circuit, poor contact and the like, the constructed virtual model and the force feedback operator are combined to realize immersive operation of virtual-real fusion, and meanwhile, the data acquisition and analysis module is used for capturing parameter changes and predicting trends in real time, so that a power assisting practical training person can quickly master fault diagnosis and parameter adjustment skills.
relevance_reason: 中型高速自動車の電気シミュレーション訓練システム。fault injection and diagnosis moduleで様々な故障をシミュレート(自動車電気分野)

title: Method for predicting multi-component spatial distribution in transformer
abstract: The invention discloses a multi-component spatial distribution prediction method in a transformer, which relates to the technical field of monitoring of the running state of power equipment, and comprises the steps of firstly constructing a multi-gas component transportation physical simulation model of transformer oil based on fluid simulation software, and configuring an observation system mapped with the position of an actual sensor; the method comprises the steps of constructing a time sequence error matrix of actual observation and simulation prediction, dividing the time sequence error matrix into a training set and a verification set, generating a dynamic B matrix by utilizing an LSTM network on the basis, fusing simulation data with real-time sensor observation data through an EnKF algorithm to realize dynamic updating and error correction of a simulation model, assisting an adaptive step length regulation and abnormality processing mechanism in a data assimilation process, and finally dynamically displaying the spatial distribution of each gas component in an oil tank in various forms. The invention effectively solves the problems of space limitation, static simulation prediction error accumulation and the like of the traditional monitoring, and realizes accurate and dynamic prediction of the spatial distribution of multiple gas components in the transformer.
relevance_reason: 変圧器内多成分分布予測(重複、A版)

title: Heterogeneous interconnection multi-core distributed simulation experiment system and cooperative control method
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of simulation, and particularly discloses a heterogeneous interconnection multi-core distributed simulation experiment system and a cooperative control method, wherein the system comprises a semi-physical simulation system and a virtual system; the semi-physical simulation system comprises a plurality of semi-physical simulation nodes, a plurality of multi-core parallel simulation nodes, a digital simulation system, an experimental environment model, a virtual-real combined simulation experiment platform and a dynamic deduction visual simulation engine, wherein each semi-physical simulation node can simulate a semi-physical simulation entity, each multi-core parallel simulation node can simulate a plurality of parallel semi-physical simulation entities, the virtual system comprises the digital simulation system, the digital simulation system can simulate a plurality of parallel digital simulation entities, the experimental environment model is used for simulating generation of experimental environment modeling data, the virtual-real combined simulation experiment platform is used for deduction and rendering of a working scene, and the dynamic deduction visual simulation engine is used for rendering environment information by using the experimental environment modeling data. The system has the capability of multi-core simulation, and can further improve the upper limit of the access of the semi-physical simulation model to the semi-physical system, so that the semi-physical system can perform cluster simulation.
relevance_reason: 異種相互接続マルチコア分散シミュレーションシステム。シミュレーション基盤アーキテクチャ

title: Multi-mode coupling lithium battery thermal runaway multi-stage early warning method and system
abstract: The invention provides a multi-mode coupling multi-stage early warning method and a multi-stage early warning system for thermal runaway of a lithium battery, which belong to the technical field of lithium battery safety monitoring, wherein the method comprises the following steps of S1, collecting a large number of historical multi-mode monitoring data in the operation process of the lithium battery to construct a data set; the method comprises the steps of S2, creating a thermal runaway monitoring model based on a time-frequency characteristic extraction module, a characteristic fusion module, a reconstruction decoding module, a physical simulation module, a multi-source information fusion module and a report output module, training and deploying the thermal runaway monitoring model through a data set, S3, collecting the thermal runaway monitoring model deployed by real-time multi-mode monitoring data input of the lithium battery, obtaining a monitoring report carrying a temperature average value, a temperature standard deviation, a voltage average value and a voltage standard deviation, and S4, carrying out thermal runaway early warning on the lithium battery based on the monitoring report. The method has the advantages that the accuracy, the working condition adaptability and the reliability of the thermal runaway early warning of the lithium battery are greatly improved.
relevance_reason: リチウム電池熱暴走多段階早期警報。物理シミュレーションモジュールを含むハザード早期警報(電池安全分野)

title: Underwater two-dimensional sound field calculation method based on Fourier feature embedding PINN
abstract: The application discloses an underwater two-dimensional sound field calculation method based on Fourier feature embedding PINN, which relates to the technical field of sound field calculation and comprises the steps of encoding into a partial differential equation physical loss function, constructing PINNs, determining corresponding sound source conditions, sea surface boundary conditions and seabed boundary conditions, encoding into boundary condition physical loss functions, constructing a data auxiliary loss function according to observed data of a calculation area, preliminarily selecting different sigma parameters to modify frequencies corresponding to Fourier bases, pre-training the preliminarily selected different sigma parameters PINNs in a set step length, calculating point-by-point average errors according to sound pressure output by PINNs after training is finished, searching optimal sigma parameters, performing two-stage training according to the optimal sigma parameters, and calculating sound propagation loss prediction results according to sound pressure real parts and imaginary parts output by PINNs. The application can enable the network to learn the high-frequency component, thereby forecasting the multi-scale marine sound propagation phenomenon.
relevance_reason: 水中音場PINN、境界条件。物理+ML音響計算手法

title: Numerical simulation method and system for two-phase flow heat transfer
abstract: The application relates to a numerical simulation method and a numerical simulation system for two-phase flow heat transfer, wherein the method comprises the following steps of S01, setting physical parameters, grid parameters and calculation parameters of simulation contents according to the simulation contents, initializing grids, S02, initializing a two-phase parameter field, a speed field and a temperature field, giving boundary conditions, S03, calculating time evolution conditions of the two-phase parameter field, the speed field and the pressure field by using a two-phase flow model, S04, calculating and obtaining the time evolution conditions of the temperature field by using a convection diffusion equation based on the time evolution conditions of the obtained speed field, and S05, combining the time evolution conditions of the obtained two-phase parameter field, the speed field, the pressure field and the temperature field, and outputting required simulation data. According to the application, on the basis of the self-adaptive grid, the temperature field is used as a passive scalar to be added into the flow field, so that the application range of the numerical simulation method, the reliability of the simulation result and the convenience of analyzing the problem are improved.
relevance_reason: 二相流伝熱数値シミュレーション、境界条件。物理シミュレーション手法

title: Acoustic device simulation system with digital twin acoustic robot and simulation method thereof
abstract: An acoustic device simulation system with digital twin acoustic robot comprising: a computing device and a simulation program which can be executed by the computing device to cause the computing device to perform operations comprising the following steps: receiving data from a physical system to create an acoustic computer-assisted engineering model; importing data from the operation of the physical system into the acoustic computer-assisted engineering model, and generating a digital twin virtual three-dimensional model; running a physical simulation through the digital twin virtual three-dimensional model; and modifying or replacing the simulation conditions of the digital twin virtual three-dimensional model in order to obtain simulation results under different conditions.

title: Simulation method for flow field distribution and deposition morphology in ultrafast laser-assisted electrochemical deposition
abstract: The present invention relates to the technical field of electrodeposition, and relates to a simulation method for flow field distribution and deposition morphology in ultrafast laser-assisted electrochemical deposition. The steps of the method comprise: constructing, in multiphysics simulation software, a two-dimensional axisymmetric multiphysics coupled field model for heat transfer, solid and fluid heat transfer, tertiary current distribution, and laminar flow; constructing a geometric model of a deposition cell and a substrate, and setting laser properties, material physical parameters, and electrodeposition properties in the multiphysics simulation software; constructing an ultrafast laser heat transfer model on the basis of a two-temperature equation; setting initial and boundary conditions of the ultrafast laser heat transfer model, and constructing an electrodeposition field; coupling the ultrafast laser heat transfer model with the electrodeposition field to construct an ultrafast laser-assisted electrochemical deposition model; delineating a grid; and performing calculation and analysis. In the present invention, ultrafast laser is incorporated to perform multiphysics coupling of a thermal field, a flow field, an electric field, etc., and a two-temperature equation and tertiary current distribution are incorporated to the model, thereby achieving the accuracy and comprehensiveness of prediction models.

title: Acoustic device simulation system with digital twin acoustic robot and simulation method thereof
abstract: A acoustic device simulation system with digital twin acoustic robot comprising: a computing device and a simulation program which can be executed by the computing device to cause the computing device to perform operations comprising the following steps: receiving data from a physical system to create an acoustic computer-assisted engineering model; importing data from the operation of the physical system into the acoustic computer-assisted engineering model, and generating a digital twin virtual three-dimensional model; running a physical simulation through the digital twin virtual three-dimensional model; and modifying or replacing the simulation conditions of the digital twin virtual three-dimensional model in order to obtain simulation results under different conditions.

title: Engine fault simulation system and method based on virtual rack
abstract: The application relates to the field of engine fault simulation, in particular to an engine fault simulation system and method based on a virtual rack, wherein the system comprises a VTB virtual rack which is respectively in communication connection with a control upper computer, an ECU and real hardware; the VTB virtual bench comprises a real-time simulation machine for running an engine model, a multifunctional digital template card module for carrying out signal conversion between the real-time simulation machine and an ECU, a wire harness connection fault test box connected between the multifunctional digital template card module and the ECU, a signal generating device connected to the wire harness connection fault test box and used for injecting hardware fault signals into the ECU through the wire harness connection fault test box, and user driving data collected by a remote mobile terminal and used for configuring the model initial state of the real-time simulation machine and/or generating test working conditions by controlling an upper computer. And the high cost and the hardware damage risk brought by the dependence of the physical bench on the entity prototype and the destructive test are avoided.

title: Method for analyzing defects of vertical interconnection structure and computer equipment
abstract: A method for analyzing defects of vertical interconnection structure includes setting up defect-free model of vertical interconnection structure and defect-containing model containing void defects, setting up electric, thermal and mechanical boundary conditions of model, setting up virtual buffer layer with high thermal conductivity and used only for heat conduction on top surface of substrate, applying generalized heat source on said buffer layer, setting up coupling relation between electric, thermal and mechanical multiple physical fields and executing multiple physical field coupling solution, carrying out third-order analysis by comparing global key index of defect-containing model and defect-free model, analyzing physical quantity distribution on key interface between metal filler of vertical interconnection structure and substrate and analyzing physical quantity distribution on longitudinal section line passing through defect center. The invention can realize comprehensive, quantitative and multi-scale evaluation of the influence of the micro-nano cavity defect in the vertical interconnection structure under the electric-thermal-force coupling field.

title: Wire current-carrying capacity-sag coupling modeling method and system based on electric-thermal-force coupling
abstract: The invention discloses a wire current-carrying capacity-sag coupling modeling method and system based on electric-thermal-force coupling, which belong to the technical field of transmission wires, and are characterized in that a heat balance equation is established based on acquired joule heat power, solar heat absorption power, convective heat dissipation power and radiant heat dissipation power, the heat balance equation is solved to obtain the surface temperature of the wire, the surface temperature of the wire is used as a boundary condition, a concentric multilayer radial heat conduction model is constructed, the radial temperature gradient of the wire is obtained, the strain of various materials in the wire is calculated based on the radial temperature gradient of the wire, the real horizontal stress is obtained through self-adaptive iteration, and the real horizontal stress and the acquired geometrical parameters of the wire are substituted into a parabolic model to obtain the maximum sag of the wire under the current working condition. The invention improves the temperature evaluation precision of the lead, avoids systematic deviation caused by isothermal or neglected irradiation/wind-induced heat exchange of the conductor, and provides a reliable thermal boundary for dynamic current-carrying capacity evaluation.

title: Adjustable cable partial discharge fault simulation experiment system based on real defects
abstract: The invention discloses an adjustable cable partial discharge fault simulation experiment system based on real defects, which comprises a data acquisition and preprocessing module, a frequency spectrum construction and index extraction module, a defect tensor initialization module, a partial discharge simulation generation module, a tensor evolution path extraction module and a structural distribution matching evaluation module, wherein the data acquisition and preprocessing module is used for acquiring original multi-mode signal data and preprocessing, the frequency spectrum construction and index extraction module is used for executing frequency spectrum decomposition operation and calculating defect response indexes, the defect tensor initialization module is used for generating a to-be-simulated defect tensor according to a target simulation reference tensor, the partial discharge simulation generation module is used for carrying out simulation processing according to partial discharge simulation points, the tensor evolution path extraction module is used for constructing a simulation defect tensor evolution graph through Soft-DTW distance and carrying out path search to obtain a final simulation defect tensor, and the structural distribution matching evaluation module is used for carrying out Sliced-Wassestein distance calculation. The invention combines tensor modeling and feedback optimization mechanisms to construct an adjustable partial discharge fault simulation system.

title: Phase field modeling method for SAC305 lead-free solder viscoplastic corrosion fracture
abstract: The application relates to the field of modeling methods, and particularly discloses a phase field modeling method for the viscoplastic corrosion fracture of SAC305 lead-free solder, which comprises the steps of determining parameters of a viscoplastic constitutive model of SAC305 material based on stress-strain data of a uniaxial tension experiment, carrying out a corrosion experiment on the SAC305 material to determine the corrosion morphology evolution rule of the SAC305 material, establishing a corrosion-fracture phase field model, and calibrating the parameters of the phase field model. According to the scheme, parameters of the constitutive model of the SAC305 are calibrated according to a uniaxial tension experiment, corrosion boundary conditions of the model are confirmed according to corrosion experiment results, a corrosion-fracture phase field model is constructed, corrosion-induced strength attenuation, crack initiation and propagation paths can be simulated accurately, and the method can be used for reliability assessment, design optimization and service life prediction of the SAC305 welding spots in electronic packaging and provides basis for engineering application of key interconnection components in a corrosion environment.

title: Method and system for online estimation of microscopic state of lithium ion battery
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of lithium ion batteries, and provides a method and a system for estimating microscopic states of a lithium ion battery on line, wherein a P2D electrochemical model is built, electrochemical data under different working conditions are generated, a deep neural network model is built and verified by using the generated electrochemical data, a partial differential equation in the P2D model is solved, boundary values of the partial differential equation are combined into state variables in a neural network node mode to forcedly meet boundary conditions of the electrochemical model, and in the training process, the electrochemical PDE control equation is used as a loss function of the deep neural network model to endow the deep neural network model with physical constraint, so that information physical fusion is realized, and the microscopic states in the battery are obtained. The invention utilizes physical constraint to avoid dependence on internal state data which is difficult to acquire.

title: Iterative calculation method for concrete temperature field under surface running water state of heat preservation material
abstract: The invention provides an iterative calculation method for a concrete temperature field under a surface running water state of a heat preservation material. Deducing the temperature of the inner side of the heat insulation material according to the heat flow of the concrete and the temperature of the outer side of the heat insulation material, and calculating a concrete temperature field by taking the temperature of the inner side of the heat insulation material as a first type of boundary condition. The invention can more accurately calculate the concrete temperature field under the surface running water state of the heat preservation material, and provides scientific basis for formulating and adjusting the temperature control anti-cracking measure of the mass concrete.

title: Method for analyzing stability of reservoir bank dangerous rock based on directional progressive degradation
abstract: The invention discloses a method for analyzing stability of reservoir bank dangerous rock based on directional progressive degradation, and relates to the technical field of geological disaster prevention and control. The method comprises the steps of determining physical and mechanical properties and boundary conditions of the reservoir bank dangerous rock, constructing a geologic model of the reservoir bank dangerous rock, establishing the reservoir bank dangerous rock model by utilizing FLAC3D software based on the determined physical and mechanical properties, dividing grids, endowing mechanical parameters to rock mass units in the model according to a directional progressive degradation principle, carrying out stability analysis by utilizing FLAC3D based on the established reservoir bank dangerous rock model and the endowed mechanical parameters, obtaining stress distribution, strain distribution and displacement, verifying analysis results and outputting treatment suggestions. According to the invention, through finely acquiring basic geological information and physical mechanical parameters and combining the degradation level division of directional layering, the accurate simulation of the dangerous rock degradation process is realized, and the defect that the degradation directionality and the degradation level cannot be reflected by the homogenization parameter assignment in the existing method is overcome.

title: Dynamic analysis modeling method for magnetic field modulation type governor bearing-birotor system
abstract: The invention relates to a dynamic analysis modeling method for a bearing-double-rotor system of a magnetic field modulation type governor, which belongs to the technical field of dynamic analysis and comprises the following steps of S1, analyzing electromagnetic characteristics of a modulated magnetic field, S2, establishing a dynamic numerical analysis model of each fault in the bearing-double-rotor system, and S3, establishing a coupling fault model of the bearing-double-rotor system. The invention effectively solves the key problems of the existing bearing-rotor system dynamics modeling technology in the aspects of application range, feature characterization, solving precision, boundary conditions and the like.

title: Apparatus and method for accelerating physics-based simulation using artificial intelligence
abstract: The invention provides a method and apparatus for performing a physical-based simulation. The processing device includes a memory and a processor. The processor is configured to perform a physics-based simulation by performing a portion of the physics-based simulation, training a neural network model based on results from performing a first portion of the physics-based simulation, performing an inference process based on results of training of the neural network model, and providing a prediction back to the physics-based simulation as input based on the inference process.

title: Wind field correction method based on multi-stage hybrid physical-data driving
abstract: The invention discloses a wind field correction method based on multi-stage hybrid physical-data driving, and relates to the technical field of wind field data processing and climate mode application. The method comprises the steps of performing dynamic downscaling simulation by using a regional climate simulation tool to obtain a multi-dimensional candidate variable field, screening target candidate climate variables according to ERA5 wind speed data to form a multi-dimensional key variable field, constructing a model to be trained comprising a multi-dimensional space feature extraction module, a time dynamic feature extraction module, multi-dimensional space-time feature fusion and an output module, training by using the multi-dimensional key variable field to obtain a hierarchical multi-dimensional space-time fusion network for correcting wind field data, and generating a high-resolution wind field correction field by using a complex topography micro-scale flow field fine-correction solver by using the wind field correction field as a boundary condition. The wind speed prediction method not only improves the accuracy of wind speed prediction, but also ensures the physical reality and consistency of the high-resolution wind field under the influence of complex terrain through physical constraint.

title: Dynamic hazard source identification and safety path generation method for fire scene
abstract: The invention discloses a dynamic hazard source identification and safety path generation method for a fire scene in the technical field of data processing for prediction purposes, and relates to the technical field of data processing for prediction purposes.A multi-source heterogeneous data is acquired in real time through a multi-dimensional sensor network to form a multi-mode state snapshot; and the dynamics control equation is obtained by carrying out forward solution by using an embedded physical information neural network and taking real-time data as boundary conditions, outputting a core dynamics vector comprising the fire spreading speed and the toxic gas generation rate, driving a fire digital twin model coupled with the building information model, compressing a minute-level evolution process to a second-level by utilizing parallel calculation to complete prediction, and generating a high-precision three-dimensional risk map capable of accurately simulating a nonlinear jump-type diffusion mode under the influence of an obstacle, thereby improving the prediction speed and accuracy.

title: Index system dynamic construction method and device based on CNN-Kriging model
abstract: The application relates to a dynamic construction method and a device of an index system based on a CNN-Kriging model, wherein the method is applied to a central node of a distributed intelligent spectrum access system comprising the central node and a plurality of distributed edge nodes; the method comprises the steps of preprocessing data samples reported by distributed edge nodes, dividing preprocessing results into a training set and a testing set, training a CNN-Kriging model, generating a synthetic data set according to the trained CNN-Kriging model, carrying out statistical analysis and index optimization according to the synthetic data set by adopting a global sensitivity analysis method, updating the data samples according to an optimized index system, and updating the index system to obtain an optimized index system oriented to spectrum access decisions. The method solves the problems of low frequency spectrum efficiency, poor reliability and incapability of adapting to dynamic environments caused by static and unexplained interference management strategies under dense deployment of mass Internet of things equipment.

title: Electroacoustic device simulation system with digital twin acoustic robot
abstract: The invention discloses a digital twin-assisted electroacoustic device simulation system, which comprises a computing device and a simulation program, wherein when the simulation program is run by the computing device, the computing device is enabled to execute the operations comprising the following steps of receiving various data of a physical system to establish an acoustic computer-assisted engineering model, importing the running data of the physical system into the acoustic computer-assisted engineering model and generating a digital twin virtual three-dimensional model, running physical simulation through the digital twin virtual three-dimensional model, and modifying or replacing simulation conditions of the digital twin virtual three-dimensional model to obtain simulation results under different conditions.

title: Intensity simulation method, device and equipment for transverse double continuous fiber leaf springs
abstract: The application relates to a strength simulation method, a device and equipment for transverse double continuous fiber leaf springs, which comprises the steps of cutting the transverse double continuous fiber leaf springs, establishing a local coordinate system of each fiber leaf spring section, dividing grids corresponding to fiber leaf springs based on a layering base surface of each fiber leaf spring, establishing grids within the length range of each fiber layering into a Set unit Set, stacking the fiber layering according to the material attribute and the layering attribute of each fiber layering to obtain a composite material layering plate, stacking the composite material layering according to the stacking direction of the composite material layering to obtain a simulation model of each fiber leaf spring, establishing a simulation model of a suspension system according to the simulation model, a second connection relation and a first connection relation of each fiber leaf spring, and performing strength test on the simulation model of the suspension system to obtain a strength simulation result. Therefore, the problems of non-convergence of calculation, easy distortion of boundary conditions and inaccurate modeling of a layering in simulation are solved.

title: Line elastic critical stress calculation method for axisymmetric buckling of large-diameter steel casing
abstract: The invention relates to a line elastic critical stress calculation method for axisymmetric buckling of a large-diameter steel casing, which comprises the steps of constructing constitutive equation and deformation coordination equation of axisymmetric steel casing bending deformation, constructing buckling equation of axisymmetric steel casing on the basis of bending theory, obtaining general solution of the buckling equation by solving a high-order differential equation, introducing mechanical boundary conditions of axial uniform loading in consideration of working conditions of the upper part of the steel casing, substituting general solution form containing radial displacement into the boundary conditions, giving numerical solution by adopting a multi-area bisection method, and obtaining critical buckling stress analysis solution of a cylindrical shell. The method has the beneficial effects that the method breaks through the limitations of the classical beam buckling theory and the buckling theory which only considers the cylindrical thin shell, can improve the calculation accuracy of the integral buckling characteristic of the semi-buried steel casing, and simultaneously considers the improvement of the buckling resistance of the steel casing by the characteristic of soil.

title: Method and system for evaluating risk of machine blocking of rear supporting system of tunnel boring machine
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of tunnel boring machines, in particular to a method and a system for evaluating the risk of machine blocking of a system matched with the tunnel boring machine, wherein the method comprises the steps of establishing a surrounding rock mechanical model; loading the tunnel face space supporting effect, the initial lining supporting effect and the reserved space between the rear supporting system and the initial lining into the surrounding rock mechanical model as boundary conditions of the model, pushing the tunneling process in a time increment mode, calculating convergence response of the lining/supporting member based on rigidity and installation state of the current supporting member, comparing the obtained convergence difference, repeating the steps until reaching preset termination conditions, comparing the maximum convergence value obtained by time sequence calculation with the reserved space between the rear supporting system and the initial lining, judging and outputting a machine-blocking risk warning.

title: Design method of ultra-compact photoelectric integrated device based on large language model
abstract: A design method of an ultra-compact photoelectric integrated device based on a large language model relates to the field of photonic integrated circuit design and comprises the steps of discretizing a design area into a structural sequence, generating a structural-response data set based on the structural sequence, applying a low-rank adaptive fine tuning technology on a pre-training large language model, jointly optimizing forward prediction and reverse generation tasks, wherein the reverse generation task explicitly models a long-range electromagnetic coupling effect by using a self-attention mechanism, generating the structural sequence from a target response and verifying response characteristics through physical simulation. The invention realizes the efficient learning of small samples through the strong generalization capability of LLM and LoRA fine tuning technology, and solves the problem of local optimum caused by neglecting long-distance coupling in the traditional photon design by explicitly capturing the long-range electromagnetic coupling effect by using a self-attention mechanism.

title: Method of designing a switchgear with arc-flash simulation and energy transmission thereof
abstract: A method of evaluating a stress applied to components of a switchgear cabinet for sustaining an arc-flash with an arc-flash event simulation and energy transmission thereof is presented with steps comprising providing a location of the arc-flash in an internal volume of the switchgear cabinet, simulating the arc-flash as a local ambient boundary condition at the location of the arc flash with an input energy, diffusing the input energy in an air domain inside the switchgear cabinet, applying the input energy as a thermal history to specific arc-flash elements, multiplying the thermal history by specific heat to calculate energy units at the arc-flash, identifying a desired thermal energy magnitude and history of deposition and calibrating the desired thermal history to substantially match an estimated mechanical power generated by the arc-flash.
inventor: HECKMAN JEFFREY | PIN ANAELE

title: Comprehensive simulation platform for AC/DC series-parallel power distribution network system
abstract: The invention discloses an integrated simulation platform of an alternating current-direct current hybrid power distribution network system, and relates to the technical field of power engineering. The system comprises a modeling simulation module, a scheduling simulation module, a multi-energy simulation module and a fault simulation module, wherein the modeling simulation module is used for independently modeling each region in the alternating current-direct current hybrid power distribution network and establishing an optimal power distribution model, and comprises a modeling unit, a reliability simulation unit and an optimization unit. According to the power distribution network simulation platform, the modeling simulation modules are arranged, so that the simulation platform can perform simulation experiments of different scenes, each region is independently modeled, the power distribution of the corresponding region is more suitable, the energy utilization rate can be greatly improved, the efficiency and the reliability of the system are improved through arranging the scheduling simulation modules and the multi-energy simulation modules, and the problems that the simulation result of the conventional power distribution network simulation platform is not ideal enough in accuracy and the simulation model is not matched with the actual conditions of each region are solved.

title: Rapid calculation method for broadband sound field of shallow sea complex fluctuation boundary
abstract: The application belongs to the technical field of marine acoustics, and provides a rapid calculation method of a shallow sea complex fluctuation boundary broadband sound field, which comprises the steps of establishing an equivalent source model, extracting a plurality of discrete frequency points from a target frequency band to generate a discrete frequency point combination, sequentially extracting the discrete frequency points from the discrete frequency point combination as first discrete frequency points, and solving the first discrete frequency points The method comprises the steps of determining source intensity of each virtual sound source of an equivalent source model at each first discrete frequency point by a dimensional matrix equation until a trend of the source intensity of each virtual sound source changing along with the first discrete frequency points meets a frequency domain continuation condition of the source intensity, determining the source intensity of each virtual sound source at each second discrete frequency point based on the frequency domain continuation of the source intensity, and calculating a broadband sound field of a target shallow sea area based on the source intensity of each virtual sound source at each discrete frequency point in a discrete frequency point combination. The rapid calculation method provided by the application can remarkably reduce the calculated amount of calculating the shallow sea broadband sound field by using the equivalent source model under the complex fluctuation boundary condition.

title: Experiment bench design method for diesel-electric hybrid propulsion system
abstract: The invention discloses a diesel-electric hybrid propulsion system experiment bench design method, which is characterized in that the maximum power of a machine is calculated, the power coefficient of the propeller is obtained according to the absorption power of the propeller and the rotating speed of the propeller, a diesel engine is selected by combining a given maximum continuous power area of the diesel engine, the power ranges of a diesel-electric hybrid power PTH mode, a PTO mode and a PTI mode are divided according to the operating characteristic curves of the use area of the diesel engine and the diesel engine, the control logic of a gearbox clutch is designed aiming at the diesel engine mode, the PTO mode, the PTI mode and the PTH mode of the diesel-electric hybrid propulsion system, the main transmission ratio, the PTH transmission ratio and the PTO transmission ratio are calculated, the running modes such as a diesel-electric hybrid power system PTH, PTO, PTI can be realized, the fault simulation experiment of typical faults is designed, and the basis can be provided for the influence caused by the performance and monitoring parameters of different fault modes in each running mode.

title: LabVIEW-based aircraft power distribution system reconstruction method and visual simulation platform
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of simulation and control of aircraft power distribution systems, and provides a LabVIEW-based aircraft power distribution system reconstruction logic algorithm and a LabVIEW-based visual simulation verification platform, wherein the LabVIEW-based aircraft power distribution system reconstruction logic algorithm comprises a generator reconstruction matrix algorithm, a bus bar contactor control algorithm, a load power control algorithm and a LabVIEW-based visual simulation verification platform; the visual simulation verification platform can display the state of the power distribution system in real time, support fault injection and system reconstruction demonstration, and provide a parameter configuration interface to adapt to different power distribution systems. The invention adopts an event driving mechanism, a state machine mechanism and a modularized programming thought, clearly manages the system behaviors in different flight phases and fault states, has good expandability and reusability, can verify the logic of the power distribution system in the initial stage of design, improves the design efficiency and quality, and reduces the development cost and risk.

title: LVC multi-domain collaborative semi-physical simulation system
abstract: An LVC multi-domain collaborative semi-physical simulation system belongs to the technical field of software and hardware system integration. The system brings digital simulation and semi-physical simulation into the same scene to perform combined countermeasure verification, realizes information interaction in the fight node through the integrated middleware, realizes information interaction between fight platforms through the networking middleware, and solves the information integration problem of the fight node and the heterogeneous fight network by adopting heterogeneous computing equipment. The simulation architecture verifies the functions and performances of the multi-domain cooperative system under the system fight design, and builds a system countermeasure verification environment with expansibility and authenticity under the condition of limited semi-physical equipment. Based on the digital environment in the system, the fight node in the system fight design can be changed at low cost, and the function and performance of the semi-physical system in the system fight design can be verified by accessing the semi-physical system into the digital environment.

title: Underwater target sound scattering modeling method and system based on physical information neural network
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of underwater sound and discloses an underwater target sound scattering modeling method and system based on a physical information neural network. The method comprises the steps of establishing an acoustic-solid coupling mathematical model of an underwater target, constructing a loss function of a physical information neural network, constructing a decoupling parallel double-network architecture, using a fluid domain neural network to learn and output a scattering sound pressure field of a fluid domain, using the elastomer domain neural network to learn and output a displacement field of an elastomer domain, realizing physical coupling by sharing sampling points and corresponding boundary condition loss functions at the acoustic-solid coupling boundary by the two networks, generating training data, performing iterative training on the decoupling parallel physical information neural network, and calculating the scattering sound pressure field outside the target and the displacement field inside the elastomer by using the trained model. The invention applies the physical information neural network to the field of underwater target sound scattering innovatively, and provides a new thought and a new way for accurately forecasting the underwater target sound scattering field.

title: Oil and gas pipeline broken pipe rebound calculation method
abstract: The invention discloses a method for calculating the rebound of a broken pipe of an oil and gas pipeline, which relates to the technical field of oil and gas pipeline maintenance and aims at solving the problems that a pipe replacement section is often complicated in geological environment and limited in operation space, so that the difficulty of pipe breakage operation and welded junction assembly is greatly increased and the risk in the pipe replacement repair process of the pipeline is greatly improved; S2, analyzing the pipeline load and calculating the rebound displacement and direction of the pipeline notch, S3, establishing a soil three-dimensional solid analysis model and a pipeline shell analysis model, S4, solving the boundary condition of the external load of the pipeline, and calculating the rebound displacement and rebound direction of the pipeline based on the boundary condition of the external load to provide technical support and preventive control measures for pipeline replacement. The effects of providing technical support for pipeline replacement and providing preventive control measures for pipeline replacement are achieved.

title: Salt spray filter selection method and device based on simulation
abstract: The application provides a salt spray filter selection method and device based on simulation, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining boundary conditions of a plurality of salt spray environment parameters, obtaining a plurality of groups of salt spray environment parameter combinations based on the boundary conditions of the plurality of salt spray environment parameters, obtaining salt spray particle sizes corresponding to the plurality of groups of salt spray environment parameter combinations based on a constructed salt spray environment simulation system, obtaining particle size distribution entering at a salt spray filter inlet corresponding to each group of salt spray environment parameter combinations, inputting a plurality of filter module design schemes into a salt spray filter simulation model one by one based on the particle size distribution corresponding to each group of salt spray environment parameter combinations, obtaining simulation results of the plurality of filter module design schemes under the group of salt spray environment parameter combinations, and obtaining optimal filter module design schemes corresponding to each group of salt spray environment parameter combinations based on the simulation results so as to select a proper salt spray filter.

title: Beryllium ore treatment simulation method by microwave heating hydrofluoric acid
abstract: The invention relates to a simulation method for treating beryllium ore by microwave heating hydrofluoric acid, which is characterized by determining the reaction process and related parameters of treating beryllium ore by microwave heating hydrofluoric acid, selecting COMSOL simulation microwave to treat beryllium ore, wherein the method comprises four physical fields of electromagnetic wave-frequency domain, fluid heat transfer, reaction engineering and dilute substance transfer, performing geometric modeling on a reaction kettle, setting boundary conditions and constraint conditions, drawing grids, performing grid independence test, and performing multi-physical field coupling through mathematical equations and functions. The influence of microwave frequency, beryllium ore powder granularity, hydrofluoric acid concentration and stirrer rotating speed on beryllium smelting is changed, the simulation data of the beryllium ore treated by microwave heating hydrofluoric acid is compared with experimental data, theoretical basis and guidance are provided for the beryllium smelting process to improve the beryllium recovery rate, the experimental precision is improved, the experimental trial-and-error cost is reduced, and the experimental time is saved.

title: Nonlinear ground stress field inversion method and device based on physical data neural network
abstract: The application provides a nonlinear ground stress field inversion method and a nonlinear ground stress field inversion device based on a physical data neural network, which are used for constructing a corresponding back propagation neural network to perform optimized interpretation by taking nonlinear ground stress field boundary conditions as optimization targets, analyzing nonlinear characteristic rules of ground stress field distribution caused by formation structure complexity and mechanical parameter heterogeneity, and obtaining optimal nonlinear ground stress field boundary conditions so as to solve the problems of larger error of nonlinear ground stress field inversion results and unreliable inversion results in engineering practice.
