title: Tunnel multi-physical-field coupling simulation and support design method considering construction disturbance
abstract: The invention relates to the field of tunnel engineering, in particular to a method for simulating multi-physical field coupling and supporting design of a tunnel by considering construction disturbance, which comprises the following steps of modeling disturbance sources, collecting disturbance factor information introduced in a tunnel construction process or an external environment, and establishing a disturbance source model to represent the spatial position, strength and evolution characteristics of the disturbance sources; the method comprises the steps of constructing a three-dimensional disturbance propagation function, coupling the three-dimensional disturbance propagation function with a multi-physical field model, introducing disturbance as a source item into a tunnel thermal-hydraulic-mechanical coupling model, adjusting modeling parameters and solving strategies by a labor-method control mechanism according to the characteristics of different tunnel construction methods, and setting corresponding disturbance source model parameters, boundary conditions and constitutive relation adjustment coefficients for different construction methods. The method solves the problems of rough disturbance modeling, idealized disturbance propagation mechanism, disjoint with a multi-physical field model and no disturbance response system in a construction method.

title: Laser powder bed material-increasing workpiece temperature field simulation prediction method based on temperature monitoring
abstract: The invention discloses a temperature monitoring-based laser powder bed material-increasing workpiece temperature field simulation prediction method, which comprises the steps of firstly, testing boundary conditions related to temperature field simulation in a laser powder bed material-increasing manufacturing process and parameters related to temperature in material properties by adopting an existing experimental test method, establishing a temperature-parameter correlation model, then, correcting the obtained temperature-parameter correlation model by comparing temperature field simulation data with temperature field test data, finally, obtaining an accurate temperature-parameter correlation model, and integrating a program package to establish the accurate temperature field prediction method. The method realizes the accurate prediction of the temperature distribution and evolution of the whole area (surface and inside) of the laser powder bed material-increasing workpiece, solves the problem of the simulation misalignment of the temperature field caused by inaccurate parameters, is applicable to the temperature field prediction of workpieces of different shapes, and avoids the problem that temperature measuring kits cannot be transplanted in the experimental test of the temperature fields of workpieces of different shapes.

title: Hemodynamic calculation method based on micro-element nerve operator
abstract: The invention discloses a blood flow dynamics calculation method based on a micro-element nerve operator, which comprises the steps of realizing time shift prediction of an intravascular flow field through a pre-trained prediction network based on an initial flow field, a blood vessel geometry and boundary conditions, realizing high-efficiency calculation of blood flow dynamics simulation of different calculation domains through designing a micro-element nerve operator with constant micro-element correlation and displacement, training the prediction network by adopting a supervised learning mode, minimizing mean square error of multi-step recursive prediction under a multi-step circulation frame, and realizing two-dimensional or three-dimensional rapid simulation by decomposing a blood flow dynamics problem into sub-problems with the micro-element correlation and learning a universal time shift operator. Compared with the prior art, the method can adapt to various calculation domains without retraining, remarkably improves the calculation efficiency and the accuracy, and is suitable for the field of medical blood flow simulation.

title: Semi-physical simulation system and method for anchor-windlass low-temperature test
abstract: The invention provides a semi-physical simulation test system and method for a low-temperature anchor and mooring machine. The test system is divided into a physical part and a model part according to whether the test system is a physical part or not, and comprises a test environment system, a data acquisition system, a semi-physical simulation system, a joint simulation system and a display system. The semi-physical simulation test system and the semi-physical simulation test method for the low-temperature anchor-windlass realize the semi-physical simulation of the anchor-windlass based on actual low-temperature working condition data, improve the accuracy of the semi-physical simulation result, enable the real hydraulic system to operate in combination with other simulated components or enable the simulated hydraulic system to operate in combination with the real other components, and realize the data processing and displaying of test data and simulation data through the data processing and display assembly.

title: Model training method and apparatus, and readable storage medium
abstract: A model training method and apparatus, and a readable storage medium. The method comprises: inputting multiple sets of verification parameters of a refrigeration device into a scenario simulation model to obtain scenario simulation data corresponding to each set of verification parameters among the multiple sets of verification parameters, wherein the refrigeration device is used for cooling multiple network devices, the multiple sets of verification parameters comprise multiple sets of refrigeration parameters under different boundary conditions, and the scenario simulation data comprises the energy consumption of refrigeration device and temperature data of a region where each network device among the multiple network devices is located; and training a reinforcement model on the basis of the multiple sets of verification parameters to obtain a target reinforcement model, wherein the target reinforcement model is used for determining a target refrigeration parameter on the basis of the current boundary condition of the refrigeration device, the target refrigeration parameter is the one, among multiple sets of candidate refrigeration parameters, that results in the lowest energy consumption of the refrigeration device, and when the refrigeration device executes the candidate refrigeration parameters, the temperature data of the region where each network device is located is lower than a temperature threshold.

title: Fault diagnosis and health management system and method
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a fault diagnosis and health management system and method, wherein the system comprises a data acquisition module, a data simulation module, a data processing module and a health degree evaluation module, the data acquisition module is used for acquiring operation data of each subsystem of a diesel engine under different operation conditions, the data simulation module is used for establishing a diesel engine simulation model, calibrating the diesel engine simulation model according to real-time operation data of the diesel engine at the current moment, so as to simulate and generate health simulation data under various operation conditions by using the calibrated diesel engine simulation model, fault simulation data under various operation conditions are generated by injecting the fault model simulation, the data processing module is used for developing a data processing algorithm according to the real-time operation data and the health simulation data under various operation conditions, the fault simulation data, and obtaining an operation condition identification result and abnormal result information, and the health degree evaluation module is used for evaluating the overall health degree of the diesel engine so as to obtain a health degree evaluation result.

title: Digital physical simulation method and device for wind turbine generator, equipment and storage medium
abstract: The application provides a digital physical simulation method, a device, equipment and a storage medium of a wind turbine, belonging to the technical field of wind turbine simulation; the method comprises the steps of calculating aerodynamic loads born by blades of a wind driven generator based on an external wind field and an aerodynamic characteristic model of the wind driven generator in a wind turbine generator, determining mechanical transmission parameters of mechanical transmission parts in the wind driven generator based on the aerodynamic loads born by the blades, calculating electric parameters of the wind driven generator according to the mechanical transmission parameters, determining simulation results based on the aerodynamic loads born by the blades, the mechanical transmission parameters and the electric parameters, sending the simulation results to a signal conversion cabinet, enabling the signal conversion cabinet to convert the simulation results into action instructions, and sending the action instructions to the wind driven generator control cabinet, wherein the action instructions are used for triggering the wind turbine control cabinet to execute actions carried in the action instructions. The application can provide a wind turbine generator simulation method combining digital and physical.

title: Intelligent discrimination and enhancement method for effective barrier layer under protection of aquifer in mining area
abstract: The invention provides an intelligent distinguishing and reinforcing method for an effective barrier layer under the protection of a water-bearing layer of a mining area, and belongs to the technical field of water-retaining exploitation. According to the method, geological parameters of a plurality of experimental mines and physical and mechanical parameters of coal and rock mass are obtained, the 3DEC numerical value is utilized to simulate the rock covering crack form after exploitation, a water resource seepage model is built by combining COMSOL Multiphysics software, and the water resource invasion depth is calculated. And then taking the relevant parameters as input and the water resource invasion depth as output, training an SVM model to construct an intelligent judgment model for the water resource seepage of the barrier layer, further predicting the water resource invasion depth, calculating the thickness of the effective barrier layer by combining the safety coefficient, and judging and correspondingly processing the effective barrier layer according to different conditions. The invention adopts the intelligent distinguishing and reinforcing method for the effective barrier layer under the protection of the water-bearing layer of the mining area, and realizes the protection of water resources of the mining area by distinguishing and reinforcing the water-resisting capacity of the effective barrier layer.

title: Coarse tooth surface meshing heat-stress-abrasion coupling modeling and analyzing method
abstract: The invention discloses a modeling and analyzing method for coarse tooth surface meshing heat-stress-abrasion coupling, and belongs to the technical field of mechanical transmission. The method comprises the steps of constructing a rough tooth surface geometric model based on a fractal theory, establishing a gear steady-state temperature field by defining thermal boundary conditions in a partitioning mode, analyzing the influence of the temperature field on contact stress by adopting a thermal-mechanical sequential coupling method, and establishing a dynamic wear model by combining an Archard wear theory and an ALE self-adaptive grid technology to realize real-time updating of the wear depth. According to the invention, through the coupling surface microscopic morphology, the temperature field, the stress field and the abrasion process, the gear contact stress calculation precision and the abrasion prediction accuracy are remarkably improved, and a reliable basis is provided for gear life assessment.

title: Real-time evaluation method for reliability of offshore autonomous water surface ship mechanical equipment
abstract: The invention discloses a real-time assessment method for reliability of marine autonomous water surface ship mechanical equipment, which comprises the steps of S1, constructing a synthetic data set of ship mechanical equipment operation conforming to an actual degradation rule, solving the problem of unbalance between small samples and data, S2, assessing the health index value of the ship mechanical equipment by adopting a comprehensive weighting method and a plurality of processed operation characteristic data, S3, constructing an unsupervised health index prediction model for predicting the health index value, training the unsupervised health index prediction model to obtain a trained unsupervised health index prediction model, S4, performing Weibull distribution fitting on the health index value predicted by the trained unsupervised health index prediction model to obtain shape parameters and scale parameters of the ship mechanical equipment under Weibull distribution, and S5, realizing real-time assessment on the reliability of the ship mechanical equipment based on the shape parameters and the scale parameters, supporting early fault detection and improving the safety of MASS.

title: Visual analysis method and device for combustion simulation
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of combustion state monitoring and discloses a visual analysis method and a visual analysis device for combustion simulation, wherein the method comprises the steps of generating a plurality of groups of sequential fluent images of each combustion simulation example under different initial conditions of the combustion simulation; the method comprises the steps of encoding each frame of image in each group of sequential fluency images to obtain a plurality of corresponding high-dimensional embedded vectors, performing dimension reduction clustering on the plurality of high-dimensional embedded vectors to generate a dimension-reduced scatter diagram, generating a plurality of sequential tracks of each combustion simulation example based on the dimension-reduced scatter diagram, searching similar sequential tracks which are most similar to the appointed sequential tracks in a preset convergence radius, and analyzing combustion convergence and stability. The invention fully utilizes the relevance and similarity between the data, can accurately identify similar combustion evolution modes, helps an expert to grasp key characteristics such as steady state and oscillation in the combustion process more accurately, reveals the combustion rule deeply, and improves the stamping combustion simulation precision.

title: Collaborative design method and device of gear transmission system facing marine environment
abstract: The invention discloses a collaborative design method and a device of a gear transmission system facing to an ocean environment, and relates to the field of mechanical design, wherein the collaborative design method comprises the steps of obtaining the working depth of the gear transmission system in the ocean environment, and calculating the ocean environment parameters based on the depth and a first relation; the method comprises the steps of calculating state parameters of lubricating oil used in a gear transmission system according to environment parameters and a second relation, selecting initial gear materials in a material performance parameter database according to the state parameters of the lubricating oil and the environment parameters of ocean, selecting initial configurations in a configuration database according to design requirements of the gear transmission system, inputting the initial gear materials and the initial configurations as initial conditions, inputting the gear materials and the configurations into a coupling performance prediction model to predict to obtain performance indexes, and adopting a multi-objective optimization algorithm to carry out iterative solution on an objective function under constraint conditions to obtain the optimal gear materials and configurations. The invention overcomes the limitation of the traditional split design and can capture complex coupling relations.

title: Motor stator winding turn-to-turn short circuit modeling and simulation system
abstract: The invention discloses a motor stator winding turn-to-turn short circuit modeling and simulation system, which relates to the technical field of motor fault simulation and comprises a feature extraction module, a fault evolution modeling module, a multilevel parameter dynamic correction module and a simulation strategy optimization module, wherein the feature extraction module is used for calculating and generating a fault excitation index and winding chaos entropy from acquired motor operation data, the fault evolution modeling module is used for solving a preset fault evolution model based on the fault excitation index and the winding chaos entropy to generate an updated fault resistance, the multilevel parameter dynamic correction module is used for correcting parameters of a simulation model according to the winding chaos entropy, and the simulation strategy optimization module is used for switching among a plurality of preset simulation modes according to the winding chaos entropy. According to the invention, a closed-loop self-adaptive system is constructed, a interdisciplinary theory is fused, dynamic simulation of the turn-to-turn short circuit full life cycle of the motor is realized, and high fidelity, physical interpretability and calculation efficiency are considered through a multi-level correction and self-adaptive strategy.

title: Foam drainage construction boundary condition determining method and system
abstract: The invention discloses a foam drainage construction boundary condition determining method and system, which comprise the steps of constructing a wellbore multiphase flow model considering a pressure field, a temperature field and a well structure, constructing a gas reservoir production characteristic model considering reservoir shale gas adsorption analysis characteristics, constructing a critical liquid carrying speed model according to target gas well production parameters predicted by the wellbore multiphase flow model and the gas reservoir production characteristic model, predicting critical liquid carrying flow rate of the target gas well according to the critical liquid carrying speed model, predicting gas apparent flow rate of the target gas well according to the gas reservoir production characteristic model, and determining wellbore liquid accumulation time and wellbore liquid accumulation characteristics of the target gas well based on the critical liquid carrying flow rate and the gas apparent flow rate. The method provided by the invention considers the influence of multiphase flow rules in the shaft on the production dynamics of the gas reservoir and the foam drainage construction effect, and can judge the foam drainage construction effect and the subsequent filling system according to the real-time shaft dropsy condition.

title: Fluid simulation data prediction and noise reduction method, system and device
abstract: The invention provides a fluid simulation data prediction and noise reduction method, a system and a device, which relate to the technical field of fluid simulation, wherein the method mainly comprises the following steps of 1, constructing a simulation model; the simulation model comprises a self-encoder, a denoising model and a decoder which are sequentially arranged, wherein the self-encoder is used for encoding condition input data and mapping the condition input data to a potential space to obtain characterization data, the denoising model is used for introducing noise into the characterization data and converting the noise into target data through noise reduction processing, the decoder is used for decoding the target data and mapping the target data to a functional space to obtain simulation result data, and step 2 is used for inputting initial condition data of fluid dynamics to the simulation model and outputting corresponding prediction result data. The scheme completes space noise reduction and output generation operation in potential space, can improve operation efficiency, reduce operation cost, and enable output to be smoother, thereby improving quality and stability of output.

title: Temperature time sequence prediction method and device for mechanism-data reconstruction particle flow system
abstract: The invention provides a temperature time sequence prediction method and a temperature time sequence prediction device for a mechanism-data reconstruction particle flow system, wherein the method comprises a brand-new physical information neural network method (PINN) constructed by combining a normalization time, a dimensionless particle temperature and a local weight adjustment method, a theoretical comprehensive loss function is constructed by a control equation, initial conditions and limited observation data sample points, the simple uniform cooling particle flow system is taken as a case, the corresponding comprehensive loss function is determined one by one according to three inverse problems of loss energy continuous dissipation coefficient, loss initial particle temperature and loss of both, the specific comprehensive loss function is taken as a target to solve, iterative updating is carried out, and the loss values and the rule of the particle temperature in the three inverse problems with time change are sequentially and accurately determined. According to the invention, PINN is considered to combine experimental data with a simulation method, and the accuracy and the robustness are high on the conditions of predicting flow field information, a closed control equation and a primary value.

title: Large-flow dynamic water grouting simulation method and system based on deep learning
abstract: The invention discloses a large-flow dynamic water grouting simulation method and a system based on deep learning, and relates to the technical field of grouting simulation, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a neural network model; the method comprises the steps of constructing a tunnel three-dimensional simulation physical model, conducting grid division on the tunnel three-dimensional simulation physical model, setting the relative directions of large-flow moving water and grouting diffusion, setting a slurry injection port, a moving water inlet and a moving water outlet of the tunnel three-dimensional simulation physical model, setting initial conditions of grouting diffusion, inputting initial speeds of slurry and large-flow moving water and initial interval distances of the initial speeds and the initial intervals into the large-flow moving water grouting model, outputting the speed and the range of slurry diffusion at each moment by the large-flow moving water grouting model, feeding back the output value of the large-flow moving water grouting model at each moment to the tunnel three-dimensional simulation physical model, obtaining grouting effect, and guiding the grouting process of actual tunnel construction according to the grouting effect.

title: Structure fracture damage simulation method and system based on deep learning
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of structural fracture damage simulation, and provides a structural fracture damage simulation method and system based on deep learning, which are used for solving the problems that the full-flow prediction precision of complex fracture behaviors depends on network architecture design and an optimization algorithm and universality is limited. The structural fracture damage simulation method based on deep learning comprises the steps of constructing a neural network model and setting initial parameters, optimizing the initial parameters of the neural network model based on a sample set and a loss function to obtain a trained neural network model, and predicting crack initiation, expansion and bifurcation combination in a structural domain by utilizing the trained neural network model based on current structural geometric parameters, material parameters, boundary conditions and initial crack information to obtain a displacement field, a stress field and damage evolution result. The adaptability of the model to different working conditions can be enhanced by introducing multi-scale and multi-physical field information.

title: Comprehensive assessment system for simulation explosive-handling training
abstract: The invention discloses a comprehensive assessment system for simulated explosive-handling training, relates to the technical fields of emergency rescue, security inspection explosive-handling, anti-terrorism and military training, and aims to solve the problems that the conventional explosive-handling training means is single, and students are difficult to form comprehensive continuous assessment due to the fact that training modes are mutually independent, and the assessment link depends on subjective experience of instructors and lacks unified objective quantification standards. The system comprises three core subsystems of VR virtual explosion-venting training, an explosion-venting command sand table, indoor physical simulation training and a comprehensive assessment management platform. The platform can be communicated with all subsystems to collect and process student operation data, and can automatically score based on a scoring model established by national and industry standards and combined with explosion venting expert experience, personal log files can be generated by integrating the data, final result of students is calculated according to preset weights, comprehensiveness of training assessment, objectivity and authority of scoring are achieved, training immersion and safety are guaranteed, and meanwhile support is provided for accurate coaching and training effect assessment through data management.

title: Determining deformation parameters for a crash test by means of machine learning
abstract: The invention relates to a computer-implemented method and system for indirectly measuring, by means of a trained machine learning model, deformation parameters for a crash test of a vehicle to be analyzed, having the following work steps: • detecting geometry parameters of a plurality of different vehicles, the parameters being measured by means of a sensor; • calculating a location probability distribution for each component and/or assembly, in particular each crash-relevant component and/or assembly, within a vehicle configuration space of the vehicle to be analyzed, the location probability distribution being derived from the detected geometry parameters; • determining boundary conditions with respect to the vehicle structure, in particular the arrangement of the components and the rigidities thereof, of the vehicle to be analyzed; • determining the vehicle structure, which is characterized by at least one geometry parameter, of a vehicle to be analyzed on the basis of the boundary conditions and the location probability distribution; • detecting at least one material parameter of individual portions of the vehicle structure, said parameters characterizing the mass, plastic properties, and elastic properties, in particular moduli of elasticity and flow curves, of the individual portions of the vehicle structure, the at least one geometry parameter and the at least one material parameter forming vehicle data relating to the vehicle to be analyzed; • calculating output data means of the machine learning model on the basis of input data, the input data being based on the vehicle data and the output data comprising a value for at least one first deformation parameter for the intrusion into the vehicle to be analyzed; and • outputting the at least one value for the first deformation parameter. The invention further relates to a computer-implemented method and a system for training the machine learning model.

title: Tunnel lining design method and system based on complex variable function method
abstract: The present invention relates to the field of tunnel construction. Disclosed are a tunnel lining design method and system based on a complex variable function method. The method comprises: selecting a tunnel excavation radius, a tunnel burial depth, a lining elastic modulus and a lining thickness, and determining a rock mass region of a tunnel and a lining region thereof; on the basis of a mapping function, respectively mapping the rock mass region and lining region of the tunnel into a rock mass annular region and a lining annular region, so as to respectively construct analytical functions of the rock mass region and the lining region under different contact conditions; solving the analytical functions on the basis of boundary conditions and continuity conditions of the rock mass region, the lining region and the contact surface therebetween; respectively calculating and acquiring the stress and displacement of any point in the lining region and the rock mass region by combining stress and displacement expressions for lining and rock mass; and determining whether a tunnel design meets design requirements, and if the tunnel design does not meet the design requirements, adjusting the lining elastic modulus and the lining thickness until the design requirements are met. The present invention is applicable to lining design parameters of tunnels of different shapes, and can effectively improve the accuracy of calculating lining design parameters.

title: Mechanism and support vector regression-based solder paste temperature soft measurement method, system, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention discloses a solder paste temperature soft measurement method, a solder paste temperature soft measurement system, electronic equipment and a storage medium based on mechanism and support vector regression, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a one-dimensional heat conduction differential equation, an inner surface boundary condition equation and an initial temperature distribution condition in a solder paste heating process according to an energy conservation law and a Fourier law; the method comprises the steps of obtaining a one-dimensional heat conduction differential equation, obtaining a first mathematical model by discretizing the one-dimensional heat conduction differential equation according to a finite difference method, simplifying the boundary condition equation of the inner surface to obtain a second mathematical model, obtaining the measured temperature of the outer surface of the solder paste, obtaining a mechanism model according to the measured temperature of the outer surface, the first mathematical model, the second mathematical model and the initial temperature distribution condition, and obtaining the inner surface temperature of the solder paste according to the mechanism model. The method is simple in implementation and accurate in calculation result, can effectively improve the temperature measurement progress in the welding process and improve the welding quality, and can be widely applied to the technical field of laser soft soldering modeling.

title: Semi-physical simulation test method for overturning and terminal control
abstract: The invention relates to a turning and tail end control semi-physical simulation test method, which is characterized in that corresponding control logic is designed according to control requirements of different stages of an aircraft, in an initial stage of emission, inertial smoothing is carried out on a course angle, a pitch angle, a course line of sight angle and a pitch line of sight angle, in a tail end guidance stage, exponential smoothing transition is carried out on a rolling angle according to a certain rule according to a bullet line of sight distance, and in a tail end attack stage, the course line of sight angle and the pitch line of sight angle are reassigned according to the change amounts of the course line of sight angle and the pitch line of sight angle so as to control the course line of sight angle and the pitch line of sight angle of a five-axis turntable. title: Method, system, medium and equipment for configuring pipeline in ocean current
abstract: The application provides a method, a system, a medium and equipment for configuring pipelines in ocean currents, which are capable of accurately simulating the movement of fluid around the pipelines by establishing a layered flow velocity field and comprehensively considering the layered effect of the ocean currents, so that the interaction between the fluid and the pipelines can be reflected more truly. Meanwhile, the boundary source term is calculated according to the relation between the fluid speed of the surface of the pipeline and the displacement of the surface of the pipeline, so that the boundary source term can accurately represent the fluid reaction force caused by the movement of the surface of the pipeline. The nonlinear elastic deformation model of the pipeline under the deformation condition is constructed, so that the stress tensor of the pipeline can be well represented. Finally, the boundary source item is used as the pipeline surface force by using the immersion boundary method, so that the interaction problem of fluid and solid under the complex boundary condition can be solved. The flow velocity and the surface displacement of the pipeline are updated through iteration until the elastic mechanical equation of the pipeline converges, and an important reference basis is provided for the configuration processes of the pipeline such as design, installation and maintenance.

title: Crystal pulling method and system for fabricating large-diameter silicon single crystal, and silicon single crystal and medium
abstract: A crystal pulling method and system for fabricating a large-diameter silicon single crystal, and a silicon single crystal and a medium. The method can comprise: performing global two-dimensional simulation on a crystal pulling process, and acquiring a global temperature distribution, a velocity field distribution and an initial solid-liquid interface value during the crystal pulling process under a preset crystal pulling apparatus and a preset crystal pulling parameter; on the basis of the global temperature distribution and the velocity field distribution, determining a boundary condition, and on the basis of the boundary condition, performing local three-dimensional simulation on the crystal pulling process to determine a target solid-liquid interface value; adjusting the preset crystal pulling parameter until the initial solid-liquid interface value is equal to the target solid-liquid interface value within a threshold range, and using the adjusted preset crystal pulling parameter as a reference crystal pulling parameter; on the basis of the reference crystal pulling parameter, simulating and calculating a simulated defect during the crystal pulling process; on the basis of the simulated defect, iteratively optimizing the reference crystal pulling parameter until the simulated defect meets a preset condition, and using the optimized reference crystal pulling parameter as a target crystal pulling parameter; and fabricating a defect-free silicon single crystal.

title: Method for designing composite foundation of reconstruction and extension pile foundation based on new foundation and old foundation rigidity cooperation
abstract: The invention discloses a new and old foundation rigidity synergy-based reconstruction pile foundation composite foundation design method, which comprises the steps of dividing a joint of a new foundation and an old foundation into a plurality of areas according to rigidity differences, respectively establishing a power control equation of each area cushion layer, respectively setting boundary conditions and continuity conditions of each area cushion layer, solving power response complete solutions of each area cushion layer, combining the boundary conditions and continuity conditions with the cushion layer power response complete solutions to obtain undetermined coefficients in the complete solutions, substituting the determined undetermined coefficients to complete solution expressions, and further quantifying influences brought by the new and old foundation rigidity differences through displacement and internal force expressions, thereby guiding the reconstruction pile foundation composite foundation design. According to the invention, the rigidity difference is used as a core factor to be introduced into a dynamic model, a dynamic equation is derived from a vibration elastic sheet theory, the problems of two ends and the joint of a new foundation and an old foundation are fully considered, the key effect of pile-soil coordination rigidity is revealed through partition modeling, the foundation design is guided, and the differential deformation is reduced.

title: Small sample trajectory prediction method and system based on data-model double driving
abstract: The invention provides a data-model double-driving-based small sample trajectory prediction method and system, which comprise the steps of building a six-degree-of-freedom trajectory model, building a small sample trajectory prediction database comprising data driving and model driving, wherein the data driving is observation data of a target trajectory, the model driving is a known full trajectory comprising all variable data of the six-degree-of-freedom trajectory model, building a trajectory prediction model based on a PINN model, building physical constraints based on the data driving and the model driving in the small sample trajectory prediction database, embedding initial conditions, boundary conditions and the physical constraints into the trajectory prediction model as loss functions, training the trajectory prediction model, and predicting the target trajectory through the trained trajectory prediction model. The method meets the ballistic prediction requirement under the condition of small samples.

title: Efficient finite cell method for lattice structure static analysis
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of intensity analysis methods of lattice structures, discloses a high-efficiency finite cell method for static analysis of lattice structures, and establishes a high-efficiency and high-precision finite element modeling and analysis integrated method for the lattice structures. Aiming at the limitations that the subdivision of a high-quality hexahedral mesh is difficult and the unit needs to ensure the welting treatment in the traditional finite element analysis, the invention adopts the structured mesh to rapidly divide the mesh, improves the self-adaptive integration strategy in the prior finite cell method, and further improves the simulation efficiency. Meanwhile, a penalty function method is adopted to weakly apply the displacement boundary condition. Furthermore, the results of the finite cell method calculations are mapped into a smoother visualization model in post-processing. Through comparison of calculation examples, the invention is verified to be capable of checking domain analysis of the unfolding strength of the complex lattice structure in a stable and efficient manner, and a feasibility scheme is provided for efficient analysis of large-scale complex engineering structures.

title: Debugging method and device of semi-physical simulation system and computer equipment
abstract: The application relates to a debugging method and device of a semi-physical simulation system and computer equipment. The method utilizes a dual-mode dynamic switching architecture, adopts a dynamic analysis scheme based on configuration files during debugging, and can meet the requirements of flexible adjustment in a debugging stage and convenient and flexible debugging. After debugging is completed, the protocol conversion configuration file is compiled into a machine code in advance by using a JIT compiling technology, and the machine code is compiled once and used for multiple times, so that analysis configuration and dynamic calculation during each time of packing/unpacking can be reduced, delay is reduced, throughput is improved, and simulation operation efficiency is improved. The method can realize the combination of the flexibility requirement of the debugging stage and the performance requirement of the operation stage.

abstract: The invention relates to a simulation method and a simulation device for improving insulation level of an insulation electric field in an isolation switch, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a multi-physical field coupling model of the isolation switch, wherein physical fields comprise an electromagnetic field of the isolation switch and a dilute substance transmission field of the isolation switch, constructing a geometric model according to a structure of the isolation switch, endowing the geometric model with material properties and introducing insulation gas parameters, setting boundary conditions of each physical field to optimize the geometric model to obtain a geometric optimization model, solving the geometric optimization model to obtain an optimal profile curve, wherein the optimal profile curve is the optimal size distribution of a structure of the isolation switch, obtaining the geometric model corresponding to the optimal profile curve, and solving to obtain the optimal electric field distribution and the optimal charge distribution. According to the invention, the field intensity distribution influence caused by the accumulation of surface charges of the isolating switch is researched, so that the electric potential and electric field intensity distribution under the influence of different sizes under direct current voltage are obtained, and the safe and stable operation of the isolating switch is facilitated.

In this case, according to the invention, a predefined, specific hierarchy is used for the partial status of the data base. The invention also relates to a computer-implemented system for behavior planning of an at least partially automated host vehicle.

abstract: The invention discloses a high-resolution urban wind speed prediction method based on a typical neighborhood model, which comprises the following steps of classifying the typical neighborhood model of a research area according to urban morphology indexes, establishing a corresponding geometric model, simulating a plurality of typical neighborhood models and real plots in the research area under different wind speed and wind direction conditions by using a computational fluid dynamics method, obtaining wind speed distribution results, constructing a database for representing the downscale change characteristics of urban wind speed, obtaining the weather boundary conditions of the medium-scale resolution in the research area by using a weather research and forecast model, constructing a multi-scale model of a nested grid, and training and verifying an MLP-CNN model combined by a multi-layer perceptron and a convolutional neural network to realize the high-resolution urban wind speed prediction of the research area.

title: Flexible antenna performance determining method and device, terminal equipment and storage medium
abstract: The application is suitable for the technical field of antenna test, and provides a method, a device, terminal equipment and a storage medium for determining the performance of a flexible antenna, wherein the method firstly generates a three-dimensional simulation model of the flexible antenna to be tested according to attribute parameters of the flexible antenna to be tested, and then combining the three-dimensional simulation model of the flexible antenna to be tested with preset deformation parameters to generate deformation simulation models of the flexible antenna to be tested under different deformation amounts, and finally determining the deformation resistance of the flexible antenna to be tested according to the deformation simulation models under each deformation amount. According to the embodiment of the application, a traditional mode of simulating antenna deformation by utilizing the Poisson characteristic of a material is abandoned, a deformation simulation model of the flexible antenna to be tested under different deformation is generated by a physical simulation method, the physical characterization of the flexible antenna in the deformation process is accurately and in detail described, and the deformation resistance of the antenna structure can be effectively evaluated.

title: Autonomous vehicle fault injection testing
abstract: Techniques for fault injection testing are described herein. The techniques may include receiving, at a computing device, an indication to simulate a fault associated with a component of a vehicle. The computing device may be coupled to the component via a control line that includes a relay or switch component that, when activated, causes the component to simulate the fault. The computing device may also receive data indicative of a vehicle response, such as a measured trajectory of the vehicle in response to the fault, whether a backup system of the vehicle performed correctly in response to the fault, whether the vehicle responded to the fault within a threshold period of time, and the like. The computing device may determine a difference between the vehicle response and an intended response of the vehicle relative to a threshold difference.

title: Bionic honeycomb liquid-cooling micro-channel heat exchanger structure and design method thereof
abstract: The invention provides a bionic honeycomb liquid cooling micro-channel heat exchanger structure and a design method thereof, wherein the structure comprises a three-dimensional modeling design, a computational fluid dynamics optimization design and comprehensive performance comparison of a heat exchanger, a three-dimensional modeling software is utilized to design an inner channel structure of a bionic honeycomb and a heat source connecting part at the bottom of the heat exchanger, finite element software is introduced, grids are divided, a finite element model is established, a laminar flow model is arranged, boundary conditions such as a heat source, cooling water flow and the like are added, fluid flow and heat transfer simulation in the heat exchanger are carried out, a bionic honeycomb heat exchanger fluid dynamics model is obtained, and temperature field and flow field data are recorded. Calculating the comprehensive performance of the bionic honeycomb liquid cooling micro-channel heat exchanger, changing the structural parameters to compare the comprehensive performance of the honeycomb heat exchangers with different structures, and finally optimizing to obtain the bionic honeycomb liquid cooling micro-channel heat exchanger with the optimal comprehensive performance. The invention realizes the organic combination of design/performance and provides theoretical guidance for the structural design of the bionic honeycomb liquid cooling micro-channel heat exchanger.

title: Hydraulic pump air tightness multi-physical field coupling simulation method
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of hydraulic pump simulation, and discloses a hydraulic pump air tightness multi-physical field coupling simulation method. The method comprises the steps of firstly establishing a three-dimensional geometric model based on hydraulic pump structural parameters, setting multi-physical field coupling boundary conditions such as a fluid field, a temperature field, a stress field and the like, and then carrying out dynamic grid division to generate an adaptive grid topological structure. And inputting the boundary conditions into a coupling solver for iterative computation to obtain initial simulation data, optimizing a grid model according to residual distribution, executing multi-field coupling simulation computation by using the optimized model, and outputting a result. The coupling solver is subjected to history experimental data training construction, the grid can be subjected to local encryption or sparsification, simulation results are stored in a classified mode, access keys are set to ensure safety, and the solver can be optimized according to different working conditions. The method can comprehensively consider the coupling effect of multiple physical fields, improves simulation precision and calculation efficiency, and provides effective support for the study of the air tightness of the hydraulic pump and the design optimization.

abstract: The invention provides a method and a system for monitoring deformation of a stock dam group based on Beidou multisource fusion, wherein satellite observation signals and sensing data of a stock dam group monitoring area are received to obtain multisource input data, a preset stock dam group digital twin body model is input to simulate physical behaviors of a stock dam group structure to generate a global deformation field, the global deformation field is used as an initial boundary condition to be input into a deformation conduction dynamics model module in the stock dam group digital twin body model, deformation key conduction paths existing in the stock dam group are identified, stress-deformation forward algorithm and reverse tracing analysis are executed in the stock dam group digital twin body model based on the deformation key conduction paths, influence weights of core risk sources on deformation of the stock dam group are calculated, simulation scenes of various regulation strategies are constructed in the stock dam group digital twin body model, and simulation deduction is carried out on the deformation trend of the stock dam group under each simulation scene to obtain deformation early warning information. title: Generator maintenance test data processing method
abstract: The invention discloses a generator maintenance test data processing method, which particularly relates to the technical field of aviation generator maintenance tests and is used for solving the problems of fault diagnosis misalignment and insufficient maintenance evaluation compliance caused by data sparseness in the prior art, extracting working condition parameter boundary conditions through analysis of airworthiness test rules, constructing a physical rule constraint matrix based on an electromagnetic-thermal-force coupling relation, dynamically reconstructing the constraint matrix according to characteristic value attenuation indexes, generating physical consistency strengthening data by combining measured data with the reconstruction matrix in an optimization mode, injecting disturbance into the strengthening data boundary and marking a high risk migration area, and finally generating maintenance evaluation decisions of airworthiness compliance based on marked data to realize physical rule consistency strengthening and security risk quantification control of the maintenance test data.

title: Method for determining winding parameters of pressure vessel, readable storage medium and electronic device
abstract: A method for determining winding parameters of a pressure container comprises the steps of obtaining stress functions, strain functions and displacement functions of all layers based on a pressure container mechanical model and boundary conditions, forming a failure factor, a radial deformation amount, a relation between layers and fiber angles of each layer based on the stress functions, the strain functions and the displacement functions of the layers and a strength failure criterion of the pressure container, and determining the fiber angles of each layer through an optimization algorithm based on the failure factor, the radial deformation amount, the relation between the layers and the fiber angles of each layer. According to the method, one or more groups of preferred fiber angles are obtained through an optimization algorithm, the fiber angles corresponding to the minimum number of layers can be obtained by adjusting the given number of layers and keeping the failure factors and the radial deformation to meet the requirements, the carbon fiber direction is not limited by 0 degree/+/-45 degrees/90 degrees or other given angles, a theoretical optimal layering scheme can be found after the constraint is eliminated, and the method is more beneficial to the weight reduction and the strength and rigidity design of the pressure vessel.

title: Intelligent order reduction method for head and cavity simulation model of combustion chamber of liquid rocket engine
abstract: The invention provides an intelligent order reduction method for a liquid rocket engine combustion chamber head cavity simulation model, which comprises the steps of establishing a numerical simulation model of the liquid rocket engine combustion chamber head cavity based on the structure and the working principle of the liquid rocket engine combustion chamber head cavity, carrying out numerical simulation calculation based on the numerical simulation model and preset boundary conditions, constructing a data set based on the numerical simulation calculation result, and training a preset neural network model based on the data set to obtain a target order reduction model of the liquid rocket engine combustion chamber head cavity. The invention can realize the intelligent order reduction of the combustion chamber head and cavity simulation model, and can ensure the simulation precision of the combustion chamber head and cavity of the liquid rocket engine while improving the simulation efficiency of the combustion chamber head and cavity of the liquid rocket engine.

title: Simulation design method applied to simulation surface acoustic wave filter
abstract: The invention provides a simulation design method applied to a simulated surface acoustic wave filter, which comprises the steps of measuring an actual surface acoustic wave filter model, obtaining Y parameters of the filter, performing de-embedding treatment on an admittance characteristic curve, extracting COM model parameters and static capacitance according to the admittance characteristic curve, performing coupling mode model data simulation according to the extracted COM model parameters, comparing the coupling mode model data with actual measurement data, performing geometric modeling on a SAW filter to obtain a multi-physical field model and grids thereof, adding corresponding boundary conditions and excitation conditions to the geometric model, generating grid files, introducing the grid files into a spectral element algorithm, adopting distributed operation to save calculation time, and comparing the simulation curve of the generated COM model with the simulation curve and the actual measurement data obtained by the spectral element algorithm. The simulation accuracy is not affected, and meanwhile, the problem of overlong simulation duration of the existing acoustic wave filter is greatly accelerated.

title: Axle coupling system analysis method based on physical information neural network
abstract: The invention discloses an axle coupling system analysis method based on a physical information neural network, relates to the technical field of vehicle-axle coupling systems, and aims to solve the problem of low calculation accuracy of dynamics of the vehicle-axle coupling systems. The axle coupling system analysis method based on the physical information neural network comprises the steps of establishing a vehicle model and a bridge model, establishing an axle coupling system according to the vehicle model and the bridge model, establishing the physical information neural network by taking a motion equation of the axle coupling system as a constraint condition and integrating an initial condition and a boundary condition of the axle coupling system as a loss function, selecting a plurality of random points in the axle coupling system to conduct iterative computation on the physical information neural network to obtain a trained neural network, and calculating the motion equation of the axle coupling system through the trained neural network to obtain vibration response of the axle coupling system.

The method is suitable for the work of predicting the surface temperature field and the pressure field of the turbine blade.

title: Construction method of explosive fusion casting process temperature prediction model and explosive fusion casting process temperature control system
abstract: The invention discloses a construction method of a temperature prediction model in an explosive casting process, which comprises the following steps of firstly, respectively constructing two PINN neural network models, wherein the first PINN neural network model is used for learning a thermal boundary condition in the explosive casting process to obtain the best approximation in a thermal boundary condition parameter space, the second PINN neural network model is used for constructing a proxy model to realize the quick prediction of the temperature in the explosive casting process, secondly, training and verifying the proxy model by using temperature field data in the explosive casting process, and thirdly, inputting the best approximation in the thermal boundary condition parameter space obtained by the first PINN neural network model into the proxy model obtained by training in the second step, and constructing the temperature prediction model of the explosive casting process capable of obtaining the temperature information in the explosive casting process. The invention also discloses a temperature control system for the explosive fusion casting process.

title: Airplane control surface servo actuator simulation method considering hinge moment influence
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of simulation and simulation of actuators, in particular to a simulation method of an aircraft control surface servo actuator considering the influence of a hinge moment, which is characterized in that an external current control command is received through an external system interface and a closed loop control module, control surface position and speed data are fed back, a fault setting and aerodynamic force data interface is provided, a current control command processing module is entered, fault simulation processing is carried out on the current control command received in the step 1, the simulation of hydraulic fault, electromagnetic valve blocking, command dead zone and control signal out-of-control is carried out, a dynamically-changed hinge moment influence factor is coupled with the movement speed of the actuator through a hinge moment coupling module, the defect that the load is simplified into a constant moment in the existing model is overcome, the influence of a pneumatic environment on the control surface movement is truly reflected, a simulation result is more close to an actual flight state, and a more reliable reference basis is provided for aircraft development, ground test and flight training.

title: Method and system for designing and evaluating performance of hollow fiber membrane contactors, i.e., MBCs, in natural gas desulfurization processes
abstract: In the examples a computer-implemented method for designing and evaluating the performance of a hollow fiber membrane contactor (MBC) in a natural gas desulfurization process is described. The MBC model includes model parameters, model equations, and boundary conditions for calculating data associated with the natural gas desulfurization process. The natural gas desulfurization process includes removing acid gases from natural gas using a solvent comprising at least one component. The method includes (i) forming a regression model using empirical data, (ii) determining a henry constant for CO  2  in the solvent using the regression model, (iii) inputting the determined henry constant for CO  2  in the MBC model as one of the model parameters, and (iv) determining CO  2  absorption in the solvent using the MBC model to design and evaluate MBC performance.

abstract: The invention relates to a dissimilar stainless steel inertia friction welding flash forming and multi-physical field prediction method which comprises the following steps of S1, establishing an inertia friction welding model, S2, setting material attribute parameters, S3, dividing grids, S4, setting clamp actions, S5, setting boundary conditions, S6, setting interaction and friction behaviors between contact surfaces, S7, constructing a inertia friction welding process thermal-force coupling model, calculating and obtaining temperature change data of characteristic points to obtain simulated welding flash morphology, enabling iteration times i=1, starting iterative simulation calculation, namely updating model parameters according to the temperature change data of the characteristic points, judging whether the temperature of the characteristic points and the simulated flash morphology reach termination conditions, stopping iteration to obtain simulation prediction results, and otherwise, reading the temperature change data of the ith iteration characteristic points, and enabling i=i+1. title: Method for simulating and analyzing water inrush catastrophe in tunnel construction based on peridynamics and techniques for optimizing tunnel construction

title: Computer-implemented method and system for monitoring trajectory suggestions for an automated operating mode of a vehicle
abstract: A computer-implemented method and system which enable a practical verification and meaningful evaluation of trajectories suggested by a planning module for an automated operating mode of a vehicle. The method includes: aggregating situation-specific information; generating a surroundings model based on the situation-specific information; ascertaining possible behaviors of the vehicle based on the situation-specific information and the surroundings model, wherein each behavior is described by a set of boundary conditions; and prioritizing the possible behaviors of the vehicle based on the boundary conditions in conjunction with a predefined set of rules. A compatibility check is carried out for a suggested trajectory and at least one of the ascertained behaviors by checking whether the suggested trajectory satisfies the boundary conditions of the respective behavior. The suggested trajectory is then evaluated based on the results of these compatibility checks and the prioritizations of the respective behaviors.

title: Tidal flat evolution prediction method and system based on hybrid model
abstract: The invention provides a tidal flat evolution prediction method and system based on a hybrid model, which relate to the technical field of intersection of dynamic geomorphology and artificial intelligence and comprise the steps of constructing a tidal flat erosion and deposition evolution database under different situations of a target coastal zone; the method comprises the steps of establishing a topography prediction model through an artificial intelligent algorithm based on a database, taking hydrodynamic feature data as input and seabed scouring and silting change amount as output, performing hybrid simulation based on a physical mechanism model and the topography prediction model, updating topography boundary conditions through cyclic iteration to realize long-duration evolution prediction, configuring a service application module, receiving user input parameters through an interactive interface and outputting a visual result. According to the invention, the traditional hydrodynamic force-sediment-landform coupling calculation is decoupled into a chain-type flow with a physical mechanism and AI cooperated, so that the calculation complexity is obviously reduced, the off-line rapid calculation business of tidal flat evolution is realized, and a real-time technical support is provided for coastal zone planning and disaster prevention decision.

title: Temperature field prediction and parameter inversion method for generating countermeasure network based on physical constraint
abstract: The invention relates to a temperature field prediction and parameter inversion method for generating an countermeasure network based on physical constraints, which comprises the following steps of obtaining sensor data and sampling random latent variables, constructing a generated countermeasure model comprising a generator, a discriminator, an auxiliary parameter generator and an auxiliary variation encoder based on partial differential equations of the sensor data and the physical constraints, generating parameters of the countermeasure model by minimizing reverse KL divergence and introducing physical consistency constraints, boundary condition constraints and information entropy regularization items in a combined mode, inputting new space-time coordinates and the random latent variables after offline training is completed, obtaining a temperature field prediction result through a trained generator, and obtaining PDE parameter estimation of corresponding positions by utilizing the auxiliary parameter generator. title: Nuclear power plant hydrogen risk analysis method, system, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention discloses a method, a system, electronic equipment and a storage medium for analyzing hydrogen risk of a nuclear power plant, and relates to the technical field of safety analysis of the nuclear power plant. The method comprises the steps of establishing a key parameter probability distribution model of a nuclear power plant hydrogen starting accident, generating an initial condition combination sample set of the key parameters based on a probability sampling method, constructing a thermodynamic hydraulic calculation working condition matrix, executing high-fidelity simulation of full-sample working conditions, generating a containment multi-compartment space-time evolution data set, utilizing the data set training time sequence neural network model to achieve mapping of accident progress and multi-physical field parameters, inputting real-time accident types and monitoring initial values, driving the model to output hydrogen concentration prediction, and synchronously completing dynamic assessment of AICC risk and DDT risk. According to the invention, through efficient calculation and data analysis means, the rapid probability assessment of the diffusion, aggregation and explosion results of hydrogen in the containment is realized, and the risk research and judgment speed and decision reliability under severe accidents of the nuclear power plant are remarkably improved.

title: Gas turbine rotor blade temperature field prediction method, system and medium
abstract: The application relates to a method, a system and a medium for predicting a temperature field of a rotor blade of a gas turbine, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a high-fidelity finite element discrete model of the rotor blade of the gas turbine, and obtaining a snapshot matrix of the temperature field of the blade through high-fidelity finite element thermodynamic simulation calculation based on the high-fidelity finite element discrete model. And establishing a reduced base according to a reduced method, constructing a temperature field based on the reduced base and a constitutive equation, and constructing an initial temperature field prediction model according to a preset depth operator network frame based on the temperature field. And carrying out iterative training on the neural network in the initial temperature field prediction model through the training set to obtain the target temperature field prediction model. And predicting the temperature field of the current gas turbine blade based on the target temperature field prediction model according to the boundary condition of the current gas turbine rotor blade, and obtaining the real-time prediction result of the blade temperature field. The problem of temperature field prediction inefficiency exists in the correlation technique under a large amount of operating modes is solved.

title: Digital twinning-based laser cutting thermal error compensation method
abstract: A laser cutting thermal error compensation method based on digital twin comprises the following steps of S1, establishing a laser heat source model, S2, establishing a thermal deformation theoretical model, setting deformation boundary conditions through three basic modes of heat conduction, heat convection and heat radiation, describing thermal deformation through thermal expansion, S3, establishing a finite element model according to the boundary conditions and workpiece parameters of the finite element model, verifying rationality of the finite element model through manufacturer recommended parameters, generating a discretized real-time processing data set when judging rationality, S4, predicting the thermal deformation of a cutting process by taking the discretized real-time processing data set as a training data set of a machine learning algorithm to generate a thermal deformation prediction cloud image, S5, cutting, driving virtual and real information transmission through a digital twin technology, and compensating cutting speed in real time according to the cutting thermal deformation amount. The application can reduce the thermal deformation amount of the joint, reasonably avoid thermal errors and improve the laser cutting precision.

title: Reliability analysis method based on self-adaptive agent model and importance sampling
abstract: The invention relates to a reliability analysis method based on a self-adaptive agent model and importance sampling, which belongs to the technical field of interventional medical stents, solves the problem of low reliability analysis efficiency of medical stents in the prior art, is used for reliability analysis of mechanical thrombus taking stents, and comprises the following steps of quantifying random parameter probability distribution of the mechanical thrombus taking stents and initializing algorithm parameters; generating random samples to obtain a training sample set and a candidate sample set, constructing and training a Kriging proxy model of a finite element model of the mechanical thrombus taking support, establishing an updated supersphere, converging and judging the radius of the updated supersphere, cross-verifying the precision of the trained Kriging proxy model by a leave-one-out method, calculating failure probability, calculating a failure probability variation coefficient and converging and judging, and when the convergence is judged to be finished, using the failure probability for safety evaluation and optimization design of the mechanical thrombus taking support, otherwise, expanding the size of the candidate sample set and returning to regenerate the random samples.

title: Catalyst simulation method based on lattice Boltzmann model
abstract: The invention discloses a catalyst simulation method based on a lattice Boltzmann model, and belongs to the field of water electrolysis hydrogen production. The method constructs three typical catalyst forms, abstracts two parameters of the bubble coverage area and the electrochemical activity surface area from the three typical catalyst forms to describe the catalyst form, sets corresponding boundary conditions according to actual conditions to enable simulation results to be more in line with the actual conditions, and analyzes the bubble separation time, the bubble generation diameter and the bubble coverage area in different catalyst forms by using a Shan-Chen multi-component lattice Boltzmann model. The invention discloses a relation between the appearance of the catalyst and the evolution of bubbles, which can better guide the optimization of the appearance of the catalyst and promote the improvement of the performance of the hydrogen production system by electrolyzing water.

title: Wind field correction method and system applied to single-station remote sensing device
abstract: Disclosed in the present invention are a wind field correction method and system applied to a single-station remote sensing device. The method comprises the following specific steps: S1, acquiring wind field data by means of a data information acquisition apparatus, and obtaining radial wind speed information of a current acquisition point by means of a data processing module; S2, on the basis of the hypothesis of an uniform wind field, using a classical wind speed reconstruction algorithm for inversion to obtain a three-dimensional wind speed vector of the acquisition point; S3, establishing an error model; and S4, on the basis of an error factor β calculated by means of the error model, performing data correction on the three-dimensional wind speed vector of the acquisition point obtained by means of inversion in S2. Compared with the prior art, the present invention provides a high-precision correction method, which can be operated on low-end hardware, and can also be directly installed and operated on hardware of a measurement device, so that measurement results can be corrected in real time, no additional complexity can be brought to users, and costs are reduced; and the present invention is suitable for solving complex system problems when accurate boundary conditions cannot be obtained.

title: Physics-based simulation of milling operations in an industrial metaverse
abstract: System and method are disclosed for simulating manufacturing of a part by material removal. A simulation module executes a simulation of material removal by a cutting tool based on a sparse voxelization of a workpiece material and a discretized set of tool surface points. A voxelization module generates a sparse voxelization of the workpiece material and a discretization of tool surface points. A tool physics module computes reaction forces based on a set of marked tool surface points and marked material voxels and computes resulting temperature increase used to predict resulting tool wear over the course of a material removal step. The tool wear information is exported to the simulation module using a feedback loop.

title: Industrial equipment topology optimization method and system based on deep learning
abstract: The invention provides an industrial equipment topology optimization method and system based on deep learning, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing an equipment model to be optimized based on a finite element modeling algorithm, setting displacement boundary conditions for model optimization, constructing a convolutional neural network model, determining a multi-channel tensor of an input convolutional neural network based on a variable density method according to model geometric parameters and load parameters of the equipment model and the displacement boundary conditions, inputting the multi-channel tensor into the convolutional neural network model which is trained to obtain target density distribution of the equipment model, and combining density parameters in a material set to obtain topology optimization results of the equipment model.

title: Aluminum alloy DC casting planktonic crystal distribution simulation method
abstract: The invention discloses a simulation method of semi-continuous/DC casting floating crystal distribution of aluminum alloy, which comprises the following steps of S1, establishing a geometric model of an ingot according to geometric modeling parameters, casting parameters, thermophysical parameters, boundary conditions and initial conditions of a product, obtaining a casting model according to a flow field, a temperature field and a concentration field in a solidification process of the ingot, S2, establishing a crystal grain motion capturing model, setting an initial crystal grain generation mode and an effective criterion thereof according to the casting model, simulating a crystal grain nucleation area in the solidification process to obtain a crystal grain distribution result, S3, taking the crystal grain distribution result as a first initial condition, and introducing crystal grain growth/reflow factors in the casting process by combining the temperature field and the concentration field to obtain the distribution state of floating crystals in the casting process. By combining with the macrosegregation model, the invention considers the influences of the nucleation position, growth and remelting of the crystal grains, can realize the simulation of the floating crystal movement and distribution characteristics in the casting process, and is beneficial to improving the casting quality.

title: Cost optimization method of electric-thermal coupling virtual power plant based on random optimization method
abstract: The application provides a cost optimization method of an electric-thermal coupling virtual power plant based on a random optimization method, which comprises the steps of obtaining historical operation parameters; the method comprises the steps of constructing a physical simulation model of each component element according to historical operation parameters to obtain a power plant operation model, constructing an operation cost model of each component element according to the historical operation parameters to obtain a power plant cost model, determining uncertainty parameters of a virtual power plant according to the historical operation parameters and constructing a randomness model, constructing a target constraint group based on the power plant operation model, carrying out risk avoidance solution and opportunity seek solution according to an IGDT (insulated gate bipolar transistor) method based on system uncertainty to obtain first uncertainty and second uncertainty, further solving power plant control parameters, and controlling the virtual power plant to operate according to the power plant control parameters. The method solves the problem that the prior art lacks a comprehensive cogeneration unit, carbon capture and electrical replacement equipment, and meets the low-cost and low-carbon requirements of a virtual power plant scheduling optimization method.
