title: Deep learning-based metallurgical equipment fault simulation modeling and control method
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of metallurgical equipment health management, and particularly relates to a fault simulation modeling and control method for metallurgical equipment based on deep learning. S1, fault simulation modeling, namely establishing a three-dimensional heat conduction partial differential equation and solving to obtain temperature field space-time distribution T (x, T) and a temperature gradient field S2, deep learning fault diagnosis, wherein T (x, T) is calculated And 3, inputting a three-dimensional convolutional neural network 3D-CNN to identify a temperature distribution abnormal mode and locate a fault source, and S3, predicting the residual life. According to the invention, the temperature gradient field of the temperature field output by the three-dimensional heat conduction partial differential equation is used as the dual-channel input of the 3D-CNN, the thermal stress risk is quantified by directly utilizing the physical field, and analysis is performed from two aspects of mechanism and data monitoring, so that the limitation that the traditional method only depends on the original temperature data is broken through.

title: Simulation method and device for motor equipment hybrid system, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract: The application relates to the technical field of power electronics, in particular to a simulation method, a simulation device, electronic equipment and a storage medium of a motor equipment hybrid system, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a complete system model of the motor equipment hybrid system; the method comprises the steps of introducing an interface element into a complete system model, dividing the complete system model into an electrical system model and a multidisciplinary system model through the interface element, wherein the electrical system model and the multidisciplinary system model are communicated through signals, the interface element and the multidisciplinary system model have complete boundary conditions, generating a functional model unit according to the interface element and the multidisciplinary system model, and simulating a motor equipment hybrid system according to the functional model unit and the electrical system model. Therefore, the problem that in a practical complex system, a multidisciplinary model is usually part of motor equipment and a system, a complete dynamic equation is not provided, and an FMU cannot be derived by using a model layer coupling mode of the FMI is solved.

title: Method, system and storage medium for enhancing fault voiceprint diagnosis sample of transformer
abstract: The invention provides a method, a system and a storage medium for enhancing fault voiceprint diagnosis samples of a transformer, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing an acoustic wave equation and medium interface boundary conditions of vibration of an iron core and a winding in medium propagation; performing sound field simulation on the fault model according to the acoustic wave equation and the boundary condition of the medium interface to obtain a fault simulation sound field, determining a physical simulation data set according to the fault simulation sound field, performing sparse representation on the physical simulation data set to obtain a sparse dictionary and a sparse coefficient matrix, performing migration learning on a real fault sample to obtain a migration dictionary, and performing sample enhancement according to the sparse dictionary, the sparse coefficient matrix and the migration dictionary to obtain a transformer fault voiceprint enhancement sample. According to the embodiment of the invention, the sample enhancement is performed through the sparse dictionary, the sparse coefficient matrix and the migration dictionary, so that the sample enhancement effect on the transformer fault sample can be effectively realized.

title: Lightning arrester multi-physical field coupling simulation method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract: The method obtains material parameters of each component of the lightning arrester by constructing a three-dimensional geometric model of the lightning arrester, and determines waveform parameters of impulse current according to actual current waveforms of the lightning arrester under the action of the impulse current. Establishing a multi-physical field coupling model of the lightning arrester, setting electric field boundary conditions, thermal field boundary conditions and mechanical field boundary conditions of the multi-physical field coupling model, dividing the three-dimensional geometric model into a plurality of grid areas, performing simulation calculation based on the multi-physical field coupling model to obtain a simulation calculation result of each grid area, and analyzing electric field distribution conditions, thermal field distribution conditions and mechanical field distribution conditions of the lightning arrester based on the simulation calculation result of each grid area. Compared with the prior art, the embodiment of the disclosure can comprehensively consider the interaction of the electric field, the thermal field and the mechanical field, and can accurately simulate the response of the lightning arrester in a complex electric environment.

title: Method and device for selecting frequency division type separator parameters
abstract: The application provides a method and a device for selecting parameters of a frequency division type separator, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining initial physical parameters, respectively carrying out electric field calculation and magnetic field calculation on the initial physical parameters to obtain electromagnetic parameters, calculating heat source items and electromagnetic force according to the electromagnetic parameters, wherein the electromagnetic parameters comprise electric field intensity, current density and magnetic field intensity, simultaneously solving an energy conservation equation, a mass conservation equation and a momentum conservation equation under a temperature field boundary condition and a flow field boundary condition by utilizing the heat source items and the electromagnetic force to obtain a temperature field, a speed field and a pressure field, and selecting target parameters of the frequency division type separator according to the temperature field, the speed field and the pressure field, wherein the target parameters comprise a discharge gap distance, an inductance value of a frequency division inductance, a spark gap distance and a heating resistance value. The application solves the problem of low performance of the frequency division type separator caused by lack of system selection of parameters of the frequency division type separator in the prior art.

title: Semi-physical simulation and VR combination method, equipment and medium
abstract: The invention provides a semi-physical simulation and VR combining method, equipment and medium, which are applied to the technical field of VR simulation, and comprise the steps of firstly acquiring rescue operation dynamic data acquired by semi-physical equipment, combining a data classification model, carrying out priority classification transmission on the rescue operation dynamic data, and adaptively adjusting time slot allocation and path selection; the model is provided with a dynamic redundancy mechanism for ensuring communication continuity, and finally, the rendering parameters of the virtual scene and virtual-real interaction rules are dynamically adjusted according to priority, time slot allocation and path selection. The method and the device realize accurate priority division and self-adaptive resource allocation of dynamic data of rescue operation through a data classification model, ensure continuous and stable communication between semi-physical equipment and a VR system by combining a dynamic redundancy mechanism, solve the problems of real-time and reliability of data transmission in nuclear emergency medical rescue, and simultaneously dynamically correlate the data transmission state with virtual scene rendering parameters and interaction rules to realize cooperative optimization of transmission and rendering.

title: Power distribution network fault simulation method for superconducting current limiter optimal configuration
abstract: The application discloses a power distribution network fault simulation method for optimizing configuration of a superconducting current limiter, which relates to the technical field of data processing, and comprises the steps of obtaining real-time operation parameters of a power distribution network monitored by various sensors; the method comprises the steps of calculating to obtain index anomaly degree corresponding to each sensor position based on the real-time operation parameters, determining fault evolution progress of each sensor position based on the index anomaly degree, determining overall fault severity of the power distribution network under the current round based on the fault evolution progress of each sensor position, and carrying out current limit simulation on the power distribution network based on the fault severity to obtain simulation results. The application improves the actual current limiting effect of the current limiter on faults.

title: North ocean wave forecasting method based on automatic sea ice concentration fusion
abstract: The invention provides a North polar sea wave forecasting method based on automatic sea ice concentration fusion, which belongs to the technical field of weather forecasting, and aims to ensure the continuity of wind field driving data by establishing a wind field data automatic acquisition system, dynamically adjust parameters of an IC4M2 sea ice wave parameterization scheme by applying a sea ice wave interaction optimization model, set a boundary line in a North atlantic high-latitude sea area, process boundary wave propagation by adopting a radiation boundary condition algorithm and a sponge layer absorption technology, start WAVEWATCH III sea wave numerical mode, and use a four-order precision finite difference discrete format and a self-adaptive artificial viscosity control algorithm to calculate the North polar sea wave field, establish a sea wave forecasting product business post-processing system and solve the technical problem of lower North polar sea wave forecasting accuracy caused by insufficient sea ice wave interaction parameterization precision.

title: Stress calculation method, device, equipment and medium for floating fan foundation structure
abstract: The application relates to a stress calculation method, device, equipment and medium of a floating fan foundation structure, which comprises the steps of carrying out frequency domain potential hydrodynamic force analysis on a basic floating body wet surface element model of the floating fan to obtain hydrodynamic force pressure distribution and hydrodynamic force coefficients, applying boundary conditions and loading various working conditions on a simulation model of the floating fan foundation structure, carrying out finite element analysis on the basis of the hydrodynamic force pressure distribution to obtain various structural stress transfer functions, carrying out linear processing on the influence of fan aerodynamic force, impeller aerodynamic torque, floating body hydrodynamic force, mooring restoring force and a fan servo controller of the floating fan on the basis of the hydrodynamic force coefficients, substituting linearization results into a motion equation of the floating fan to calculate to obtain various dynamic response spectrums, multiplying the structural stress transfer functions with corresponding dynamic response spectrums respectively, and adding a plurality of multiplied results to obtain a total stress spectrum. The method can improve efficiency.

title: Experimental device and method for simulating shale fan-shaped well pattern optimization in high-temperature high-pressure environment
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of physical simulation of oil and gas reservoir development, and relates to an experimental device and method for simulating shale fan-shaped well pattern optimization in a high-temperature and high-pressure environment. The device pumps the coal oil into the high-temperature high-pressure bin through the fluid injection assembly to realize a high-pressure environment, lays a fan-shaped well pattern on the heterogeneous semi-cylindrical model, sets cracks on the horizontal well section, injects the fluid through the central vertical well section, acquires data in real time through the saturation and pressure monitoring assembly, and simulates the high-temperature high-pressure stratum environment by combining with the temperature control assembly, thereby optimizing the distance between the fan-shaped well pattern, the length of the horizontal section and the number of the cracks. The method can effectively simulate the fluid migration law of the shale reservoir under the complex well pattern structure, and provides an optimal design basis for shale gas development.

abstract: The invention relates to a relay protection test system and method of an electrochemical energy storage power station access system, wherein the relay protection test system comprises a power supply unit, a voltage regulating circuit, an energy storage monitoring upper computer, a converter main circuit physical simulation unit, a real-time simulation upper computer, a real-time simulation target machine and a transformer simulation unit, wherein the power supply unit is used for simulating an electrochemical energy storage power station to perform charge and discharge, the voltage regulating circuit is used for regulating voltage and simulating charge and discharge characteristics of a battery, the energy storage monitoring upper computer is used for starting energy storage operation and sending a battery simulation control command, the converter main circuit physical simulation unit is used for simulating a battery converter main circuit, the real-time simulation upper computer is used for establishing an energy storage converter control model and a control program, the real-time simulation target machine is used for outputting a converter control command to the real-time simulation target machine, the real-time simulation target machine is used for controlling the converter main circuit physical simulation unit, the electric system physical simulation unit is used for outputting an electric quantity primary value, and the transformer simulation unit is used for converting the electric quantity primary value into an electric quantity secondary value to be output to a relay protection device to be tested, and determining a test result based on the action condition of the relay protection device to be tested.

title: Concrete dam humidity field sensitivity analysis method for surface insulation board before and after dismantling
abstract: The invention provides a concrete dam humidity field sensitivity analysis method for a surface insulation board before and after dismantling, which comprises the following steps of S1, determining relevant parameters affecting humidity field analysis, S2, determining corresponding humidity boundary conditions and humidity fields, S3, constructing a finite element analysis model of a concrete block, S4, performing humidity field simulation calculation, setting corresponding concrete parameters according to the humidity environment where the concrete dam is located and test results, and S5, simulating the influence of the humidity field of the concrete and the change of the humidity field of the concrete after dismantling the surface insulation board on the structural state of the concrete dam when the surface insulation board is not dismantled. According to the method, different humidity boundary conditions are considered, the humidity loss caused by the hydration heat of the concrete, the humidity continuously changes along with time and other factors are considered, and the influence of the humidity field change on the stress field and the working state of the concrete dam is obtained by analyzing and calculating the humidity fields before and after the insulation board on the surface of the concrete dam is removed.

title: Similarity analysis method for spacecraft ground microgravity simulation platform
abstract: The invention discloses a method for analyzing the similarity of a spacecraft ground microgravity simulation platform, and belongs to the technical field of aerospace. The method comprises the steps of establishing a space dynamics model of a spacecraft ground microgravity semi-physical simulation platform, carrying out Lagrange dynamics rewrite on the space dynamics model to obtain a rewritten simulation platform, carrying out similarity analysis on the spacecraft ground microgravity semi-physical simulation platform and the rewritten simulation platform based on pi theorem, obtaining related space satellite platform parameters for determining design parameters of the rewritten simulation platform, designing a gesture scanning track and a gesture scanning PID control law for the related space satellite platform to obtain a space gesture scanning PID control law, carrying out similarity analysis on the space gesture scanning PID control law based on pi theorem, and designing gesture scanning PID control law parameters of the ground microgravity simulation platform to obtain a ground space gesture scanning PID control law. The dynamics and control effects of the platform can be made to coincide with the effects of the actual satellite in space.

title: Coal rock index parameter prediction method and device based on CT scanning
abstract: The application provides a coal rock index parameter prediction method and a device based on CT scanning, which relate to the technical field of coal, and the method comprises the steps of respectively carrying out CT scanning on N modeling coal samples to determine the fracture length-volume distribution characteristics of each modeling coal sample so as to construct a digital rock core corresponding to the modeling coal sample; carrying out a uniaxial or triaxial loading test on each modeling coal sample in the N modeling coal samples to obtain uniaxial or triaxial mechanical property parameters corresponding to each modeling coal sample, setting the effect between a crack structure and a matrix structure in each digital rock as a smooth joint model effect, setting the crack mesoscopic parameters corresponding to the crack structure in each digital rock as 0, calibrating the matrix mesoscopic parameters of the matrix structure of the digital rock based on the uniaxial mechanical property parameters and the triaxial mechanical property parameters, setting stress boundary conditions corresponding to a prediction index, and carrying out a simulation test on the calibrated digital rock to obtain the prediction parameters corresponding to the prediction index of the coal rock.

title: Method and device for constructing digital twin body of chip, predicting electrical parameter value, medium and electronic equipment
abstract: The application provides a method, a device, a medium and electronic equipment for constructing a digital twin body of a chip and predicting an electrical parameter value, wherein the method comprises the steps of performing physical simulation based on an ideal process flow provided with standard design parameters of a target chip to obtain a physical prediction model; and obtaining the digital twin body of the target chip based on the physical prediction model and the residual error correction model. The method provides an interpretable physical mechanism foundation through the physical prediction model constructed by physical simulation, and simultaneously accurately compensates nonlinear errors based on the residual error correction model constructed by the real data training set, so that the machine learning model only needs to focus on low-order simple mapping of learning process deviation, the construction complexity of the model is obviously reduced, and the prediction precision of the digital twin of the chip is improved.

title: General semi-physical simulation test system of traction system
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of semi-physical simulation of a traction system, in particular to a general semi-physical simulation test system of the traction system, which solves the technical problems in the background technology and comprises an upper computer, a real-time simulation environment simulation unit and a traction system physical control unit, wherein the upper computer is used for simulation management, automatic test and high-speed data monitoring, and the traction system physical control unit is a tested object of the semi-physical simulation test or test equipment of the simulation test system; the upper computer is connected with the real-time simulation environment simulation unit, the processor module is connected with the traction system real object control unit through the broken wire test unit and the signal conversion unit, and the broken wire test unit is connected with the upper computer through the high-speed data acquisition unit. The method realizes the expandability and fault tolerance of the test system by using a modularized design method, can realize the transformation of various topological structures by simple terminal plugging, improves the compatibility and universality of the simulation system, and covers the application requirements of all traction systems in the rail transit field.

title: Calculation method and system for two-dimensional foundation pit unsteady seepage field under suspension type retaining wall support
abstract: The application provides a method and a system for calculating an unsteady seepage field of a two-dimensional foundation pit under the support of a suspension retaining wall, and belongs to the technical field of computer aided design. Dividing the seepage field around the foundation pit into three regular areas, sequentially carrying out Laplace transformation, fourier transformation and inverse transformation on time variables in the non-steady state seepage balance equation and the boundary condition of each area according to the boundary condition when seepage does not occur as a zero moment boundary condition, obtaining an expression of a water head series solution of each area, constructing a non-homogeneous equation set by using continuous conditions among the areas, carrying out programming solution by using orthogonality of trigonometric functions, substituting the obtained constant items into the expression of the water head series solution of each area, and carrying out inverse transformation on the solved expression by using Stehfest method to obtain the expression of the water head series solution of the foundation pit non-steady state seepage field. The analysis solution of the seepage field calculated by the method has higher precision, and can accurately determine the dynamic change characteristics of the seepage field around the foundation pit along with time.

title: Single-phase medium nonlinear super-surface Schottky wave frequency dispersion relation calculation method and system
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of physical acoustics, in particular to a method and a system for calculating the dispersion relation of a nonlinear super-surface Schottky wave of a single-phase medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps of obtaining an expression of a displacement component and a stress component of the single-phase medium under the action of the Schottky wave; and applying stress and displacement continuity boundary conditions at the interface of the single-phase medium and the fluid layer based on all the expressions, so as to obtain a characteristic equation of the dispersion characteristic of the coupling system, solving the characteristic equation, and finally obtaining a dispersion curve of the coupling system. According to the invention, by providing the explicit dispersion relation of the nonlinear super-surface Schottky wave of the single-phase medium, the calculation efficiency and the prediction precision of the nonlinear super-surface interface wave propagation on the single-phase medium are improved, and the calculation cost and the design period of acoustic super-surface design, vibration suppression and waveguide regulation are reduced.

title: Multi-physical field topology optimization ash suppression method for multiphase intelligent material and structure, computer-readable storage medium and force-electric coupling multiphase material structure for 3D printing
abstract: The invention discloses a multi-physical field topology optimization ash suppression method of a multi-phase intelligent material and structure, a computer-readable storage medium and a force-electric coupling multi-phase material structure for 3D printing. The method comprises the steps of S1, setting initial conditions, taking material density as a design variable, taking the maximum electric energy conversion efficiency as an objective function, taking mechanical energy constraint and volume constraint as constraint functions, constructing a topology optimization model, S2, entering an iteration loop, calculating the objective function and the sensitivity of the objective function and the constraint function to the design variable according to the constraint function, S3, carrying out filtering and projection processing on the calculated sensitivity, S4, updating the design variable through an MMA algorithm, S5, judging whether the design variable obtained through updating in the step S4 meets the convergence condition, executing the step S6, otherwise, substituting the design variable subjected to projection processing in the step S5 into the step S2, continuing the iteration loop, and S6, ending the iteration, and outputting the final topology optimization design.

title: Saturated porous medium super-surface Schottky wave frequency dispersion relation calculation method and system
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of physical acoustics, in particular to a method and a system for calculating the dispersion relation of a saturated porous medium super-surface Schottky wave, wherein the method comprises the following steps of obtaining expressions of solid skeleton displacement, fluid relative displacement, total stress, solid shear stress and pore pressure under the action of the Schottky wave, obtaining expressions of fluid displacement components and fluid normal stress, obtaining expressions of relative motion of a resonator, applying stress and displacement continuity boundary conditions at the interface of the saturated porous medium and a fluid layer according to all the expressions, obtaining a characteristic equation of dispersion characteristics, and solving the characteristic equation to obtain a dispersion curve. According to the invention, by providing the explicit dispersion relation of the saturated porous medium super-surface Schottky wave, the calculation efficiency and the prediction precision of complex interfacial wave propagation are improved, the optimal design of the super-surface resonator array can be guided, and key theoretical tools and technical supports are provided for the design of high-performance acoustic functional devices and structures.

abstract: The invention relates to a new energy power supply capacity assessment method which comprises the steps of determining wind power output probability distribution and photovoltaic output probability distribution of a power grid system according to historical data of new energy power generation of the power grid system, respectively generating a set number of wind power output time sequence curves and photovoltaic output time sequence curves by using a preset wind power output simulation model and a preset photovoltaic output simulation model, respectively conforming the wind power output probability distribution and the photovoltaic output probability distribution by the wind power output time sequence curves and the photovoltaic output time sequence curves, carrying out simulation time sequence analysis on each set of wind power output time sequence curves and the photovoltaic output time sequence curves by combining with prediction boundary conditions of the power grid system to obtain power surplus results of power balance analysis corresponding to each set, and determining predicted power gaps of new energy power supply of the power grid system according to the power surplus results of the set number.

abstract: The invention discloses a gas leakage simulation method of power equipment, electronic equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps of constructing a gas leakage simulation model corresponding to the power equipment, wherein the gas leakage simulation model is used for simulating gas leakage faults of the power equipment, a gas leakage opening and a gas extraction opening are formed in the gas leakage simulation model, gas in the power equipment leaks in the gas leakage opening and the gas extraction opening, determining at least one control equation of the gas, wherein different control equations are used for controlling different flow characteristics of the gas in the power equipment, determining boundary conditions of the gas flowing in the gas leakage opening and the gas extraction opening, and performing simulation solving on the gas leakage faults of the power equipment based on the at least one control equation, the boundary conditions and the gas leakage simulation model to obtain simulation results. The invention solves the technical problem of lower safety of the power equipment.

title: Method for quantizing rotational flow distortion attenuation through guide vanes based on design pre-rotation angle
abstract: The application belongs to the field of aeroengine design, and particularly relates to a method for quantizing rotational flow distortion based on a design pre-rotation angle through guide vane attenuation, wherein corresponding rotational flow evaluation parameters of an upstream surface and a downstream surface are subtracted to obtain rotational flow attenuation after flowing through a flow guide support plate; and further, the attenuation rate of the air inlet rotational flow distortion of the same radial height or the whole surface after passing through the air inlet casing guide support plate is calculated based on the rotational flow attenuation amount after passing through the guide support plate. The method comprises the steps of establishing an upstream reference surface and a downstream reference surface on the upstream and downstream of a flow guide support plate respectively, selecting a certain number of position points on the two surfaces respectively, carrying out full-loop simulation of an air inlet casing based on boundary conditions with rotational flow inlets of an AIP interface, then carrying out rotational flow distortion evaluation parameter calculation on the upstream and downstream reference surfaces and subtraction and division calculation on the upstream and downstream reference surface evaluation parameters based on rotational flow angles of the position points and a flow guide support plate design pre-rotation angle, and obtaining the attenuation rate of air inlet rotational flow distortion after passing through guide vanes so as to achieve the purpose of quantitatively calculating rotational flow attenuation.

title: Embedded frame-oriented lightning strike fire partial differential equation solving method
abstract: The invention discloses an embedded frame-oriented lightning strike fire partial differential equation solving method which comprises the steps of inputting a form, an initial condition, a boundary condition, differential grid division and a neural network structure of a lightning strike fire equation, carrying out discrete solving on the lightning strike fire equation based on a preset grid by utilizing a finite difference method and a time domain finite difference method to obtain a discrete numerical solution on a definition domain, solving the lightning strike fire equation by adopting a physical information neural network, carrying out error correction by embedding the discrete numerical solution to obtain a complete numerical solution on a time-space domain, and outputting a visual result of the complete numerical solution. The invention realizes high-precision approximation and solution of the whole partial differential equation system.

title: Intelligent heat transfer prediction method and system for heat exchanger based on deep learning
abstract: The invention discloses a heat exchanger intelligent heat transfer prediction method and system based on deep learning. The method comprises the steps of firstly obtaining input characteristic data comprising a fluid state and a heat transfer state, secondly, adopting a cascade calibration architecture to conduct prediction, utilizing a first machine learning model to generate an initial heat transfer performance predicted value, utilizing a second machine learning model to predict and correct a predicted residual of the initial heat transfer performance predicted value, obtaining a high-precision final predicted value after superposition of the initial heat transfer performance predicted value and the predicted residual of the second machine learning model, and finally, generating an operation parameter adjustment scheme which takes heat transfer efficiency and energy consumption into consideration through a multi-objective optimization algorithm based on the final predicted value and flow resistance data. The invention solves the problems of low prediction precision, incapability of balancing optimization and poor adaptability of the prior art by combining physical simulation with AI, cascading residual error calibration, dynamic balancing optimization and self-adaptive updating mechanism, and remarkably improves the prediction precision, decision scientificity and reliability of long-term operation of the system.

title: Digital twin method, device, medium and equipment for evaluating service performance of structural material
abstract: The invention relates to a digital twin method, a device, a medium and equipment for evaluating the service performance of a structural material, which comprises the following steps of establishing a digital geometric model of the structural material, and configuring boundary conditions and loads according to the real service environment of the digital geometric model; the method comprises the steps of collecting multisource service state data of a structural material in a multifactor coupling service environment, calibrating and updating the digital geometric model by adopting the state data, constructing a physical-data fusion digital twin model of the structural material, analyzing the service state of the structural material and predicting service life based on a machine learning algorithm, and outputting performance degradation trend and residual service life assessment results of the structural material. The invention applies digital twin to service performance evaluation of the structural material, realizes performance prediction and health state evaluation of the material in a complex environment, improves the safety guarantee capability of the structural material in the whole life cycle, and has important engineering value and strategic significance.

title: Intelligent design method for tunnel open cut tunnel top drainage structure
abstract: The application discloses an intelligent design method of a drainage structure at the top of a tunnel open cut tunnel, which relates to the technical field of tunnel design and comprises the steps of creating a natural terrain model according to a local coordinate system of the tunnel open cut tunnel, generating a peripheral three-dimensional terrain model after open cut tunnel backfilling based on the natural terrain model, determining an open cut tunnel top terrain line according to the peripheral three-dimensional terrain model, determining a drainage structure type corresponding to the top of the tunnel open cut tunnel according to the open cut tunnel top terrain line, setting a limiting boundary condition, determining an optimal starting and ending point of a drainage structure central line according to the drainage structure type in the limiting boundary condition, determining an optimal three-dimensional central line of the drainage structure under the constraint condition of the optimal starting and ending point, optimizing the cross-sectional size of the drainage structure according to different section gradients in the drainage structure, obtaining the optimal cross-sectional size, and generating a three-dimensional solid model of the drainage structure based on the optimal three-dimensional central line and the optimal cross-sectional size. title: Physical AI-based magnetic field environment modeling method
abstract: A magnetic field environment modeling method based on physical AI comprises a data layer, a preprocessing layer, a core modeling layer and a verification and application layer, wherein the core modeling layer comprises a physical knowledge base, stores physical laws, material constitutive relations and boundary conditions related to a target magnetic field environment, a model building module is responsible for designing and building a main structure of a physical AI model according to problem characteristics and the physical knowledge base, a physical AI engine is used for representing an established or trained physical AI model instance, receiving input and rapidly outputting predicted magnetic field values, and a model training module is responsible for training a neural network model generated by the model building module by using the preprocessed data and physical constraints in the physical knowledge base. The core innovation point of the invention is that the physical artificial intelligence paradigm is systematically introduced and applied to the modeling process of the complex magnetic field environment, and an efficient, accurate, robust and physically consistent magnetic field modeling system is created through deep fusion of physical laws and data-driven learning.

abstract: The invention discloses an electromagnetic simulation multi-scale region segmentation method based on deep learning, which is used for constructing and training a deep learning model for identifying key regions and non-key regions in an electromagnetic simulation region, wherein a training process adopts a labeling data set and optimizes model performance by using a cross verification method, a full-wave solution is adopted for simulating the key regions to obtain field distribution of the key regions, a high-frequency approximation method is adopted for simulating the non-key regions to simulate an electromagnetic field generated after incident waves are reflected by the surface of an object, and dynamic boundary conditions are generated at the boundaries of the key regions and the non-key regions to ensure continuity and consistency of field values. In a large-scale electromagnetic simulation scene, the invention realizes the optimal configuration of computing resources by combining deep learning with a mixed solution strategy, focuses limited computing power on a high-precision demand area, and remarkably improves the simulation efficiency and the overall performance.

title: Decision-making method and related device
abstract: This application provides a decision method and a related device, and relates to the field of communication technologies. The decision method includes: obtaining first feature information of a historical real physical environment, where the first feature information includes environment data in a plurality of dimensions; constructing a plurality of physical simulation environments based on the first feature information; obtaining second feature information of an electronic device located in the historical real physical environment, where the second feature information includes body status data in a plurality of dimensions; constructing a digital twin device of the electronic device in a simulation system based on the second feature information; obtaining a decision model based on simulation results of the digital twin device in the plurality of physical simulation environments; and feeding back the decision model to the electronic device. In this application, the plurality of physical simulation environments are constructed based on the historical real physical environment, and simulation is performed in the plurality of physical simulation environments in parallel by using the digital twin device. In this way, the decision model can be quickly and accurately obtained through training, and accuracy of a decision made by the electronic device in a current real scenario is improved.

abstract: The invention discloses a satellite ship on-the-fly general satellite semi-physical simulation method and a system, wherein the method comprises satellite ephemeris resolving and satellite track predicting based on a satellite toolbox and self-defined multi-element two-line report TLE data, generating a target satellite for an on-the-fly general satellite process, carrying out ship bump simulation based on sea wave power spectrum empirical functions corrected by sea area features, adding disturbance for the on-the-fly general satellite, carrying out simulation fitting of an actual measurement inertial navigation data error model and a drift model based on an Allen variance, feeding back three-axis angles of an on-the-fly general antenna system in real time, and carrying out multi-sensor synchronization based on a cubic spline interpolation and extrapolation algorithm of a sensor error model and drift model correction interpolation coefficient, thereby improving simulation reality and data reliability. The communication-in-motion semi-physical simulation platform constructed by the invention effectively restores the satellite communication process of the communication-in-motion antenna, ensures the stability of communication data input and output, supports the introduction of measured data to perform semi-physical simulation, and verifies the accuracy of a satellite algorithm.

title: Regenerative cooling multichannel layout design method based on fuel reaction progress uniformity optimization
abstract: The invention discloses a regenerative cooling multichannel layout design method based on uniformity optimization of fuel reaction progress, which comprises the steps of setting initial channel numbers, determining designed fuel flow of each channel, distributing channels at equal intervals in an initial state, setting section geometric parameters, dividing a cooling structure into a plurality of stations perpendicular to the fuel flow direction, loading thermal boundary conditions according to a non-uniform thermal field of an engine, obtaining fuel temperature and cracking reaction data of each station through calculating a thermal conduction process and fuel cracking reaction, adjusting channel positions between adjacent stations through an optimization algorithm, minimizing objective function values, obtaining channel layout of all stations through repeated optimization calculation, and connecting all stations through a cubic spline curve to obtain a final multichannel layout optimization result. The invention solves the layout adaptation problem of the regenerative cooling channel in a complex thermal environment, improves the cooling efficiency, and reduces the excessive cracking of fuel and the waste of cooling capacity.

abstract: The invention relates to a fault simulation system of a point switch and an troubleshooting training method, wherein the system comprises a judging control console, a monitoring terminal, a control cabinet and the point switch which are sequentially connected, one or more point switches are arranged in a circuit of the point switch, the types of the point switches comprise an indoor indication open circuit, an outdoor indication open circuit, a control circuit open circuit, a protection and starting open circuit and a drive acquisition circuit open circuit, the judging control console transmits fault point information to the monitoring terminal, the monitoring terminal controls the fault point of one of the circuits of the point switch to be disconnected through the control cabinet, and the monitoring terminal displays alarm prompt information and the running state of the point switch. title: Seam high-penetration evaluation method and system for thin interbedded shale oil
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of petroleum development and fracturing, and relates to a seam-height penetrating layer evaluation method and system of thin interbedded shale oil, wherein the method comprises the following steps of S1, constructing longitudinal continuous multi-small-layer geomechanical models of different dessert positions; S2, constructing different thin interbed feature fracturing physical simulation experiments based on a geomechanical model, S3, constructing different thin interbed feature fracture propagation numerical simulation experiments based on the geomechanical model, S4, combining the physical simulation experiments and the numerical simulation experiments, and constructing a thin interbed shale oil seam high-penetration evaluation chart according to the stress difference and the interlayer thickness of different storage interlayers. The system includes a first build module, a second build module, a third build module, and a fourth build module. According to the invention, the artificial crack extension rules under the characteristics of different lithology sequences, mechanical parameters and interlayer interfaces are clarified, and a local fracture height evaluation chart is established, so that the optimization of a fracturing scheme is guided in a targeted manner, and the integral transformation effect of desserts is improved.

title: Mountain tunnel support stress deformation numerical calculation method, system and terminal
abstract: The invention discloses a mountain tunnel supporting stress deformation numerical calculation method, a mountain tunnel supporting stress deformation numerical calculation system and a mountain tunnel supporting stress deformation numerical calculation terminal, wherein the method comprises the steps of carrying out surrounding rock classification and classification, burial depth classification and ground stress classification according to the rock hardness degree, the rock body integrity degree, the burial depth and an initial ground stress field of a mountain tunnel, and then selecting a corresponding constitutive model and boundary conditions according to classification results; based on the constitutive model and boundary conditions, a mountain tunnel supporting stress deformation numerical model is established according to tunnel simulation parameters to carry out simulation calculation, and stress and deformation of the supporting structure are obtained. The method is based on the hierarchical discrimination of the tunnels, adaptively matches the constitutive model and the boundary condition, is used for establishing a numerical model, can effectively improve the accuracy of the stress simulation calculation of the supporting structure, realizes the differential calculation requirement of the same framework from shallow embedding to ultra-deep embedding, is beneficial to evaluating the safety and the stability of the supporting structure, and is suitable for the optimization design and construction safety evaluation of the tunnel supporting structure under the complex geological condition.

title: Modularized multi-level electric energy conversion device based on master-slave architecture sampling communication
abstract: The invention discloses a modularized multi-level electric energy conversion device based on master-slave architecture sampling communication, which comprises a main power circuit and a control system, wherein the control system comprises a semi-physical simulation controller, a signal conditioning circuit and a signal sampling circuit, the signal sampling circuit is used for sampling signals of the main power circuit, acquiring sampling signals and transmitting the sampling signals to the semi-physical simulation controller in real time, the semi-physical simulation controller is used for confirming the on-off condition of a switching tube of each SM sub-module in an MMC circuit according to the acquired sampling signals to obtain pulse signals of the on-off of the switching tube, and the signal conditioning circuit is used for carrying out signal conditioning on the pulse signals of the on-off of the switching tube and outputting the pulse signals to a three-phase signal distribution plate so as to use the conditioned pulse signals for phase control of the MMC circuit. The problem of current MMC experiment platform exist not enough in the aspect of state monitoring reliability, main control unit resource allocation, cause serious restriction system's control bandwidth and dynamic response speed is solved.

title: Semi-physical simulation system and method of wing-variable-bending aircraft
abstract: The invention discloses a semi-physical simulation system and a semi-physical simulation method of a wing-variable aircraft, which belong to the technical field of semi-physical simulation of variant aircraft, and comprise the steps of constructing a model by a PC upper computer and monitoring a flow; the real-time simulation computer is connected with all devices through an optical fiber reflection memory network to execute trajectory calculation, pneumatic processing, wing section reconstruction and deformation control strategy generation, the triaxial servo turntable loads inertial navigation devices and tracks pose information, the wind tunnel applies pneumatic load to the deformed wing, the STM32 driving system realizes multistage motor cooperative control, the measuring system acquires deformation data in real time through the laser displacement sensor, the strain gauge array and the coding disc, the flight control system generates rudder control and deformation instructions, and the annular cascade optical fiber network realizes multiprotocol conversion. According to the invention, the physical deformation wing is integrated into the semi-physical simulation, so that the cooperative test of flight control, deformation control and a machine body structure is realized, the deformation anti-interference and flight safety research is supported, and a foundation is laid for the optimization and test flight of the wing-flexible aircraft.

title: Point cloud neural network aerodynamic force thermal rapid prediction method considering variable geometry
abstract: The invention discloses a point cloud neural network aerodynamic force thermal rapid prediction method considering variable geometric shapes, which belongs to the field of aerodynamics and comprises the steps of determining a study object, constructing a data set, extracting global shape features, local shape features and inflow condition features of different variable geometric shapes under the same basic configuration by adopting a three-dimensional point cloud neural network, taking the global shape features, the local shape features and the inflow condition features as input parameters of the point cloud neural network, and predicting wall pressure and heat flow density by adopting the same model, wherein training data of the three-dimensional point cloud neural network adopts wall heat flow density and pressure under a non-uniform wall temperature boundary condition. The invention can realize the efficient prediction of the wall pressure distribution and the heat flux density under the non-uniform wall temperature boundary conditions of different variable geometric shapes under the same basic configuration, and improves the prediction accuracy.

title: Method, device and medium for determining instantaneous flow pressure state of pipe explosion of pressure pipe network
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of municipal engineering, and discloses a method, a device and a medium for determining the instantaneous flow pressure state of a pipe explosion of a pressure pipe network, which can convert the pipe explosion event of the pressure pipe network from a time domain to a frequency domain for analysis by calculating the Laplacian frequency domain variable of the pipe explosion event to be simulated, the interpolation operation on time and space in the traditional method is avoided, a large amount of calculation and memory burden are reduced, solutions on different frequencies are mutually independent, parallel calculation can be adopted, and therefore calculation efficiency is greatly improved. Furthermore, by constructing an initial hydraulic boundary condition, the hydraulic state of each node when a pipe explosion event occurs is accurately described, so that steady-state hydraulic simulation before pipe explosion and after pipe explosion is respectively carried out, and the accuracy of a simulation result is ensured. And finally, constructing and solving a transient flow frequency domain equation of the pressure pipe network, so that the accuracy of the obtained transient flow pressure change time sequence of the pressure pipe network burst approximates to MOC, and the calculation efficiency is greatly improved.

title: Karst region surface water and underground water exchange quantity inversion method
abstract: The invention discloses a karst region surface water and underground water exchange quantity inversion method based on a temperature tracing method, which is used for collecting temperature time series data of different horizontal positions and different riverbed depths of karst region surface water/riverbed sections, constructing a new two-dimensional heat transmission mathematical model for describing the temperature tracing process of the karst region to be detected by directly utilizing the observed surface water temperature data as boundary conditions of a temperature tracing model, deriving an analytical solution of the constructed mathematical model by adopting a Green function method, and coupling a particle swarm optimization algorithm, breaking the limitation that the traditional temperature tracing model can only invert the vertical exchange quantity, realizing the automatic inversion of the karst region surface water and underground water exchange quantity, providing a new technical means for the interaction of the karst region surface water and the underground water, the water circulation research of the karst region, and the like, and being widely applied to the fields of the numerical simulation of the karst underground water system, the evaluation of water resources, the ecological environment research and the like.

title: Natural frequency data enhancement method for tea-oil tree based on improved CTGAN network
abstract: The invention discloses an enhancement method of natural frequency data of tea-oil trees based on an improved CTGAN network, which comprises the steps of establishing a simplified three-degree-of-freedom mass-spring-damping model of the tea-oil trees, constructing and solving a forced vibration differential equation of the tea-oil trees, collecting multiple groups of size parameters and natural frequency data of the tea-oil trees, constructing an original real data set, inputting the original real data set into the constructed improved CTGAN network, obtaining an optimal improved CTGAN network by minimizing absolute difference of pearson correlation coefficients between the original real data set and a synthetic data set, training the optimal improved CTGAN network to generate multiple groups of synthetic data, evaluating the quality of the synthetic data by using a statistical method, and developing a machine learning model to conduct regression prediction on the synthetic data. The invention expands limited original training samples to generate new samples meeting the real data distribution so as to meet the requirements of the machine learning model on the data samples.

title: Multi-objective optimization method for cooling space power magnetic device structure based on phase change material
abstract: A multi-objective optimization method for cooling a space power magnetic device structure based on a phase change material relates to the technical field of space power magnetic device cooling. The method comprises the steps of designing a magnetic device cooling structure, sealing and wrapping phase change materials on the surface of a magnetic core of the magnetic device through a packaging shell, building a model according to COMSOL Multiphysics, setting the assignment range of thickness variables of the phase change materials to obtain the magnetic device cooling structure with different sizes, performing steady-state parameterization scanning, calculating effective cooling capacity per unit volume and effective cooling capacity per unit mass of a winding and the magnetic core, calculating unit cooling cost of the winding and the magnetic core, and obtaining the thickness value of the optimal phase change material by averaging according to an Origin fitting curve. The space power magnetic device is cooled based on the high latent heat property of the phase change material, and the multi-objective optimization including the volume, the mass, the material cost and the carrying cost is comprehensively considered, so that a better cooling effect is obtained.

title: Train electrical control simulation system
abstract: The application discloses a train electric control simulation system which comprises a sliding plug door centralized control simulation unit, a safety loop simulation unit, an air conditioner control simulation unit, an illumination control simulation unit and a power supply simulation unit, wherein the sliding plug door centralized control simulation unit is used for simulating train opening and closing logic and interlocking functions, the safety loop simulation unit is used for simulating train interlocking functions related to train safety operation and comprises the step of interlocking with the sliding plug door centralized control simulation unit to realize door opening and closing safety interlocking, the air conditioner control simulation unit is used for simulating temperature regulation and air conditioner faults in a train, the illumination control simulation unit is used for simulating train illumination mode switching and emergency response functions, and the power supply simulation unit is used for simulating train power supply selection logic and protection functions and is used for supplying power to the sliding plug door centralized control simulation unit, the safety loop simulation unit, the air conditioner control simulation unit and the illumination control simulation unit. title: Mountain fire spreading simulation method based on FDS
abstract: The invention provides a mountain fire spreading simulation method based on FDS, which is used for solving the problems of insufficient modeling precision, insufficient multi-parameter coupling, contradiction between calculation efficiency and precision and the like of complex terrain in the prior art. The method comprises the steps of preprocessing terrain data of a simulation area, extracting terrain features comprising slopes and directions, dividing grids of the simulation area, dynamically adjusting the resolution of the grids according to the slopes, loading a weather condition dynamic coupling module, combining data in a forest combustible thermal property parameter database, and dynamically simulating fire spread, wherein the forest combustible thermal property parameter database comprises vegetation types corresponding to each grid in the simulation area, thermal property parameters, density, height and water content corresponding to each vegetation type, and the weather condition dynamic coupling module is configured to realize bidirectional coupling of a wind field and a combustion process by quantifying the effect of fire on wind and the effect of wind on fire, and dynamically updating wind speed, wind direction and temperature boundary conditions.

title: Coastal ocean environment modeling method based on physical AI
abstract: The invention discloses a physical AI-based coastal ocean environment modeling method which comprises the steps of obtaining and preprocessing multisource data of a coastal ocean environment, including topography, hydrodynamic observation or driving, wave observation or driving, satellite remote sensing, site observation, navigation observation, a submarine observation network, high-resolution submarine topography and shoreline data and model driving force data, obtaining and formally expressing key physical rules of the coastal ocean environment, constructing a physical AI engine for simulating or predicting sediment concentration or seabed topography change, designing the structure and/or training process into key physical rules capable of being formally expressed, jointly training the physical AI engine based on the multisource data and the formally expressed key physical rules, and performing the simulation or prediction of the state of the coastal ocean environment based on the input of initial conditions and driving force data into the physical AI engine to form a coastal ocean environment model. title: Engine part matching simulation method and device based on non-uniform data transmission
abstract: The invention relates to the field of matching simulation of aeroengines, in particular to a method and a device for matching simulation of engine parts based on non-uniform data transmission, comprising the steps of reading boundary conditions of first parts in a plurality of parts which are connected in sequence in an aeroengine to be analyzed; and repeatedly determining the outlet aerodynamic parameters of the upstream component based on the boundary conditions of the upstream component in the two adjacent components from the first component in the plurality of components, determining the outlet aerodynamic parameters of the upstream component and the outlet static pressure of the upstream component as the boundary conditions of the downstream component to obtain the outlet aerodynamic parameters of the downstream component until the outlet aerodynamic parameters of the last component are obtained, and determining that the iteration stop condition is met if the difference between the inlet static pressure of the downstream component in the target position and the outlet static pressure of the upstream component in each group of adjacent components is smaller than or equal to the static pressure threshold value, thereby obtaining the simulation result of the aeroengine. The method and the device improve the accuracy of the simulation result of the engine.

title: Single pulse simulation method under condition of partial damage of darkroom array
abstract: The invention discloses a single pulse simulation method under the condition of partial damage of a darkroom array, which comprises the steps of determining an array area required to be used on a spherical array when an aircraft performs semi-physical simulation in the darkroom of a radar, selecting a new array area, rotating a turntable for fixing the aircraft according to a preset angle, enabling the midpoint of the area to correspond to a zero position of the turntable at the center of the darkroom of the radar, enabling the orientation of a single pulse radar guiding device carried on the aircraft to avoid the damaged array area, calculating a rotation angle instruction of a turntable for executing a second rotation sequence according to the determined preset angle and a rotation angle instruction of the aircraft on the turntable, calculating the rotation angle instruction of the spherical array for executing the second rotation sequence according to the preset angle and a sight angle required to be simulated when the aircraft is simulated, and executing the turntable and the spherical array according to the corresponding rotation angle instruction respectively, so that a single pulse simulation process is performed.

title: Semi-physical simulation method and system for wind-solar coupling hydrogen production system
abstract: The invention relates to a semi-physical simulation method and system of a wind-solar coupling hydrogen production system. The method comprises the steps of constructing a simulation model of the wind-solar coupled hydrogen production system, compiling and loading the simulation model into a hardware simulation device of a semi-physical simulation platform, simulating a steady-state working condition or a non-steady-state working condition of the wind-solar coupled hydrogen production system, controlling the simulation model to run in the hardware simulation device, sending output of the simulation model into a physical converter and a controller through a power amplifier connected with the hardware simulation device, collecting and returning output of the physical converter and the controller to the simulation model through a signal collecting device, collecting simulation data of the simulation model in real time by an oscilloscope, and analyzing stability and accuracy of the simulation model according to the simulation data of the simulation model under the steady-state working condition and/or the non-steady-state working condition. title: Method for performing core physical simulation program fast calculation by deep learning method
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of numerical calculation of nuclear power station reactors, and particularly relates to a method for performing quick calculation of a reactor core physical simulation program by using a deep learning method. The method comprises the following steps of generating sample data based on a reactor core calculation program, performing deep learning network design and training, and integrating a machine learning model with the reactor core calculation program. The method has the advantage that after acceleration is not performed, the diffusion process needs to be iterated for a plurality of times. When the diffusion solver solves based on the output of the deep learning model, only 1 iteration is needed, the calculation result meets the convergence criterion, so that the calculation speed is greatly improved, and meanwhile, the stability of the whole program is higher and the influence of accidental mutation of the deep learning model is avoided.

title: Wafer test offset detection method, system and storage medium
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of semiconductor manufacturing, and provides a wafer test offset detection method, a system and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: and acquiring key vector data in the wafer test process, wherein the key vector data comprises a thermal load vector, a system state vector and a real-time observation vector, sorting to obtain a multi-mode data set, establishing a hybrid prediction model combining a physical simulation model and a residual error correction model, predicting an actual thermal displacement prediction vector by adopting the hybrid prediction model based on the multi-mode data set, judging whether thermal displacement mismatch risks exist, if so, triggering offset root cause identification, establishing a historical knowledge base, if triggering offset root cause identification, identifying thermal displacement mismatch root causes of the wafer test based on the multi-mode data set and the historical knowledge base, generating a sequence root cause list, sequentially aiming at the thermal displacement mismatch root causes according to the obtained sequence root cause list, generating a mismatch compensation strategy, and compensating the thermal displacement mismatch risks.

title: Structural reliability analysis method based on Kriging model and truncated importance sampling
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of mechanical structure reliability analysis, and particularly relates to a structural reliability analysis method based on a Kriging model and truncated importance sampling, which comprises the following steps of S1, analyzing a mechanical structure, identifying key factors and establishing a functional function; S2, estimating probability distribution forms and parameters of input variables, S3, sampling to generate multidimensional random samples, calculating responses by using a function to form a training sample set, S4, optimizing relevant function parameters of a Kriging model by using the training sample set to construct an initial Kriging model, S5, evaluating MPP by using the Kriging model to form a TIS density function, extracting candidate sample points, S6, selecting the candidate sample point with the smallest learning function value as a newly added training sample point to continuously optimize the Kriging model, returning to S5 if the candidate sample point is not converged, converging to S7, predicting responses by using the Kriging model with local convergence to calculate failure probability and variation coefficients, and returning to S5 if the candidate sample point is not converged. The method can improve the calculation efficiency of the reliability analysis of the complex structure with low failure probability.

title: Cluster target optimization semi-physical simulation method based on cascading BP neural network
abstract: The invention provides a cluster target optimal semi-physical simulation method and system based on a cascading BP neural network, wherein the method comprises the steps of determining a cluster target value grading index according to simulation task requirements, combining simulation experience, constructing a grading sample training set with wide grading distribution, constructing an initial cascading BP neural network, training the cascading BP neural network through the grading sample training set, judging whether the current cluster target distribution exceeds the range of a simulation antenna group, traversing all antenna groups of the simulation cluster target through a position relation if the current cluster target distribution exceeds the range of the simulation antenna group, calculating grading indexes of alternative schemes, inputting the trained cascading BP neural network, outputting grading results of the schemes, taking the highest grading as a final simulation scheme, and directly simulating all targets if the current cluster target distribution exceeds the range of the simulation antenna group. The invention realizes the optimization of the simulation effect of the cluster target under the condition of limited simulation resources, intelligently decides the current optimal simulation antenna group, and has simple network structure and high processing speed.

title: System and method for evaluating stability of anti-generation drug
abstract: The invention relates to the field of drug stability assessment, in particular to an anti-generation drug stability assessment system and a method thereof. The system comprises three modules of challenge sample simulation, drug stability test and intelligent identification. The system generates an anti-noise, self-adaptive and stable countermeasure sample based on the molecular structure of the medicine, and predicts the medicine stability under different conditions through an environmental physical simulation and digital twin model. The intelligent recognition module performs molecular fragment sensitivity analysis, predicts stability under extreme conditions, and outputs an evaluation report. The system solves the problems of efficiency, precision and application range in the prior art, combines innovative technologies to realize evaluation quality change, provides scientific basis for drug research and development, transportation and storage, and remarkably improves the drug stability evaluation level.

title: Rapid calculation method for tube pass sound transmission characteristics of heat exchanger
abstract: The invention discloses a rapid calculation method of heat exchanger tube pass sound transmission characteristics, which relates to the technical field of ships, the method is based on a transmission matrix method, firstly, the heat exchanger tube pass is divided into a plurality of structural units, then, the sound transmission matrix of each unit is obtained by adopting a numerical simulation/analytic calculation/test method, and finally, assembling the matrix according to the overall structure and the unit boundary condition to form an overall transmission matrix, so as to realize the evaluation and calculation of the tube side acoustic transmission loss of the heat exchanger and be beneficial to the quantitative analysis of the acoustic transmission characteristic. The invention breaks through the heat exchange tube sound vibration transmission analysis modeling technology with shell-side fluid, solves the problem that the large-size heat exchanger with sound-solid coupling effect is difficult to calculate by a numerical method, can provide input for the acoustic quantitative evaluation of the ship sea-going cooling pipeline system, and has positive significance for the low-noise design of the heat exchanger and the improvement of the ship sound stealth performance.

title: Uranium dendrite growth prediction method in uranium electrorefining process based on phase field method
abstract: The invention discloses a prediction method for uranium dendrite growth in a uranium electrorefining process based on a phase field method, and belongs to the field of spent fuel aftertreatment. The uranium dendrite growth control method comprises the steps of establishing a phase field model for predicting uranium dendrite growth according to a phase field control equation deduced by electrochemical reaction thermodynamics and free energy functions, carrying out dimensionless treatment on the phase field control equation, inputting the equation into simulation software, determining a phase field simulation domain, carrying out grid division, setting initial crystal nucleus positions, setting parameters, boundary conditions and solving conditions of the uranium dendrite phase field model, determining specific mathematical relations between the parameters of the phase field model and macroscopic measurable parameters through an analytic method, solving the input control equation through the software, outputting a result, and carrying out visual treatment to obtain the uranium dendrite growth morphology in the uranium electrolysis refining process. The method can realize the prediction of the growth of the uranium dendrite under different technological parameters such as constant potential, constant current, pulse electrolysis and the like, is beneficial to comprehensively understanding the growth mechanism of the uranium dendrite, and saves time cost and capital investment.

abstract: The invention relates to a modeling and fault simulation method for an aeroengine lubricating oil system, and relates to the technical field of aerospace. title: Low-inductance energy consumption resistor design method and device based on group intelligent algorithm
abstract: The invention discloses a low-inductance energy consumption resistor design method and device based on a group intelligent algorithm, and belongs to the field of high-power inductive energy storage load design. According to the design resistance value of the laminated energy dissipation resistor, initial design parameters of the resistor are randomly generated, wherein the initial design parameters mainly comprise the number of the resistor pieces, the length, the width and the thickness of the resistor pieces. According to the stray inductance calculation formula, the inductance value under the parameter is calculated and is used as an adaptation value, the adaptation value is input into a gray wolf optimization algorithm, iterative calculation is carried out on the adaptation value, and finally the design parameter with the minimum inductance value is found. Before iteration, corresponding boundary conditions are set according to physical limitations of the resistor design. After iteration for set times, finite element simulation software is used for verification, and model distortion is prevented. The invention can realize the optimal design of the energy consumption resistor, reduce stray inductance and improve discharge performance on the basis of ensuring the accurate resistance value. The invention has simple design flow, higher calculation precision and convenient engineering realization.

title: Numerical simulation method for taper plane model of inertia friction welding
abstract: The invention discloses a numerical simulation method for a taper plane model of inertia friction welding, and relates to the technical field of welding and cutting. The method comprises the steps of establishing a three-dimensional model of a double joint in an inertia friction welding process, establishing a transient thermal coupling module, introducing a fixed end and a rotating end into a geometric structure of the transient thermal coupling module, endowing the fixed end and the rotating end with corresponding metal alloy materials, respectively dispersing the fixed end and the rotating end into a plurality of grids, adjusting grid positions corresponding to the fixed end and the rotating end with the aim of attaching the fixed end and the rotating end, setting a thermal boundary condition between the fixed end and the rotating end, and obtaining a temperature field, stress distribution and displacement cloud picture of the double joint by modifying technological parameters of the fixed end and the rotating end and performing simulation. The method ensures that the accuracy of the stress field, the temperature field and the displacement cloud picture in the inertia friction welding process obtained by carrying out numerical simulation on the inertia friction welding process is higher.
