title: Dimension reduction modeling method suitable for proton exchange membrane fuel cell short stack
abstract: The invention discloses a dimension reduction modeling method suitable for a proton exchange membrane fuel cell short stack, which adopts a one-dimensional flux equation to solve a membrane electrode assembly, and adopts a three-dimensional calculation domain to solve PEMFC short stack polar plates, flow channels and gas diffusion layer assemblies. Including conservation of mass, conservation of momentum, conservation of components, conservation of energy, conservation of liquid water, and conservation of electron potential, and one-dimensional domain including electrochemical reaction, membrane water, electro-osmotic drag, and flux conservation equations associated with catalytic layers and proton exchange membranes. The three-dimensional domain calculation result is used as a one-dimensional domain boundary condition, and is converted into a three-dimensional domain source phase and connected with the three-dimensional domain through an expansion layer. The modeling of the PEMFC short stack can reduce the grid number to one tenth of the traditional three-dimensional model, considers the processes of mass transfer and heat transfer, electrochemical reaction, membrane water balance and the like in the PEMFC, and can accurately simulate the PEMFC stack with the activation area exceeding 300cm  2  and the number of battery blocks exceeding 10.

abstract: The invention discloses an indoor pollutant diffusion analysis method based on CFD simulation, which relates to the technical field of pollution diffusion analysis and comprises the following steps of setting a real-time monitoring unit to collect indoor environment data to be monitored, inputting the indoor environment data to be monitored to a CFD model, setting boundary conditions, constructing a background flow field of a speed field, a pressure field and a temperature field through iterative calculation, dividing an initial grid according to indoor space layout, constructing a pollutant diffusion equation under the condition of the background flow field, obtaining a pollutant estimated concentration value in a historical reference time period, outputting an actual concentration value through a pollutant concentration detection unit, determining whether grid splitting or merging is carried out according to the difference between the estimated concentration and the actual concentration and a concentration gradient, correcting parameters of a pollutant diffusion equation by utilizing the updated actual concentration value of the grid, obtaining an accurate diffusion equation, monitoring pollutant diffusion conditions in real time, and improving the accuracy of the model obviously.

abstract: The invention provides a deep learning method for predicting thermal hydraulic characteristics of a sodium-cooled fast reactor heat exchanger, which belongs to the technical field of passive waste heat discharge systems of sodium-cooled fast reactors, and comprises the steps of utilizing a first DNN to approximate low-fidelity flow and temperature distribution, constructing a nonlinear relation between low-fidelity and high-fidelity data through a second DNN, injecting a physical information partial differential equation and boundary conditions into a third DNN as constraints to optimize a prediction result, and combining a fluid heat transfer partial differential equation and data driving advantages, so that high-fidelity prediction of flow velocity and temperature in the PCHE of the sodium-cooled fast reactor can be realized only by low-fidelity data, the problem that the physical information in the heat exchanger is difficult to measure is solved, and the method has important significance in improving inherent safety and reactor core safety of the sodium-cooled fast reactor.

title: Audio simulation method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract: The application discloses an audio simulation method, an audio simulation device, audio simulation equipment and a storage medium, which relate to the field of audio simulation. Through offline training, the proxy model learns and solidifies the nonlinear mapping relationship from excitation parameters (frequency, voltage) to complex sound field physical characterization (spherical harmonic coefficients). In real-time applications, the trained model can instantaneously predict the spherical harmonic coefficients of the sound source based on the driving parameters and be used for subsequent acoustic simulations and ultimately to synthesize audible audio. Therefore, the time-consuming microcosmic physical simulation process is decoupled into offline training, so that a huge calculation gap of source-field direct coupling is bypassed, real-time full-link audio simulation is realized on the premise of ensuring high precision, and the calculation bottleneck is effectively solved.

abstract: The invention discloses an underground reservoir pressure-bearing structure considering the least adverse working condition and a quantitative design method thereof, which are suitable for the technical field of underground engineering, and comprise the following steps of S1, finding out the mechanical boundary condition of a multilayer structure, and determining the condition of the underground reservoir and corresponding operation parameters; S3, calculating related parameters of the pressure-bearing structure of the underground reservoir under the most unfavorable working conditions by taking the parameters obtained in the step S1 as input according to a three-dimensional stress balance equation. title: Closed-loop self-adaptive motor turn-to-turn short circuit dynamic evolution simulation system
abstract: The invention discloses a closed-loop self-adaptive motor turn-to-turn short circuit dynamic evolution simulation system, which relates to the technical field of motor fault simulation and comprises a feature extraction module, a fault evolution modeling module, a multi-level parameter dynamic correction module and a simulation strategy optimization module, wherein the feature extraction module is used for calculating and generating a fault excitation index and a winding chaos entropy from acquired motor operation data, the fault evolution modeling module is used for solving a preset fault evolution model based on the fault excitation index and the winding chaos entropy to generate an updated fault resistance, the multi-level parameter dynamic correction module is used for correcting parameters of a simulation model according to the winding chaos entropy, and the simulation strategy optimization module is used for switching among a plurality of preset simulation modes according to the winding chaos entropy. title: Wind field data modeling method and system for wind resistance test of small and medium-sized unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract: The invention discloses a wind field data modeling method and system for a wind resistance test of a medium-sized and small-sized unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprise the steps of collecting topographic data, wind speed data and wind turbine data of the test wind field, determining a preset area and an unmeasured area according to a preset track of the unmanned aerial vehicle based on the test wind field, obtaining boundary conditions and disturbance grid wake of the unmeasured area through fluid simulation based on the topographic data and the preset area, carrying out wind speed vector decomposition on grids according to the preset wind field boundary conditions, obtaining a preset wind field model according to disturbance time sequences, maneuvering weights of the unmanned aerial vehicle and disturbance grid wake, obtaining a predicted wind field of the unmeasured area through Gaussian process regression based on the preset wind field model, and obtaining a target wind field model through grid time sequence coupling by using different preset tracks of the unmanned aerial vehicle. According to the method, through space-time collaborative interpolation and fluid simulation of Gaussian process regression, the inlet boundary condition is more in accordance with the fluid mechanics rule, and the physical consistency and reliability of a target wind field are improved.

title: Numerical simulation method for light cutter cutting reinforced concrete continuous wall
abstract: The invention discloses a numerical simulation method for a light cutter cutting reinforced concrete wall, which comprises the steps of S1, constructing a cutter cylinder model, a cutter tooth model and a reinforced concrete wall connecting model, S2, assembling the cutter tooth model and the cutter cylinder model into a light cutter model, arranging the light cutter model and the cutter cylinder model in front of the reinforced concrete wall connecting model, S3, defining material parameters and section properties of each part, S4, creating a dynamic explicit analysis step, sequentially executing grid division, rigid constraint definition and binding constraint definition interaction operation on a three-dimensional model, S5, setting boundary conditions, fixedly connecting four sides of the wall, and applying cutter propelling displacement and rotating speed to a reference point, and S6, carrying out data analysis. The invention can simulate cutting effects under different working conditions, optimize cutter configuration and tunneling parameters, and solve the problem that passive rotation is difficult to simulate when the hob cutters cut reinforced concrete, so that the numerical model is more in line with actual cutting effects.

title: Standard modularized energy storage thermal runaway early warning method and system based on digital twinning
abstract: The invention discloses a standard modularized energy storage thermal runaway early warning method and system based on digital twinning, and relates to the technical field of energy storage system safety monitoring. The method comprises the steps of deploying multi-type sensors in an energy storage unit to form a network, collecting multidimensional data such as temperature, voltage, gas concentration and the like, transmitting the data to a digital twin platform, converting the data into a format, then using the format to predict thermal runaway, combining the platform with an LSTM-GBDT mixed model through physical modeling, outputting risk probability, and triggering early warning by comparing a risk threshold. The system comprises a sensing perception module, a data acquisition and transmission module, a digital twin prediction module and an early warning execution module. The digital twin platform is used for combining physical simulation and historical data training, so that the heat transfer and uncontrolled propagation process can be accurately simulated, virtual simulation optimization is supported, early warning accuracy and reliability are improved, and operation and maintenance burden and accident potential are reduced.

title: Electromagnetic pulse transmission simulation method and system based on scattering matrix and crossing ionosphere
abstract: The invention provides an electromagnetic pulse transmission simulation method and system based on a scattering matrix, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a source area waveform signal, carrying out Fourier transform on the source area waveform signal to obtain the amplitude and the phase of different frequency components of the source area signal, uniformly layering the ionized layer to obtain the electron density, the electron collision frequency and the total electron content of a path along which the ionized layer is layered, writing the scattering matrix by boundary conditions, combining the scattering matrices among all adjacent layers after the uniform layering of the ionized layer to construct a global matrix, calculating a total transmission coefficient, calculating the amplitude attenuation and the phase change of a single-frequency signal when the ionized layer is transmitted according to the total transmission coefficient, carrying out Fourier inverse transform according to the amplitude attenuation and the phase change to obtain a time domain signal after the ionized layer is passed, updating the source area waveform signal, and comprehensively and accurately describing the scattering characteristics of electromagnetic waves in a complex environment by a final simulation result.

title: Full-slope erosion sand transportation simulation method integrating soil properties and land utilization
abstract: The invention discloses a full-slope erosion sand conveying simulation method for integrating soil properties and land utilization, which is characterized by respectively collecting erosion sand conveying basic data corresponding to full slopes of a hilly slope and a valley slope in a river basin, wherein the erosion sand conveying basic data comprises soil data, topographic data, land utilization data, vegetation data and water sand data, automatically judging the erosion environment type of the full slope based on the erosion sand conveying basic data, topographic conditions and land utilization type boundary conditions, acquiring initial parameters to be optimized for influencing erosion based on the erosion environment type, updating the initial parameters to be optimized based on a cuckoo search algorithm until optimal parameters are obtained, changing slope combinations and slope lengths in the topographic conditions and land utilization type and vegetation coverage rate combinations in the land utilization type boundary conditions, obtaining various different scenes, and simulating full-slope sand conveying evolution processes based on the different scenes and the optimal parameters to obtain slope sand conveying rates under different conditions.

title: Hydraulic pump air tightness multi-physical field coupling simulation method
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of hydraulic pump simulation, and discloses a hydraulic pump air tightness multi-physical field coupling simulation method. The method comprises the steps of firstly establishing a three-dimensional geometric model based on hydraulic pump structural parameters, setting multi-physical field coupling boundary conditions such as a fluid field, a temperature field, a stress field and the like, and then carrying out dynamic grid division to generate an adaptive grid topological structure. And inputting the boundary conditions into a coupling solver for iterative computation to obtain initial simulation data, optimizing a grid model according to residual distribution, executing multi-field coupling simulation computation by using the optimized model, and outputting a result. The coupling solver is subjected to history experimental data training construction, the grid can be subjected to local encryption or sparsification, simulation results are stored in a classified mode, access keys are set to ensure safety, and the solver can be optimized according to different working conditions. The method can comprehensively consider the coupling effect of multiple physical fields, improves simulation precision and calculation efficiency, and provides effective support for the study of the air tightness of the hydraulic pump and the design optimization.

title: Fault simulation device of aviation power supply system and control method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses an aviation power supply system fault simulation device and a control method thereof, wherein the device comprises an AC aviation power supply module, an aviation direct current power supply module, a multiplexing switch, a poor contact and overload fault simulator, an RLC load and a signal collector; the device comprises a fault simulator, a fault signal collector, a voltage value acquisition device and an RLC load, wherein the fault simulator is used for simulating series arcs of fault of alternating current power supply and direct current power supply of an aviation power supply under different RLC loads, acquiring arc images and arc temperatures, and acquiring wire images and temperatures during overload faults, the signal collector is used for acquiring voltage values between a multiplexing switch and a zero line and between the fault simulator and the fault simulator, voltage values between a positive electrode and a negative electrode, current flowing through the zero line or the negative electrode and current flowing through a live wire or the positive electrode after the series arcs are generated, and the RLC load is used for simulating different types of loads including resistive loads, inductive loads and capacitive loads.

title: Method and system for measuring and calculating yield of wind-solar storage system based on Homer Pro
abstract: The application discloses a method and a system for measuring and calculating the yield of a wind-light storage system based on Homer Pro, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a wind-light storage system model in Homer Pro software and configuring corresponding parameters; setting up one or more configuration schemes for the wind-solar storage system model, setting corresponding simulation boundary conditions for the configuration schemes to form different simulation scenes, carrying out automatic simulation on each simulation scene, automatically extracting internal yield from simulation results, carrying out structuring treatment on the extracted internal yield to generate internal yield under different configuration schemes, carrying out comparison analysis, and obtaining a sensitivity analysis report and an optimal configuration scheme based on the comparison analysis result. By utilizing the scheme of the application, the simulation scene can be ensured to be flexibly attached to the real boundary conditions of various projects. And a clear sensitivity analysis report and an optimal configuration scheme can be generated, so that a complicated technical measuring and calculating process is converted into an efficient assessment tool.

abstract: The invention discloses a semi-physical simulation method of an airborne radar interference scene, which relates to the technical field of radars and comprises the steps of finding a corresponding file of a scene to be simulated in a recorder, and extracting inertial navigation data and a beam control word to form the file; the method comprises the steps of importing files into scene editing software and a radar beam scheduling module to generate interference track data, sending the interference track data to the radar beam scheduling module, forming interference echo on an interference machine control page, playing back actually measured clutter data through recorder control software, selecting a simulation mode on radar display control software, setting signal processing parameters, running simulation, generating a simulation target by a digital beam forming plug-in, receiving the clutter and the interference echo, synthesizing the clutter and the interference echo to form a synthesized beam, and finally carrying out signal processing.

title: Optical cleaning simulation analysis method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention provides a light cleaning simulation analysis method, a light cleaning simulation analysis device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of light cleaning. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a geometric model of the light cleaning chamber, setting simulation parameters for the geometric model, adding a geometric optical physical field and a laminar flow physical field into the geometric model, setting material initial conditions for the geometric model, carrying out ray tracing on the geometric optical physical field and carrying out steady-state solving on the laminar flow physical field, simulating ultraviolet irradiance and a gas flow field in the light cleaning chamber to obtain a simulation result, and carrying out simulation analysis on the simulation result to obtain a simulation analysis result. The method aims to solve the problems of low research efficiency and high trial-and-error cost caused by the lack of effective guiding directions when the traditional light cleaning technology is used for exploring the layout of the gas circuit and the light source, improve the research and exploration efficiency and reduce the exploration cost in experiments.

title: Marine fan high average stress node fatigue evaluation method
abstract: The invention discloses a fatigue evaluation method for a high average stress node of an offshore wind turbine, which comprises the following steps of firstly, obtaining a load time course of axial force and bending moment acting on the top end of a tower barrel of the offshore wind turbine under each sea condition through dynamic analysis according to environmental parameters including sea condition parameters of a working sea area of the offshore wind turbine and wind, wave and flow coupling action, secondly, establishing a material constitutive model, establishing a steel normal-temperature creep constitutive model through Norton theory and Ramberg-Osgood model, describing creep rate and stress relation of a bolt material under long-term service, thirdly, establishing an integral modeling model of a tower barrel connecting structure and a local fine model of a bolt connecting unit, fourthly, calculating creep influence based on the fine model, loading an analysis result as an initial condition to the integral model and carrying out stress response analysis, and fifthly, carrying out fatigue damage prediction on the offshore wind turbine structure based on S-N curve and Palmgen-Miner rule.

title: Kalman filtering-based composite material repair interface temperature field estimation method
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of composite material repair and intelligent monitoring, in particular to a composite material repair interface temperature field estimation method based on Kalman filtering, which comprises the following steps of 1, constructing an aircraft composite material repair solidification heat transfer control equation; step 2, establishing a one-dimensional space model of the repair curing heat transfer state, establishing a node at intervals of delta z in the thickness direction to obtain a discrete thermal control equation, giving boundary conditions, and step 3, establishing a nonlinear Kalman filtering model of the repair curing heat transfer, deducing to obtain a Kalman filtering coefficient K, inputting an initial state value, and estimating the temperature of a cementing interface. According to the invention, by introducing a state estimation and noise suppression technology, multipoint temperature acquisition data are effectively fused, and the temperature of the adhesive joint interface of the patch is accurately estimated on line and in real time, so that a reliable temperature control basis is provided for a temperature control system of the thermal compensation instrument, and the problem of inaccurate temperature control in the prior art is solved.

title: Performance evaluation method and system for automobile rear wheel active steering system
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent control of rear wheels of automobiles, in particular to a performance evaluation method and system of an active steering system of a rear wheel of an automobile, and establishes a complete set of functions and performance evaluation system and test method of the rear wheel steering system based on the function requirements of the whole automobile and the dynamic performance standards and requirements of the automobile. The method comprises the steps of taking a functional scene, scene working conditions, working condition evaluation indexes and an evaluation method as early evaluation standards of a control strategy software development stage, performing virtual simulation verification, and rapidly performing strategy, software evaluation and optimization. The method can be used as a test working condition and test case foundation of the software and hardware integrated development stage of the controller to carry out semi-physical simulation test of the controller in the loop and carry out quick verification on the software and the hardware of the controller. And the final function and performance are completely evaluated as a judging standard for the function and performance rack test of the rear wheel active steering real object system, the calibration of the whole vehicle and the test evaluation.

title: Practical training platform for overhaul skills of reheater or superheater and control method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a practical training platform for overhaul skills of a reheater or a superheater and a control method thereof, wherein the platform comprises a multi-angle simulation area module, a control module and a control module, wherein the multi-angle simulation area module comprises at least three simulation areas which can be independently operated and are used for respectively simulating different space installation positions of the reheater or the superheater in a boiler of a thermal power plant; the integrated fault simulation module is configured in the replaceable pipe fitting module and is used for actively generating leakage or pipe explosion fault phenomena, and the integrated control module is used for sending a fault triggering instruction to the integrated fault simulation module, calling a preset process database according to the current pipe fitting parameters of the replaceable pipe fitting module and sending synchronous start-stop instructions to at least three simulation areas of the multi-angle simulation area module. Through integrating the multi-module collaborative architecture, full scene coverage, multi-specialty linkage and process pre-verification are realized, and multi-specialty collaborative training operation is supported.

title: Annular heat supply network impedance identification method based on gradient descent method, electronic equipment and computer readable storage medium
abstract: The invention provides a loop heat supply network impedance identification method based on a gradient descent method, electronic equipment and a computer readable storage medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of inputting model parameters and boundary conditions of a loop heat supply network; the method comprises the steps of carrying out normalization processing on a designed impedance vector, calculating a theoretical pressure value based on a hydraulic working condition model of an annular pipe network, combining actual measured pressure values of all heat exchange stations, constructing a loss function, calculating gradients of the loss function on the impedance of all normalized pipe sections, iteratively updating the impedance values of all pipe sections according to the gradients based on a gradient descent algorithm, judging whether convergence conditions are met, carrying out inverse normalization processing on the impedance values meeting the convergence conditions to obtain the actual impedance values of all the identified pipe sections, and realizing the identification of the impedance values of all the pipe sections by only using collected pressure data of the heat exchange stations on the premise that the annular heat supply network is not required to be modified.

title: Method for quickly solving electromagnetic field distribution under variable dielectric constant
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of electromagnetic field calculation, and particularly relates to a method for quickly solving electromagnetic field distribution under a variable dielectric constant. According to the method, the physical field under the initial boundary condition is solved, the full-wave simulation method is utilized, and in the subsequent iterative calculation, the electromagnetic field distribution is continuously adjusted by utilizing a correction calculation formula every time the dielectric constant of a substance changes, so that the corresponding electromagnetic field distribution is obtained. The algorithm is particularly suitable for the situation that the dielectric constant of the substance is gradually changed under the influence of external environment factors. The invention solves the problem of huge calculation amount caused by adopting a repeated full-wave simulation calculation method aiming at the environments such as continuously changing physical properties, physical fields and the like of the substances in the traditional method. By rapidly acquiring real-time electromagnetic field distribution around an object, the electromagnetic field radiation condition and the electromagnetic wave leakage condition of a system can be observed, and the problem of systematic electromagnetic compatibility is solved.

title: Cross-scale large-scale electromagnetic surface grid generation method with periodic fine features
abstract: The invention discloses a trans-scale large-scale electromagnetic surface grid generation method with periodic fine features, which comprises the steps of reading a trans-scale electromagnetic geometric model with periodic fine features, setting replication directions and numbers, setting periodic boundary conditions of the electromagnetic geometric model, determining source surfaces and target surfaces in the replication directions, extracting boundary lines, establishing a mapping relation between the source surfaces and the target surfaces and the boundary lines, discretizing the electromagnetic geometric model to generate a discrete background triangular grid, generating a size field of integral geometry according to the periodic fine features and the trans-scale features of the electromagnetic geometric model, generating and merging surface grids of the source surfaces, the target surfaces and the rest surfaces according to the mapping relation and the discrete background triangular grid and the size field, and batch-copying the merged surface grids according to the replication directions and the numbers according to the surface grids to generate the trans-scale large-scale electromagnetic surface grid with the periodic fine features.

title: Inverter multi-model fusion control performance evaluation method for complex power grid
abstract: The invention discloses an inverter multi-model fusion control performance evaluation method for a complex power grid, and belongs to the field of electrical engineering. The method is oriented to the operation characteristics of the new energy grid-connected inverter in the complex power grid environment, and the high-efficiency evaluation of the multi-model fusion control strategy in the aspects of stability, adaptability and performance improvement is realized by constructing a test sample library covering various disturbance scenes and combining a semi-physical simulation platform and a multi-dimensional performance index system. The method has the characteristics of simplicity and convenience in implementation and comprehensive evaluation, can provide real-time data support for control strategy optimization, and improves the robustness and intelligent regulation and control capability of the grid-connected inverter under the dynamic power grid condition. Compared with the prior art, the method effectively solves the problems that the traditional evaluation method is difficult to quantify adaptability, optimal performance and insufficient evaluation precision when dealing with the disturbance of the complex power grid.

title: Tensioning type mooring interception design method considering mooring failure
abstract: The invention provides a tensioning type mooring line cutting-off design method considering mooring failure, which comprises the steps of 1, selecting a mooring line cutting-off parameter and a value range thereof, 2, obtaining restoring force data after each displacement of a platform under full water depth, 3, obtaining a mooring line horizontal projection distance under an initial condition of the platform under cutting off water depth, 4, obtaining restoring force data after each displacement of the platform under cutting off water depth, 5, determining a mooring line failure working condition and formulating an optimization algorithm objective function, and 6, optimizing and selecting the mooring line cutting-off parameter by utilizing the determined optimization algorithm objective function through an optimization program to obtain an optimal solution. The invention can simultaneously consider the interception design of the two conditions before and after the mooring failure, further provides reference for the interception design of the mooring failure, and can effectively reduce the error of the restoring force of the platform with full water depth by considering the interception design of the conditions before and after the mooring failure compared with the interception design of the platform under the condition of no failure.

title: Pier scouring multiphase flow calculation method and system based on physical information neural network
abstract: The invention discloses a pier scour multiphase flow calculation method and a system based on a physical information neural network, comprising the following steps of constructing a two-phase flow pier scour calculation equation based on an Euler-Euler method; the method comprises the steps of constructing initial parameters and boundary conditions of a two-phase flow pier flushing model, generating simulation data, dividing the data into a test set and a training set, establishing a two-phase flow based physical information neural network according to a constructed two-phase flow pier flushing calculation equation and the given initial parameters and boundary conditions of the two-phase flow pier flushing model, training the two-phase flow based physical information neural network, and obtaining a prediction result of the multi-phase flow pier flushing physical information neural network. The method overcomes the limitation of the traditional prediction method, and can obviously improve the calculation efficiency while ensuring the precision.

title: Technological parameter optimization method for reducing residual stress of cylinder head of large-bore diesel engine
abstract: The invention discloses a process parameter optimization method for reducing residual stress of a cylinder head of a large-bore diesel engine, which comprises the following steps of establishing a J-C constitutive model of a cylinder head material, carrying out multi-procedure machining process simulation analysis on the cylinder head by utilizing a 'dead unit' technology and the J-C constitutive model to obtain a residual stress simulation value, adopting a blind hole method to obtain a test value of the residual stress, comparing the test value with the simulation value, controlling the error value within an allowable error range, establishing a nonlinear mapping relation between a cutting parameter and a response target based on a data regression prediction model of a BP neural network to obtain a prediction model, optimizing cutting parameters of three machining processes of cylinder head milling, turning and boring by adopting the prediction model, predicting to obtain a minimum residual stress value and an optimal cutting force, taking the optimal cutting force as a boundary condition, and carrying out machining process simulation analysis to obtain an optimal reduction amplitude of the residual stress value. The invention greatly reduces the residual stress of the cylinder cover.

title: Semi-physical simulation system and method of magnetic suspension bearing, electronic equipment and medium
abstract: The embodiment of the invention relates to the field of semi-physical simulation tests and discloses a semi-physical simulation system and method of a magnetic suspension bearing, electronic equipment and a medium. The system comprises a magnetic bearing, a simulation development computer and a real-time simulation target machine, wherein the simulation development computer is used for constructing a driving circuit model according to a driving circuit of the magnetic bearing and sending the constructed driving circuit model to the real-time simulation target machine, the real-time simulation target machine is used for collecting operation data of the magnetic bearing in real time, inputting the operation data into the driving circuit model to obtain a first operation state of the magnetic bearing, determining a first control parameter according to the first operation state to drive the magnetic bearing to act through the first control parameter, and the real-time simulation target machine is pre-stored with the corresponding relation between the operation states of a plurality of magnetic bearings and the control parameter. The method solves the problems existing when the magnetic bearing system is researched by adopting an all-physical test or an all-digital simulation mode.

title: Multi-mode simulation method for flight environment simulation control system
abstract: The application provides a multi-mode simulation method of a flight environment simulation control system, which belongs to the technical field of aeroengines and comprises the steps of selecting a full-digital simulation experiment or a semi-physical simulation experiment, operating an object model and a control model, calculating simulation parameters, calculating a feedforward control quantity according to the engine rotating speed change rate output by the object model by the feedforward controller, estimating the total disturbance of the system by the expansion state observer to obtain an estimated value, feeding back the estimated value to the active disturbance controller, calculating to obtain an initial control quantity, superposing the feedforward control quantity and the estimated value by the initial control quantity to obtain a final control quantity and inputting the final control quantity into a hydraulic control valve flow model in the object model, setting control parameters of the control model by the full-digital simulation experiment, and optimizing the set control parameters by the semi-physical simulation experiment, thereby improving simulation confidence and efficiency and reducing cost.

title: Slope rainfall infiltration stability dynamic evaluation and landslide prediction method
abstract: A dynamic evaluation and landslide prediction method for slope rainfall infiltration stability comprises the steps of constructing a numerical model coupling rainfall infiltration and slope stress field response, integrating multi-source data, updating model boundary conditions in real time, carrying out dynamic stability evaluation based on a local safety coefficient method, training a landslide prediction model and realizing intelligent early warning judgment. The invention provides a seepage-stress-intensity three-field coupling numerical model, which dynamically simulates the physical response process of an unsaturated soil body, can truly restore the precursor mechanism of rainfall induced landslide, improves prediction scientificity and accuracy, integrates remote sensing topographic data, soil property investigation parameters and real-time meteorological monitoring information, dynamically updates the boundary condition and initial state of the model through a system interface, realizes real-time response environment change, improves simulation reliability, introduces a local safety coefficient assessment mechanism, combines a continuous weak area discrimination algorithm, realizes space identification and time sequence tracking of a potential slippage area and a damaged area, and improves the analysis refinement level of slope stability.

title: Piping lane pipeline key connection point leakage monitoring system and method based on AI vision
abstract: The application relates to the field of computer vision and industrial safety monitoring, and discloses a piping lane pipeline key connection point leakage monitoring system and method based on AI vision, wherein the system comprises a data acquisition module, an intelligent analysis module, a 3D modeling module, a space-time verification module and an alarm prediction module, and real-time detection and three-dimensional accurate positioning of a leakage area are realized by dynamic fusion of visible light, infrared and pressure data and neural network optimization driven by physical simulation parameters; and further screening false alarm events of non-physical laws through optical flow tracking and hydrodynamic verification, generating a leakage risk heat map and triggering hierarchical alarm based on Bayesian decision and diffusion equation prediction. The application solves the technical problems of low leakage detection precision, high false alarm rate and inaccurate positioning in complex pipe gallery scenes, has the advantages of high environmental adaptability, strong anti-interference capability and prospective risk pre-judgment, and is suitable for intelligent safety monitoring of underground pipe galleries and petrochemical pipelines.

title: Deep learning numerical solution method of anisotropic scattering neutron transport equation
abstract: The invention particularly relates to a deep learning numerical solution method of an anisotropic scattering neutron transport equation, which belongs to the technical field of neutron transport equation solution, and comprises the steps of 1, establishing an expression of the neutron transport equation according to a geometric form and boundary conditions of a scattering source, 2, respectively differentiating integral terms in the neutron transport equation into original functions corresponding to integrated functions under integral numbers to obtain differential equations, and establishing a constant solution constraint condition of the original functions, 3, respectively mapping the original functions and unknown angular flux density functions in the neutron transport equation into neural network functions, and carrying out alternate iterative deep learning based on a framework for solving the differential equations by the aid of the deep learning until a loss function is smaller than a preset value to obtain a numerical solution of the unknown angular flux density function. The invention provides a new technical approach for a numerical solution method of an anisotropic scattering neutron transport equation.

title: Thermoelastic analysis method for hollow rotary drum structure
abstract: The invention relates to a thermoelastic analysis method of a hollow rotary drum structure, which comprises the following steps of S1, establishing a fractional order heat conduction equation considering the viscoelasticity effect and establishing a motion equation and a constitutive equation without taking physical strength into account for the hollow rotary drum structure, S2, determining the boundary condition of the hollow rotary drum structure with thermal shock effect, S3, carrying out dimensionless treatment on the fractional order heat conduction equation, the motion equation, the constitutive equation and the boundary condition to obtain a control equation, S4, carrying out Laplace inverse transformation on the obtained control equation, solving the obtained control equation by a eigenvalue method to obtain a mechanical property distribution result, and providing a corresponding distribution rule diagram. Compared with the prior art, the invention has the advantage of being more fit with the actual working condition. The method has the advantages of improving the calculation accuracy, providing an efficient solving method, ensuring the numerical stability, along with wide applicability and the like.

title: Pipeline inner wall spraying simulation control method and device based on digital twin
abstract: The embodiment of the application provides a pipeline inner wall spraying simulation control method and device based on digital twinning, wherein the method comprises the steps of importing a guide rail model and a motion mechanism model into offline programming software, configuring a motion pair, constructing a virtual scene corresponding to an actual pipeline inner wall spraying production line based on a digital twinning technology, importing a pipeline three-dimensional model, configuring workpiece parameters, calibrating coordinate data, identifying a pipeline inner wall spraying area boundary, defining a spraying range, generating an initial spraying track, adjusting parameters according to boundary conditions, optimizing the track, configuring spray gun parameters, importing a flange plate and the spray gun model, completing basic tool configuration, importing a tool model, configuring tool parameters, configuring spraying parameters based on sampling data, and obtaining a spraying tool. And the real-time visualization of the spraying track optimization, the parameter dynamic matching and the spraying effect is realized.

title: Structural dynamic response analysis method based on hard constraint Fourier characteristic physical information neural network
abstract: The invention discloses a structural dynamic response analysis method based on a hard constraint Fourier characteristic physical information neural network, and relates to the technical field of structural dynamic response analysis. The method comprises the steps of mapping time domain input into multi-scale frequency components through a Fourier basis function, combining frequency spectrum components by adopting a leachable weight matrix, reconstructing time domain displacement response through a nonlinear activation layer to serve as an objective function to be output, hard-coding initial conditions into a displacement function through a time modulation function, automatically differentiating and calculating first-order derivatives and second-order derivatives of the displacement function through a deep learning framework, substituting the first-order derivatives and the second-order derivatives into a structural dynamics ordinary differential equation, constructing a loss function based on a residual error of the structural dynamics ordinary differential equation, and outputting or reversely transferring the loss function to input of a neural network based on a calculation result of the loss function. According to the invention, the selection of the Fourier characteristic parameters is determined through the priori knowledge of the dynamic equation solution of the structure, fourier mapping is introduced, and the dynamic initial conditions are embedded into the neural network by adopting a hard constraint method, so that the loss function only keeps the loss terms of the dynamic equation, the problem that the traditional physical information neural network is difficult to learn the limitation of high-frequency information is solved, the error caused by the improper weighting method is avoided, and the optimization process for balancing the weights of all the loss terms is omitted.

title: Heterogeneous interconnection multi-core distributed simulation experiment system and cooperative control method
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of simulation, and particularly discloses a heterogeneous interconnection multi-core distributed simulation experiment system and a cooperative control method, wherein the system comprises a semi-physical simulation system and a virtual system; the semi-physical simulation system comprises a plurality of semi-physical simulation nodes, a plurality of multi-core parallel simulation nodes, a digital simulation system, an experimental environment model, a virtual-real combined simulation experiment platform and a dynamic deduction visual simulation engine, wherein each semi-physical simulation node can simulate a semi-physical simulation entity, each multi-core parallel simulation node can simulate a plurality of parallel semi-physical simulation entities, the virtual system comprises the digital simulation system, the digital simulation system can simulate a plurality of parallel digital simulation entities, the experimental environment model is used for simulating generation of experimental environment modeling data, the virtual-real combined simulation experiment platform is used for deduction and rendering of a working scene, and the dynamic deduction visual simulation engine is used for rendering environment information by using the experimental environment modeling data. The system has the capability of multi-core simulation, and can further improve the upper limit of the access of the semi-physical simulation model to the semi-physical system, so that the semi-physical system can perform cluster simulation.

title: Ultra-fine group resonance self-screen deep learning calculation method for uniform system
abstract: The invention relates to a uniform system hyperfine group resonance self-screen deep learning calculation method, which belongs to the technical field of nuclear reactor core calculation and comprises the following steps of mapping a neutron slowing equation and a primitive function transformation equation in a complete differential form into a neural network function respectively, constructing a neutron slowing equation loss function, a primitive function transformation equation damage function, a scattering source primitive function fixed solution constraint loss function, an energy initial condition loss function and a flux density non-negative boundary condition loss function, weighting to form a machine learning loss function, alternately adjusting neural network function parameters according to the machine learning loss function to carry out iterative deep machine learning, training the whole training set into small training sets from high to low sequentially in an energy section order, and solving the segmentation of the neutron slowing equation by taking the training set of the former energy group as the boundary condition of the latter energy group. The invention realizes a new way for solving neutron moderation equation in uniform system.

title: Optimal design method suitable for CO2 gas cooler
abstract: The invention discloses an optimal design method suitable for a CO2 air cooler, which comprises the following steps of S1, obtaining design requirements of the air cooler and determining key optimization parameters and optimization targets by combining application scenes, S2, generating an initial data set through experimental design and CFD (computational fluid dynamics) analog calculation, S3, preprocessing data, including normalization processing, outlier rejection and missing value filling, and S4, constructing a proxy model according to the preprocessed data, and fitting a nonlinear relation between input parameters and output performance indexes by adopting an artificial neural network or a response surface analysis method. According to the invention, a mathematical model of air cooler fluid flow and heat exchange is established through the CFD simulation module, and fine simulation is performed aiming at flow and heat exchange characteristics in a CO  2  supercritical state, and great attention is paid to details such as grid division precision, boundary condition setting, turbulence model selection and the like.

title: Marine engine fault diagnosis method based on digital twin
abstract: The invention discloses a digital twin-based marine engine fault diagnosis method which comprises the following specific steps of 1, constructing a marine digital twin model, 2, fusing sensor acquisition data and fault simulation data through extended Kalman filtering to be used as training set samples, 3, constructing an engine fault diagnosis model through an LMS algorithm with a step variable factor, 4, training the engine fault diagnosis model through the training set samples to complete training of the engine fault diagnosis model, 5, transmitting real-time sensor data into the engine fault diagnosis model to diagnose engine faults, feeding back engine fault types and fault parameters, and 6, displaying the fed back engine fault types and the fault parameters through the marine digital twin model. The invention combines the improved fault diagnosis method with the digital twin system, so that the fault diagnosis efficiency and accuracy are improved, and the fault visualization is realized.

title: Reliability scheme generation method integrating knowledge graph and large model
abstract: The invention discloses a reliability scheme generation method for fusing a knowledge graph and a large model, which belongs to the field of electronic product reliability engineering and comprises the following steps of S1, constructing a knowledge graph of the electronic product reliability field containing entity attributes, relations and dynamic constraints, S2, fusing synthetic data with real data to obtain an electronic product reliability enhancement data set, S3, introducing knowledge consistency loss to perform joint training to obtain an ER-KG-RAG-LLM fusion model with field knowledge anchoring and reliability scheme generation capability, S4, receiving the reliability requirement of the electronic product, inputting the ER-KG-RAG-LLM fusion model, and outputting a reliability scheme. By adopting the reliability scheme generation method integrating the knowledge graph and the large model, the whole process of the electronic product reliability scheme from knowledge retrieval to intelligent generation is credible and efficient, and engineering accuracy and scene suitability are considered.

title: New energy power station power equipment infrared temperature measurement simulation method
abstract: The invention discloses an infrared temperature measurement simulation method for power equipment of a new energy power station, which comprises the following steps of creating scenes of the new energy power station and the power equipment by a Unity engine, obtaining map pictures conforming to infrared thermal imaging color characteristics, assigning the map pictures to a mapping channel of a display screen model, establishing a UI panel and a UI temperature measurement box, calculating a maximum temperature point in the UI temperature measurement box, calculating the display temperature of the maximum temperature point in the UI temperature measurement box according to the influence law of the material emissivity and the measurement distance of an object in a real environment on temperature measurement values, displaying the display temperature in the infrared display screen model mapping, establishing a fault simulation server, and sending fault information to a student client for infrared temperature measurement simulation training. According to the simulation method provided by the invention, the infrared thermal imaging map is truly simulated and displayed, so that the simulation training effect consistent with that of a real infrared thermometer is achieved, and the simulation training, examination, skill identification and the like of the infrared temperature measuring process are realized.

title: Typical equipment general health management platform based on multi-model environment
abstract: The invention discloses a general health management platform of typical equipment based on a multi-model environment, which is used as a full-digital platform and is designed and developed by adopting a B/S architecture, the platform consists of a multi-signal flow graph, a AMEsim multi-model environment, a model database, fault injection, fault diagnosis, fault mining, state evaluation and other functional modules, the two model environments provide modeling paradigms of the typical equipment based on different modes, the model database stores comprehensive test information and provides a data interaction interface, and the functional modules provide multi-type health management functional nodes. The invention is a health management platform software core, realizes the integration of two model environments, the regularity of model paradigms and the unification of data interfaces, provides multi-type health management service, fully utilizes model test information, is suitable for health management tasks of multi-type typical equipment, has the advantages of strong portability, multi-user parallel operation and the like, and can meet wider health management requirements.

title: Integrated algorithm: numerical simulation with two rounds of machine learning for monitoring and control devices
abstract: A computer and machine-implemented method based on integrated numerical/machine learning for general-purpose simulation of real-world systems. The purpose is to allow machines to carry out simulations and analyze the surrounding environment for advanced monitoring and control tasks. The processors available in the devices are limited in their capabilities and they cannot perform complicated calculations. In addition, the boundary conditions of the real-world systems are in a continuous change, which makes the simulation task very difficult for machines. Moreover, validating the simulation is a human task. The method is set to overcome the challenges by compromising a numerical method with two- round machine learning. The first round helps to simplify the numerical model, whereas the second round allows the device to adjust the numerical algorithm in responding to any change in the boundary conditions. Additionally, the method can be used as computer software to reduce the computational and validation effort.

title: Tunable Beam Scanning Metagratings Leaky Wave Antenna Based on Varactor Diodes
abstract: This invention discloses a tunable beam scanning method for metagratings leaky wave antennas based on varactor diodes, which includes the following steps: S1, research and analysis of the mechanism of metagratings beam conversion; research on the Mechanism of planar metagratings under Anisotropic, uniform, and continuous periodic boundary conditions; S2, design and optimization of transmission modes according to the Floquet-Bloch (FB) theorem using metagratings; research on the desired FB mode and eliminate adverse effects by designing a tool for metagratings parameters; S3, analysis and design of metagratings leaky wave antennas; research on the analytical fields and currents of synthesized metagratings within the framework of leaky wave antennas to customize phase, beam shape, and polarization performance; S4, design and analysis of electrically tunable beam-controlled metagratings leaky wave antennas. This invention adopts the aforementioned tunable beam scanning method for metagratings leaky wave antennas at a fixed frequency based on varactor diodes.

title: Method and system for constructing temperature field of reflecting surface of antenna
abstract: The application discloses an antenna reflector temperature field construction method and system, wherein the method comprises the steps of carrying out heat-fluid coupling simulation analysis on an antenna reflector geometric model by utilizing finite element simulation analysis software to obtain a first simulation temperature distribution set of an antenna reflector, reversely solving a simulation parameter set when carrying out heat-fluid coupling simulation analysis on the antenna reflector geometric model by utilizing an optimization algorithm based on the first simulation temperature distribution set and the first temperature set, correcting parameters and boundary conditions of the antenna reflector geometric model by utilizing the simulation parameter set to obtain an optimized antenna reflector geometric model, carrying out heat-fluid coupling simulation analysis on the optimized antenna reflector geometric model based on finite element simulation analysis software to obtain a second simulation temperature distribution set of the antenna reflector, and constructing the temperature field of the antenna reflector by taking the second simulation temperature distribution set as a data set based on a machine learning method, thereby improving the accuracy of the prediction of the reflector temperature field.

title: Physical and data fusion driven chemical laser numerical simulation method
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of chemical laser numerical simulation, and relates to a chemical laser light-emitting power prediction method based on series driving of physical and data models, which comprises the following steps of collecting experimental design parameters and experimental light-emitting performance of a chemical laser, and establishing an original experimental database; the method comprises the steps of obtaining the concentration of a process species through chemical equilibrium calculation, obtaining key intermediate variables of a light emitting process by taking experimental conditions and the concentration of the process species as boundary conditions of hydrodynamic calculation, using the key intermediate variables of the light emitting process to expand an original database, calculating a ratio relation between temperatures based on aerodynamic relation in a chemical laser process, using the ratio relation between the temperatures to expand the original database, generating sub-feature spaces with dimensions in a specified range according to the expanded feature spaces, respectively using the sub-feature spaces for training of a data model, selecting the sub-feature spaces based on a feature selection method, and predicting light emitting power on the sub-feature spaces correspondingly selected by the data model. According to the invention, chemical laser power is predicted through experimental design parameters, and acceptable calculation accuracy of engineering is provided while the calculation cost is low.

title: Sheath steady-state voltage and circulation calculation method based on multi-loop land cable distributed model
abstract: The invention discloses a sheath steady-state voltage and circulation calculation method based on a multi-loop land cable distributed model, which comprises the steps of 1, obtaining factors influencing steady-state induced voltage and circulation of a multi-loop single-core land cable sheath, 2, establishing a multi-loop single-core land cable unit length distributed parameter model, further obtaining a multi-loop land cable system linear equation set matrix, 3, calculating series impedance of multi-loop single-core land cable lines in the system linear equation set matrix, 4, calculating parallel admittances among the multi-loop single-core land cable lines in the system linear equation set matrix, 5, constructing an impedance matrix and an admittance matrix, thereby supplementing the system linear equation set matrix completely, 6, determining boundary conditions of the system linear equation set matrix, 7, solving the system linear equation set matrix, namely obtaining steady-state induced voltage and circulation values, and 8, calculating steady-state induced voltage and circulation of the multi-loop single-core land cable sheath with the same arrangement mode. The invention omits repeated modeling and simulation calculation processes, improves the adaptability of the model, and has great engineering value.

title: Motor stator winding turn-to-turn short circuit modeling and simulation system
abstract: The invention discloses a motor stator winding turn-to-turn short circuit modeling and simulation system, which relates to the technical field of motor fault simulation and comprises a feature extraction module, a fault evolution modeling module, a multilevel parameter dynamic correction module and a simulation strategy optimization module, wherein the feature extraction module is used for calculating and generating a fault excitation index and winding chaos entropy from acquired motor operation data, the fault evolution modeling module is used for solving a preset fault evolution model based on the fault excitation index and the winding chaos entropy to generate an updated fault resistance, the multilevel parameter dynamic correction module is used for correcting parameters of a simulation model according to the winding chaos entropy, and the simulation strategy optimization module is used for switching among a plurality of preset simulation modes according to the winding chaos entropy. According to the invention, a closed-loop self-adaptive system is constructed, a interdisciplinary theory is fused, dynamic simulation of the turn-to-turn short circuit full life cycle of the motor is realized, and high fidelity, physical interpretability and calculation efficiency are considered through a multi-level correction and self-adaptive strategy.

title: Method for optimizing subway rail top air port setting height
abstract: The invention discloses a method for optimizing the setting height of a subway rail top air port, which relates to the technical field of subway rail top air ports and specifically comprises S1, S2 and S3. The method for optimizing the height of the rail top air opening of the subway provided by the invention can quantitatively calculate the height of the rail top air opening under the optimal heat removal effect, meanwhile, the input conditions of calculation simulation of the method take account of scientific rigor and engineering feasibility, the regularity of the subway operation is relied on, the typical values of the piston air temperature and speed and the typical values of the condenser air outlet temperature and speed are determined by adopting time weighted average, the boundary conditions can be reflected relatively scientifically, the calculation amount brought by taking the number one by one in the boundary condition range is greatly reduced, and the engineering application is more convenient.
